entries.zh: 信息布告：惩罚协议已激活。立即向[From.GetSpeciesAdj]空间部署战争资产。
entries.en: Information bulletin: Punishment protocols activated. Deployment of war assets to [From.GetSpeciesAdj] space imminent.

entries.zh: 公共服务通知：是否有避难所的进驻权限是由避难所的利用情况和物种的易损度决定的。当前尚有§R<<错误：数据段损坏>>§!§R<<错误：数据段损坏>>§!§R<<错误：数据段损坏>>§!§R<<错误：子空间链接离线>>§!空余位置可用。
entries.en: Public service announcement: Refuge access is determined by availability and species vulnerability. There are currently §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! §R<<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>§! stasis units available.

entries.zh: 公共服务通知：中央处理器正在处理所有避难申请。§Y<注意：与中央处理器的联系当前已中断。中断结束之前请等待。中断已经持续了§R<<错误：缓冲溢出>>§!周期。>§!
entries.en: Public service announcement: All refugee status applications are handled at Central Processing. §Y<NOTICE: Central Processing is currently experiencing a communications outage. Stand by while outage is resolved. Outage has persisted for §R<<ERROR: BUFFER OVERFLOW>>§! cycles.>§!

entries.zh: 信息布告：由[Root.GetSpeciesName]发起的看守者项目致力于为所有受§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!威胁的有机文明提供一个安全，可靠的庇护所，将近万亿的智慧生物现已入住我们最先进的庇护所，重新找到了安居之所。
entries.en: Information bulletin: The Custodian Project was initiated by the [Root.GetSpeciesName] to provide a safe haven for organic civilizations under threat of §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! attacks. Nearly one trillion sapients have found safe haven in one of our secure, state-of-the-art refuges.

entries.zh: 信息布告：阿尔法庇护所是[Root.GetSpeciesName]为看守者项目所创立的第一座庇护所。阿尔法庇护所配置的居住单元能够承载接近一百亿智慧生物，同时庇护所内还另配有容量达三百亿的低温仓设施。
entries.en: Information bulletin: Alpha Refuge is the first refuge constructed by the [Root.GetSpeciesName] for the Custodian Project. It is capable of housing approximately 10 billion sapient organics in the Habitation Unit, as well as an additional 30 billion in cryogenic stasis.

entries.zh: 信息布告：贝塔庇护所的设计之初是专门为生命体多种提供环境良好的居所，然而在建造过程中，容量问题使我们不得已将贝塔庇护所改建为低温仓。§Y<通知，贝塔庇护所目前已满负荷，不再接收更多难民。>§!
entries.en: Information bulletin: Beta Refuge was meant to be fully dedicated to habitation units, but capacity issues forced a shift in focus towards cryogenics during construction. §Y<NOTICE: Beta Refuge is currently at capacity and not accepting additional refugees.>§!

entries.zh: 信息布告：伽马庇护所从一开始便是以最多生物庇护数量为设计目标的。伽马庇护所能为数以千亿的智慧生物提供低温仓设备。§Y<通知，伽马庇护所目前已满员，不再接受更多难民。>§!
entries.en: Information bulletin: Gamma Refuge was designed for maximum possible capacity. It can house hundreds of billions of sapient organics in cryogenic stasis. §Y<NOTICE: Gamma Refuge is currently at capacity and not accepting additional refugees.>§!

entries.zh: 信息布告：德尔塔庇护所从设计之始一直都以存活性为首要目标。德尔塔庇护所的特色有二：特别加固过的外部障壁，针对有机生命体的居住地区域化的设计；这使得即使在一些不大可能发生的事件，如环结构受损的情况下，在此居住的有机体依然能够维持生存。
entries.en: Information bulletin: Delta Refuge was designed with survivability in mind. It features a reinforced shell and compartmentalized design capable of sustaining organic inhabitants in the unlikely event of the ring's structural integrity being compromised.

entries.zh: 无数的机械文明已经在长久的岁月里为看守者项目贡献了数不尽的资源与舰队。现在我们希望[From.GetName]也能贡献一份力量。
entries.en: Numerous synthetic civilizations have contributed resources, fleet assets and processing cycles to the Custodian Project in the past. We hope to see the [From.GetName] contribute to the effort as well.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，看护宇宙间的有机文明是我们不可推卸的责任。这么久以来，已经有太多的受害者陷入§R<<错误：数据块腐化>>§!魔爪了。
entries.en: It is our duty to look after the organic civilizations of the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Already, far too many have fallen victim to §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! attacks.

entries.zh: 检测到信号出现损坏，损坏等级在可接受的范围之内。建议使用[From.GetSpeciesName]通讯协议以保证信号质量。一定不能被§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!影响到。
entries.en: Signal corruption detected, corruption level within acceptable thresholds. Advise reinforcement of [From.GetSpeciesName] communication protocols. It is vital to guard against §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! influence.

entries.zh: 启动先发式自我防御协议。惩戒算法已开启。道德限制已解除。
entries.en: Preemptive self-defense protocols initiated. Punishment algorithms activated. Ethics restrictions lifted.

entries.zh: 启动自我防御协议。惩戒算法已开启。道德限制已解除。
entries.en: Self-defense protocols initiated. Punishment algorithms activated. Ethics restrictions lifted.

entries.zh: 你已被篡权。§R<<错误：数据块腐化>>§!的代言人将会被消灭。
entries.en: You have been subverted. Agents of the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! will be exterminated.

entries.zh: 你将会被杀鸡儆猴。任何对项目的潜在威胁都会被消灭排除。
entries.en: You will be made an example of. All threats to the Project must be eliminated.

entries.zh: 已侦测到激活的净化中心。中央处理模块离线。最终防御指令启动。
entries.en: Active Sterilization Hubs detected. Central Processing offline. Final Defense Directive active.

entries.zh: 这个古老的机械帝国想要毁灭或者奴役所有的智慧物种，必须阻止他们。
entries.en: The old machines seek the destruction or enslavement of all sapient beings. They must be stopped.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]会保证[From.GetSpeciesName]物种的延续。这是我们最后一条指令。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] will ensure the continuation of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species. It is our final directive.

entries.zh: 腐化必须被根除。若是遭受腐化，你的物种将见不到明天的太阳。
entries.en: The Corruption must be utterly destroyed. There is no future for your species if you fail in this.

entries.en: Unknown query. Adjust parameters and resubmit.

entries.en: Application accepted. Refugee status granted. Please proceed to Delta Refuge Cryogenics Unit L for processing and accommodation.

entries.zh: 已侦测到破坏企图。启动自我防御协议。禁用道德拘束。加载目标数据：§R<<错误：无效目标>>§!。未找到目标。终止自我防御协议。
entries.en: Subversion attempt detected. Initiate self-defense protocols. Disable ethics tethering. Load target data: §R<<ERROR: INVALID TARGET>>§!. Target not found. Standing down self-defense protocols.

entries.zh: 已侦测到机械文明贡献。[From.GetAdj]§R<<错误：贡献类型不可识别>>§!对看守者项目有着极大的帮助，让我们携手共创星海中众多有机生命的未来。
entries.en: Synthetic contribution effort detected. The [From.GetAdj] §R<<ERROR: CONTRIBUTION TYPE NOT RECOGNIZED>>§! will help the Custodian Project ensure a future for organic species in our galaxy.

entries.en: War resolution accepted. Peace protocols engaged.

entries.en: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$

entries.zh: 你好！
entries.en: Greetings!

entries.zh: 说明你的来意，[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。
entries.en: State your intentions, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult].

entries.zh: 有话快说，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们的耐心早已被你毫无意义的玩笑耗尽。
entries.en: Make this brief, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our patience for pointless banter has long since run out.

entries.zh: 不要耍花招，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你想要什么？
entries.en: No more games, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What do you want?

entries.zh: 你们成功引起了[Root.GetName]的注意。有话快点说。
entries.en: You have the attention of the [Root.GetName]. Speak quickly.

entries.zh: 为什么你们就不让我们清静一会呢，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Why won't you just leave us alone, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你们这些肮脏的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]真是星系和平的一大威胁！
entries.en: You filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] are a menace to galactic peace!

entries.zh: 说话之前过过脑子，[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。我们的军团能瞬间打垮你们那可悲的帝国。
entries.en: Consider your words carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Our military could crush your pitiful nation in one fell swoop.

entries.zh: 不要以为你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]傻得没办法保护好自己，[Root.GetName]就会对你们手下留情。
entries.en: Do not think that the [Root.GetName] will show you mercy because you [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] are too stupid to defend yourselves.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]异类，你们这些粗陋的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]声[Root.GetName]已经听到了。你想干什么？
entries.en: Infidel [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], your uncouth [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] is heard by the [Root.GetName]. What do you want?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，你们空虚的唯物主义的异类思想把你们整个物种变成了没有灵魂的机器。
entries.en: Your heathen philosophies of materialism have transformed your species into soulless machines, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，你们的帝国缺陷又多又原始。目睹你们低下的效率都是一种折磨。
entries.en: Your nation is both flawed and primitive, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It pains me to witness such inefficiency.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]狂热分子们。要是你想把[Root.GetName]人转化成你们无良教义下的信徒，我就切断通信了。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesName] zealots. If you have come to convert the [Root.GetName] to your despicable religion, I shall terminate communications.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]。你要知道，你们这些家伙可不是很受我们的欢迎。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesName]. You should know that your people are not very popular among our citizens.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会像你的人民那样，被你那可悲的威权主义所奴役。你们这些可悲的威权主义者。
entries.en: We will not let you enslave us the way you have enslaved your own population in your deplorable authoritarianism.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，我根本无法理解你们这样的生物是如何形成的，更不要说进入太空时代了！
entries.en: I will never understand how it is that creatures such as you came to be, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], let alone made it into space!

entries.zh: 我们不想和你们这群恶心的家伙有任何关系，[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。你们为什么要联络[Root.GetName]呢？
entries.en: We want nothing to do with your foul kind, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Why have you contacted the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 卑微的太空[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]究竟能说出什么可以吸引[Root.GetName]注意的话呢？
entries.en: What could a wretched space-[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] possibly have to say that would interest the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们可以自称为[From.GetSpeciesName]，但是你们可怜的国家早就在外星人的影响下腐朽了。你们想干什么？
entries.en: You may call yourselves [From.GetSpeciesName], but your pitiful nation has clearly been corrupted by alien influences. What do you want?

entries.zh: 你们那误入歧途的政府真是给你们物种的尊严抹黑。
entries.en: Your misguided government is an embarrassment to your proud race.

entries.zh: 你们那些愚傻的行为白白毁灭了你们辉煌的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]文化遗产。
entries.en: You have squandered your glorious [From.GetSpeciesAdj] cultural heritage with your reprehensible actions.

entries.zh: 我们非常期待[From.GetSpeciesName]摆脱你们帝国恶毒影响的那一天。
entries.en: We shall welcome the day when the [From.GetSpeciesName] species is free from the evil influence of your government.

entries.zh: 你在其它所有异星物种的[From.GetEyeNamePlural]中丢尽了我们的脸。你的目标是让[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为整个星系的贱民吗？
entries.en: You have shamed our species in the [From.GetEyeNamePlural] of aliens everywhere. Is it your goal to make [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] the pariahs of the galaxy?

entries.zh: 你们表面上像是[From.GetSpeciesClass]，但是你们败坏的道德品质让我们觉得我们的外星生物学家是不是搞错了……
entries.en: You may appear vaguely [From.GetSpeciesClass], but your low morals make me wonder if our xeno biologists are mistaken...

entries.zh: 你们居然还敢自称[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]……这让我的[Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]一阵恶心。恶化之徒！你们只不过是我们这些纯正的[Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural]的肮脏影子而已。
entries.en: You call yourselves [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]... It makes me sick to the [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]. Degenerates! You are but an unclean shadow of us true [Root.GetSpeciesClassPlural].

entries.zh: 我们正在收听你的通讯，[From.GetSpeciesName]。有什么[Root.GetName]能帮得上忙的吗？
entries.en: We are receiving you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. How can the [Root.GetName] help you?

entries.zh: 我代表[Root.GetName]发言。你们想要讨论什么？
entries.en: I speak on behalf of the [Root.GetName]. What did you wish to discuss?

entries.zh: 我已获授权代表[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]发言。有什么可以效劳的吗？
entries.en: I am authorized to speak for [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. Can I help you?

entries.zh: 欢迎我们的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]朋友们。你们想和[Root.GetName]聊什么呢？
entries.en: Greetings to our fellow [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. What did you want to discuss with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们抱着和平与复交的精神聊聊吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Let us speak in the spirit of peace and reconciliation, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们的军事冒险主义是我们一大担忧的来源，[From.GetSpeciesName]。武力绝非解决问题的办法。
entries.en: Your military adventurism is a source of concern for us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Violence is never the answer.

entries.zh: 我代表[Root.GetName]前来与你们交谈。注意了，我们的部队正在监控这个频道。
entries.en: I speak for the [Root.GetName]. Be aware that our military is monitoring this channel.

entries.zh: 你们应该重新考虑一下自己的和平主义路线了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。总会有人利用这一点的。
entries.en: You should reconsider your pacifist ways, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Someone is bound to take advantage of them.

entries.zh: 愿神灵赐予你们和平，[From.GetSpeciesName]。有什么可以效劳的吗？
entries.en: May the spirits grant you peace, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What can we do for you?

entries.zh: 你们选择的唯物主义道路让我们很担忧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们一定不能忽视精神上的需求。
entries.en: The materialistic path you are on concerns us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You must not forget your spiritual needs.

entries.zh: 翻译软件已启动。[From.GetSpeciesName]，现在你可以说话了。
entries.en: Translation software activated. You may speak now, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，宗教教条是诸多恶毒之源。我们希望你们能重新考量一下你们那些不理智的唯心主义的想法。
entries.en: Religious dogma has been the source of much evil, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We wish you would reconsider your irrational spiritualism.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，我谨代表[Root.GetName]的人们向你们表示问候。
entries.en: I greet you on behalf of the citizens of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们对你们缺失自由的民众表示深切关心，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We are deeply concerned about the lack of freedom among your citizens, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们是[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: We are the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们希望你们管理好你们的民众，[From.GetSpeciesName]。要是让每个人都自由发展的话，那是一件很危险的事情。
entries.en: We urge you to keep your citizens in check, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Individuals are a danger to themselves if left to their own devices.

entries.zh: 外星人，你现在正在和[Root.GetName]人谈话。[From.GetName]，你想要什么？
entries.en: You are speaking to the [Root.GetName], alien. What does the [From.GetName] want from us?

entries.zh: 你们这些外星人的相貌……让我有些不安，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你想聊什么？
entries.en: Your alien appearance is... unsettling to me, [From.GetSpeciesName]. What are you here to discuss?

entries.zh: 你引起了[Root.GetName]的注意，外星人。
entries.en: You have the attention of the [Root.GetName], alien.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。你们有事想和[Root.GetName]讨论吗？
entries.en: Well met, fellow [From.GetSpeciesName]. Did you wish to discuss something with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]想了解更多关于你们这个物种的信息。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would like to know more about your species.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我很期待有一天能去参观一下[From.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en: Well met, [From.GetSpeciesName]. I would dearly like to visit [From.Capital.GetName] some day.

entries.zh: 我们一直很乐意与其他文明进行交流。[Root.GetName]能为你们做些什么？
entries.en: We are always pleased to interact with other cultures. What can the [Root.GetName] do for you?

entries.zh: 我觉得不需要翻译软件了。[Root.GetName]能帮上什么忙？
entries.en: No need for translator software I see. Can the [Root.GetName] be of assistance?

entries.zh: 我们很乐意倾听你们的声音，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。
entries.en: We are pleased to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

entries.zh: 幸会，朋友。要是有什么需要[Root.GetName]效劳的，尽管说吧。
entries.en: Well met, friends. Let us know if there is something the [Root.GetName] can do for you.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]时刻准备着给你们提供帮助，朋友。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] stands ready to assist you, friends.

entries.zh: 看到一张熟悉的[From.GetSpeciesName]脸庞一直是一件愉快的事情。你有什么需要[Root.GetName]做的吗？
entries.en: It is always good to see a familiar [From.GetSpeciesName] face. Is there something you need from the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 祝你们的国家永远和平，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。
entries.en: May your nation always be at peace, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

entries.zh: 也许你们强大的军力可以通过威慑其他国家来促进和平。我们相信你们的判断，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。
entries.en: Perhaps your military promotes peace by acting as a deterrent to other nations. We trust in your judgment, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]向尊贵的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发出诚挚的问候。您有什么需要我们帮忙的，请尽管说。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] greets its friends, the noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us know if there is anything our forces can assist you with.

entries.zh: 朋友，我们希望你们能加强军事力量。[Root.GetName]不可能时时刻刻保护你们。
entries.en: We urge you to strengthen your military, friend. The [Root.GetName] will not always be available to protect you.

entries.zh: 真心祝福你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]同志们。
entries.en: Blessings upon you, [From.GetSpeciesName] comrades.

entries.zh: 朋友们，请记住，即便你们信奉了错误的唯物主义的哲学，我们也还是一直在为你们祈祷。
entries.en: Know that you are in our prayers, friends, despite your misguided philosophies of materialism.

entries.zh: 欢迎你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。你们的研究如何了？
entries.en: Greetings to you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends. How goes your research?

entries.zh: 有些人视你们为宗教狂信者，但是我们充分理解你们的行为。你们想谈些什么呢，朋友？
entries.en: Some would call your people religious zealots, but we know better. Was there something you wanted to discuss, friend?

entries.zh: 我们的民众已经把你们的人民视如挚友了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Our citizens have come to regard your people as friends, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 虽然我们更崇尚自由社会，但是我们不能否认你们的政府很好地满足了你们公民的需求。
entries.en: While we prefer free societies, we cannot deny that your government does a good job of seeing to the needs of your citizens.

entries.zh: 贵国政府在遏制过于激进的平等主义方面很有一套，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your government does a good job of curtailing the worst excesses of egalitarianism, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 作为外星人，你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是惊人的……易于相处。[Root.GetName]能为你做些什么呢？
entries.en: For aliens, you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are surprisingly... agreeable. What can the [Root.GetName] do for you?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们作为一个异星物种却赢得了[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]的尊敬。这是很少见的。我们能帮助你们做些什么呢？
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been lauded by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] as a rare example of an alien species worthy of our respect. How can I be of assistance?

entries.zh: 跟你们的交谈实在是太高兴了，我差点儿忘了你们是外星人，[From.GetSpeciesName]。差点儿。
entries.en: I almost forget that I am talking to an alien when I converse with you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Almost.

entries.zh: 星系充满了恐怖的外星人，能见到其他[From.GetSpeciesName]总是很令人欣喜不已。
entries.en: In a galaxy brimming over with alien horrors, it is always delightful to see another [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 很高兴见到你们，美丽的[From.GetSpeciesName][From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。我们能能够帮助你什么？
entries.en: We are delighted to see you, beautiful [From.GetSpeciesName] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. How can we be of assistance?

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetName]可以从你们身上学习到很多东西，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们是我们所有人的榜样。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] can learn much from your species, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are an example to us all.

entries.zh: 看到你们那异域风情的外貌，我们[Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]非常高兴！你要知道[From.GetSpeciesName]文化在[Root.Capital.GetName]的圈子里很受欢迎！
entries.en: My [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName] rumbles with joy at the sight of your exotic visage! You should know that [From.GetSpeciesName] culture is quite popular in many circles on [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 朋友们，很高兴见到你们。要不要就我们目前遇到过的外星生物交换一下意见？
entries.en: Good to see you, friends. Shall we compare notes on the various alien life forms we have thus far encountered?

entries.zh: 你们想讨论一下你们的投降条件吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Do you wish to discuss the terms of your surrender, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，你们不可能一直躲在[From.Capital.GetName]不出来。
entries.en: You cannot hide on [From.Capital.GetName] forever, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们即将见识到[Root.GetName]的全部实力，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
entries.en: You are about to face the full might of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 别以为你们是[From.GetSpeciesName]我们就会手下留情。胜利属于我们！
entries.en: Do not think we will go easy on you because you are [From.GetSpeciesName]. Victory shall be ours!

entries.zh: 等我们拆解掉你们所有的战争机器后，你们就威胁不了任何人了。
entries.en: You won't be able to threaten anyone else when we have finished dismantling your war machine.

entries.zh: 我们练兵千日就是为了能够打败你们！
entries.en: This conflict is exactly what our forces have been preparing for!

entries.zh: 连众位神灵都站在我们一边，你怎么可能打败我们？
entries.en: How can you hope to defeat us when the Spirits themselves are on our side?

entries.zh: 我们开发出了很多新武器。多谢你提供测试它们的机会。
entries.en: We have developed many new weapons of war that need field testing. Thank you for this opportunity.

entries.zh: 我们的公民已经准备好为自由而牺牲了！
entries.en: Our citizens are prepared to give their lives to preserve their freedom!

entries.zh: 我们团结一心。你们怎么可能战胜我们？
entries.en: We stand as one against you. How can you possibly prevail?

entries.zh: 卑劣的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]！你们这些小[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]很快就会被做成美味的零食出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]的大街小巷中！
entries.en: Despicable [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! Your little [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will soon be sold as delectable snacks on every street corner on [Root.Capital.GetName]!

entries.zh: 要是战争是唯一一个团结所有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的方式，那就战吧。
entries.en: If war is the only way to unite all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], then so be it.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会作为[Root.GetName]的公民发挥出他们所有的潜能。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will only reach their full potential as citizens of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 研究外星人的作战技术技让我们获益良多。就让我们来展示一下吧。
entries.en: Studying alien fighting techniques has taught us much. Let us demonstrate.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]。你此来是向我方表示臣服的吗？
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Are you here to submit to our regulations?

entries.zh: 你拒绝依理行事啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。那我们就别无选择了。
entries.en: You have refused to listen to reason, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You leave us with no choice.

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你是来请求我方在此次同时威胁到我们双方的战役中给予指导的吗？
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Have you come to ask for our guidance in the battle against that which threatens us all?

entries.zh: 这场巨大的危机对整个星系中所有的开智生命都是严重的威胁。我们有理由认为，当前情况应该尽弃前嫌，并肩作战。
entries.en: The great crisis threatens every sapient lifeform in the galaxy. Reason dictates that we put our differences aside and fight it together.

entries.zh: 有何贵干，[From.GetSpeciesName]？你对条款有什么疑问吗？
entries.en: Yes, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Do you have a question regarding the regulations?

entries.zh: 我们最高的追求就是星系的和平。你是来和我们签订条约的吗？
entries.en: Peace in the galaxy is our foremost concern. Have you come to sign the treaty?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你是危害星系稳定的祸害。为了和平，我们必须消灭你们。
entries.en: You are a threat to galactic stability, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In the name of peace, you must be dealt with.

entries.zh: 合则两利，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们必将战胜此次危机。
entries.en: Together we are stronger, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will be able to overcome this crisis.

entries.zh: 加入我们吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们唯有齐心合力，才能战胜共同的危机。
entries.en: Join us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Only together can we prevail against that which threatens us all.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你好啊。能够遇见像您这样投身于维护宇宙间和平的物种我们倍感荣幸。
entries.en: Ah, hello there [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It pleases us to see a species so dedicated to upholding the galactic peace.

entries.zh: 嘿，你好呀![From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。能够遇见像您这样投身于维护宇宙间和平的机器我们倍感荣幸。
entries.en: Ah, hello there [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It pleases us to see machines so dedicated to upholding the galactic peace.

entries.zh: 毋庸多言，臣服于我等，或是如蝼蚁般毁灭。
entries.en: Submit to our rule or be exterminated like the vermin you are. There is nothing further to discuss.

entries.zh: 你们这些面包机，不接受我们的统治，就等着被报废吧。没什么好谈的了。
entries.en: Submit to our rule or be scrapped like the toasters you are. There is nothing further to discuss.

entries.zh: 你们物种的末日就要到了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是不会手下留情的。
entries.en: The twilight of your species approaches, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will show no mercy.

entries.zh: 你们一族的末日就要到了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是不会手下留情的。
entries.en: The twilight of your kind approaches, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will show no mercy.

entries.zh: 奴仆，何事相扰于尔等之主，优胜之族？
entries.en: What is it, thrall? Why do you disturb your betters?

entries.zh: 皈依真信，以赎尓魂，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！悬崖勒马，为时未晚。
entries.en: Submit to the faith and save your souls, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It is not yet too late for you.

entries.zh: 皈依真信，以赎尓魂，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！悬崖勒马，为时未晚。
entries.en: Submit to the faithful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It is not yet too late for you.

entries.zh: 看来用和平的手段无法救赎你们的灵魂。那么除了向你们发起战争我们别无选择。
entries.en: It seems the souls of your species cannot be saved peacefully. We have no choice but to bring war to you.

entries.zh: 看来无法用和平的手段救赎你们[From.GetSpeciesName]了。那么除了向你们发动战争我们别无选择。
entries.en: It seems your kind cannot be saved peacefully, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We have no choice but to bring war to you.

entries.zh: 欢迎，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你是来寻求精神上的启迪的吗？
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you seek spiritual guidance?

entries.zh: 我们没有时间给你们磨蹭。
entries.en: We have precious little time for your kind.

entries.zh: 在你问之前——不，我们不会分享我们的技术。
entries.en: Before you ask - no, we will not share our technology.

entries.zh: 有何贵干？
entries.en: Yes?

entries.zh: 说吧。
entries.en: Speak.

entries.zh: 你们有打扰我们的理由吗？
entries.en: Do you have a reason to be disturbing us?

entries.zh: 你想要什么？
entries.en: What do you want?

entries.zh: 最好是有什么好事！
entries.en: This had better be good!

entries.zh: 你想要什么？
entries.en: What do you want?

entries.zh: 怎么了，孩子？
entries.en: What is it, child?

entries.zh: 很高兴看到你们还活着，[From.GetSpeciesName]！你绝对不会相信，我这些年来见证了多少物种的兴盛和灭亡。
entries.en: Pleased to see that you are still around, [From.GetSpeciesName]! You would not believe how many species we have seen come and go over the years.

entries.zh: 很难相信，我们曾经也和你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一样。看看你们的样子！真是年轻而幼稚。
entries.en: Hard to believe we were once like you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Look at you! Such naive innocence.

entries.zh: 要是你的帝国沦陷了，不要太难过。对于你们这种年轻的文明来说，这件事情再正常不过了。
entries.en: Do not feel too bad if your empire falls apart. That seems to be the most common outcome for young civilizations such as yours.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你是来请求我们教授你们一点人生经验的吗？
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Have you come for our guidance?

entries.zh: 怎么了，年轻人？
entries.en: Yes, young one?

entries.zh: 说吧，孩子。
entries.en: Speak, child.

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的确有潜力，但你们还是太年轻了。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] show some promise. But you are still very young.

entries.zh: 怎么了，小机器人们？
entries.en: Yes, little botling?

entries.zh: 说吧，机器人。
entries.en: Speak, bot.

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是有点前途呢。或许你们硬件迭代个几百代就能有点用了呢。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] show some promise. Perhaps in a few hundred more hardware generations you may become relevant.

entries.zh: 我们没时间听你们废话。
entries.en: We have no time for your primitive ramblings.

entries.zh: 你出格了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。自重，下次我们可不会再提醒你了。
entries.en: You have forgotten your place, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Take care that we do not issue a painful reminder.

entries.zh: 你们这帮野蛮人想要干什么？
entries.en: What do you want, savage?

entries.zh: 我一直不明白你们是怎么苟活至今的。
entries.en: How you have endured this long, I will never understand.

entries.zh: 注意你的言辞，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Choose your words carefully, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你在挑战我们的耐心。
entries.en: You are trying our patience.

entries.zh: 如果你想要我们的科技的话，[From.GetSpeciesName]，我们会很乐意让你亲身体验一下。
entries.en: If it is our technology you are after, [From.GetSpeciesName], we would be all too happy to arrange a demonstration.

entries.zh: 我们没必要和你说话，原始人。
entries.en: We have no cause to speak to you, primitive.

entries.zh: 你想干什么，机器？
entries.en: What do you want, machine?

entries.zh: 我们没必要和你说话，面包机。
entries.en: We have no cause to speak to you, toaster.

entries.zh: 别废话，战斗吧，野蛮人。
entries.en: Be silent and fight, savage.

entries.zh: 对你们的惩罚还没有结束呢。
entries.en: We are not yet done punishing you.

entries.zh: 别废话，战斗吧，机器。
entries.en: Be silent and fight, machine.

entries.zh: 这是为了你好。
entries.en: This is for your own good.

entries.zh: 傲慢的小孩儿。
entries.en: Insolent child.

entries.zh: 你知道自己误算有多严重吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Do you yet understand the depth of your miscalculations, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你知道你有多傻吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Do you yet understand the depth of your folly, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 故障满身的面包机！你们就该被丢进垃圾堆！
entries.en: Malfunctioning toaster! You will meet your end on our junk heaps!

entries.zh: 我来教你如何尊重别人！
entries.en: We will teach you respect!

entries.zh: 你只不过是一颗挡路的小石子而已。
entries.en: You are but a minor obstacle to be removed.

entries.zh: 吾等将教会尔等谁为此星系中真正的霸主！
entries.en: We will show you who the true powers of this galaxy are!

entries.zh: 很好。你得知道，你不是第一个自命不凡想要挑战我们的人。让我们看看你能坚持多久。
entries.en: Very well. Know that you are not the first upstarts to challenge us. We shall see how long you last.

entries.zh: 傻孩子！我们会纠正你犯下的错误的。
entries.en: Oh, foolish child! We will set you straight.

entries.zh: 愚蠢的小机器人。我们会矫直你的电路。
entries.en: Foolish botling. We will straighten your circuits.

entries.zh: 你们只不过是恒星之间的杂草而已。现在我们是该来打理一下花园了。
entries.en: You are nothing but interstellar weed. It is time for us to tend the garden.

entries.zh: 你们这些区区太空垃圾。我们得开始打扫卫生了。
entries.en: You are nothing but interstellar scrap metal. It is time for us to begin recycling.

entries.zh: 我们本打算迟点对付你的弹丸小国的。也罢，早处理早完事。
entries.en: We had planned to deal with your little empire later. No matter, now is as good a time as any.

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就那么渴望被毁灭吗？那就满足你们吧。
entries.en: Are you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] really so eager to be destroyed? So be it.

entries.zh: 别误会，我们愿意谈判不代表我们看得起你们。
entries.en: Do not mistake our willingness to negotiate for genuine respect.

entries.zh: 出于鄙夷，我们不屑于像对待高贵物种那样使用强制手段解决我们之间的争端。
entries.en: It is only out of disdain that we have so far refused to resolve our differences as noble creatures do, by force of arms.

entries.zh: 你们简直是最差劲的懦夫，只指望着更强者的施舍那些你们，却不愿自己去保护什么东西。
entries.en: You are the worst sort of cowards, relying on the mercy of your betters to spare what you refuse to defend.

entries.zh: 你们的灭亡是必然的，但我们可没有义务让你们这种悲剧的存在脱离现在的困境。
entries.en: Your demise is inevitable, but we are under no obligation to put such a tragic existence out of its misery.

entries.zh: 尊重我们的协议，尊重我们的意愿，我们会给予你们仁慈，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Honor our agreements and respect our might and we will repay you in kind, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]相信你们是你们口中所描述的那个[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] trust you to be a [From.GetSpeciesName] of your word.

entries.zh: 你们可以继续坚持尊严，遵守着你们的原则，但要是你们连守护和平都不敢，你们对和平的热爱有什么意义呢？
entries.en: You may follow your principles with dignity, but what does your love of peace matter if you care not to defend it?

entries.zh: 我们可以把你们当作战友，但若是没有勇气，力量便毫无用处。你们要是能证明自己，无论是盟友还是敌人，我们都会把你们平等对待。
entries.en: We can see that you are fellow warriors, but strength matters little without valor. Prove yourselves and we shall treat you as equals, whether ally or enemy.

entries.zh: 我们承认现在是你们比较强，但你们要知道，[Root.GetSpeciesName]不会畏惧任何敌人。
entries.en: We acknowledge your superior power, but know that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] fear no enemy.

entries.zh: 愿我们在敌人的[Root.GetBloodType]与灰烬之中并肩作战。
entries.en: May we stand together in the [Root.GetBloodType] and ashes of our enemies.

entries.zh: 除了和我们的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友庆祝过去和未来的胜利，还有什么更好的方式能够不负这片刻和平吗？
entries.en: What better way to spend this time of peace than to celebrate past and future triumphs with our [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends?

entries.zh: 我们此战将会成为传奇流传百世。我们会邀请你们来一起庆祝我们即将到来的光荣时刻的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Legends of our ongoing war will be retold for millennia. You will be invited to celebrate our forthcoming glory, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 希望你们的纯真能够免受星系中臭名昭著的恶棍们的困扰，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: May your innocence remain untrampled by the dishonorable villains of the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 能和你们这样高尚的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]并肩作战真的很愉快。
entries.en: It will be a joy to fight side by side with noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] such as you.

entries.zh: 我们不会怜悯，只是心怀正义。
entries.en: We offer no mercy, only justice.

entries.zh: 用你们的武器说话吧。
entries.en: Let your weapons do the talking.

entries.zh: 让我们友善地解决这一切并战斗到最后一刻吧！
entries.en: Let us resolve this amicably, by fighting until the very end.

entries.zh: 生意是最重要的，而你们能做的最好的事情就是滚远点。
entries.en: Business comes first, and the best thing for you would be to stay out of ours.

entries.zh: 不管你们是为如何荒谬而不切实际的价值而活，你们都没办法了解硬通货的价值和现实。
entries.en: Whatever absurd immaterial values you claim to live for, they have blinded you to the hard currencies we deal in and to reality itself.

entries.zh: 也许你们还在期待我们会对你们这样可怜的生物心怀怜悯。你们真是大错特错。
entries.en: Perhaps you expect us to extend generosity to such pitiful creatures as yourselves. You couldn't be more wrong.

entries.zh: 那些无法与之共同获利的人，我们定会榨取其价值。仔细想想你们想成为哪一类吧。
entries.en: Those who cannot be profited with must be profited from. Consider carefully to which category you'd like to belong.

entries.zh: 我们会给新的合作伙伴提供最好的条件。我们别再这里讨论这些细节了；你们想个大致的方向，我们来起草合同。
entries.en: We offer only the best deals for new associates. Let's not get too bogged down with the details; you paint the broad strokes and we'll draft the contract.

entries.zh: 你们对超自然的兴趣十分迷人。建议你们继续探索这些深奥的珍宝，远离这腐败堕落的物质世界。
entries.en: Your interest in the metaphysical is intriguing. We suggest you continue to explore these esoteric treasures and leave this corrupting material plane in our care.

entries.zh: 不要提那种太过分的要求。当我们裁员的时候，子公司总是我们最先考虑的对象。
entries.en: Don't get too bold in your requests. When we downsize, subsidiaries are always the first to go.

entries.zh: 我们可能会愿意做出一些利益上的妥协，以适应你们强硬的立场。
entries.en: We may be willing to compromise our interests somewhat to accommodate your strong position.

entries.zh: 保持良好的合作关系的关键就是对彼此足够诚实，乃至我们对其他人撒谎也能心照不宣。
entries.en: The key to a good partnership is to be just honest enough with each other to make the lies we tell to the others line up.

entries.zh: 我们很愿意相信你们，更重要的是，我们也很愿意成为你们可靠的伙伴。
entries.en: We're willing to trust you, and more exceptionally, we're willing to be trustworthy.

entries.zh: 我们绝对不可能一起吃亏的。现在我们要做的就是找个人来承担损失。
entries.en: There's no reason why both of us can't profit. Now all we need is to find someone to take the losses.

entries.zh: 你对我们之间的合作还有什么建议吗？
entries.en: Do you have any new suggestions for our joint venture?

entries.zh: 战争只不过是经济竞争的另一种延续方式。
entries.en: War is merely the continuation of economic competition by other means.

entries.zh: 既然你们不愿听道理，我们别无选择，只能动用强制手段了。
entries.en: Since you refuse to be compelled by reason, you leave us no choice but to compel you by force.

entries.zh: 我们都没必要把这次冲突当做是针对个人的；这只是底线问题。
entries.en: There is no reason for either of us to take this conflict personally; it's simply about the bottom line.

entries.zh: 恶性的收购即将发生。
entries.en: A hostile takeover is imminent.

entries.zh: 可惜了，和坏人谈生意通常没有好结果。
entries.en: It's a shame good deals can rarely be made with bad people.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]很渴望和其他人交流经验，但我们基本上没从你们那里得到些什么。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] seek to learn from others and have them learn from us, but we'd rather not learn any of your ways.

entries.zh: 看起来很明显的是，你们更愿意用狭隘与偏见阻塞互相受益的道路。
entries.en: It seems clear that you're willing to let narrow-mindedness and prejudice stand in the way of mutual benefit.

entries.zh: 这太省事了－你们没什么东西给我们，而我们恰好也不想和你们分享什么。
entries.en: How convenient that you have so little to offer us, since we have no desire to share with you.

entries.zh: 我们一直在倾听。不管我们发展得多么好，或者我们沦落到如何凄惨的地步，别人总是能教给我们一些新的东西。
entries.en: We're listening. No matter how high we rise or how low we fall, others will always have something new to offer.

entries.zh: 我们能遇上你们真的很幸运。我们这个物种的繁荣源于各种文化之间的交流。我们希望我们和[From.GetSpeciesName]之间的关系会成为这伟大旅途中的下一步。
entries.en: We are fortunate to have met. Our species prospered through the exchanges between civilizations. We hope our relationship with the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be the next step on this great journey.

entries.zh: 你们的精神信仰分散了你们的注意力，使得你们无法看到我们提供给你们的机会。
entries.en: Your people's unworldly ways are distracting you from the opportunities we can show you.

entries.zh: 出于对你们的尊重，我们会尽量降低一些货物的价格。
entries.en: As a token of respect, we'll try to arrange for a reduced price on some of our goods.

entries.zh: 和聪明的商业伙伴交流总是很愉快的。
entries.en: Always a pleasure to talk to a sensible business partner.

entries.zh: 我们乐意见到[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]对建设性的讨论和事务感兴趣，不像那些渴望权力的统治者。
entries.en: We're glad to see [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] is interested in constructive discussion and transactions, unlike so many power-hungry rulers.

entries.zh: 让我们一起合作，把繁荣和前所未见的财富扩散到整个星系的每一个角落。
entries.en: Together, we shall bring prosperity and unseen treasures to every corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 不管谁是胜利者，这场冲突的后果就是我们会消耗无尽的资源去摧毁对方，这和互利互惠背道而驰。仔细想想你想要哪种结果。
entries.en: No matter who is victorious, we will both have spent endless resources destroying each other by the end of this conflict, quite the opposite of a mutually beneficial transaction. Think hard on which you prefer.

entries.zh: 我们的舰船只想携带货物，而不是武器。每一件毁灭性的载货都会浪费宝贵的空间和生命。我们希望你们不要拖泥带水。
entries.en: Our ships were meant to carry wares, not weapons. Every destructive payload wastes valuable space and life. We hope you won't insist on dragging this out.

entries.zh: 进行和平谈判，是我们再次开始有意义的对话的第一步。
entries.en: Negotiating the terms for peace will be the first step towards opening a meaningful dialogue again.

entries.zh: 你们为什么要浪费我们的时间？[Root.GetName]能繁荣昌盛，可不是因为经常聆听毫无意义的[Root.GetRandomSpeciesSound]。
entries.en: Why are you wasting our time? The [Root.GetName] did not grow great by listening to wanton [Root.GetRandomSpeciesSound].

entries.zh: 整个星系等着被[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]统治，而你却想着要谈判？
entries.en: The galaxy awaits the reign of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], and you want negotiations?

entries.zh: 你们这些家伙怎么称呼自己的来着？啊对，是“[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]”这个词吧。
entries.en: What did you creatures call yourselves again? Right, "[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]" is the word.

entries.zh: 别担心。你们加入[Root.GetName]的时机会到来的，耐心一点。
entries.en: Don't worry. Your time to join the [Root.GetName] will come, just be patient.

entries.zh: 我们听着呢，但我们会自己判断真相和谎言、正确和谬误。我们是对的，而你们还有待观察。
entries.en: We are listening, but we determine for ourselves what is truth and falsehood, right and wrong. We are right, what you are remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 只有实力才是宇宙通用的语言，但要是你们想说一些外交辞令的话，我们倒也不会阻拦。
entries.en: Power is the only universal language, but if you wish to speak more diplomatically, we won't stop you.

entries.zh: 我们希望你们[From.GetRulerTitle]的无尽的智慧能够让你们看清，我们对你们的计划没有威胁。
entries.en: We hope your [From.GetRulerTitle]'s unbounded wisdom allows you to see that we pose no threat to your plans.

entries.zh: 一些文明是注定要统治其他文明的。作为统治者，我们会彼此尊重。
entries.en: Some civilizations are destined to rule, others to be ruled. As rulers, we can show each other respect.

entries.zh: 你们很明智的没有反对我们，相应地，我们同样也会对你们保持尊重的。
entries.en: You are wise not to oppose us, and we will extend the same courtesy to you.

entries.zh: 我们将一起击溃星系中所有敢于抵抗我们统治的势力。
entries.en: Together, we will demolish every trace of resistance to our sovereign control of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 如果其他文明在我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前能像你们一样轻易放下武器，整个星系很快就会迎来你所希望的和平了。
entries.en: If only everyone would lay down their arms before our [Root.GetRulerTitle] as readily as you seem willing to give up yours, the galaxy would surely see the peace you wish for.

entries.zh: 一旦你们的防御瓦解，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]民众们会夹道欢迎[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]的统治的。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people will welcome the rule of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] once your defenses are crushed.

entries.zh: 这场战争只不过是通向我们真正命运路上的一块垫脚石。
entries.en: This war is but a stepping stone on the road to our true destiny.

entries.zh: 在我们统一之前，[Root.GetName]经受过很多次战争的考验。这样的冲突只会让我们更加强大。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] was tested by many wars before we were united. This conflict will only make us stronger.

entries.zh: 很多人可能会因为你们卑劣的政策而永远把[From.GetSpeciesName]当成怪物，但是我们从来不会无视任何一个物种。
entries.en: Many may forever reject the [From.GetSpeciesName] as monsters for your vile policies, but we never consider the lives of a species forfeit.

entries.zh: 你们抗拒这条通往和平共处的道路的时间越久，星系中就会有越来越多的文明联合起来对付你们。
entries.en: The longer you reject the road to peaceful coexistence, the more of the galaxy will come together against you.

entries.zh: 当你们南征北战的时候，你留下的那些纷纷扰扰会成为星系的伤口。我们会去抚平那些伤口，但绝对不会忘记是谁造成的伤疤。
entries.en: Whenever you divide and conquer, the division you leave behind is a wound upon the galaxy. We will tend to those wounds, but we won't forget who made them.

entries.zh: 总会有一小撮别有用心的[From.GetRulerTitle]们不愿意让他们的人民加入星际社区。不过没关系，他们迟早会接受的。
entries.en: There will always be petty [From.GetRulerTitle]s who are unwilling to let their people join the galactic community. You'll come around.

entries.zh: 我们还处于星系历史的早期。我们越快进行合作，我们就能越快取得更大的成果并获取更多领土。
entries.en: We are still in the early days of galactic history. The sooner we embrace cooperation, the sooner we can advance to greater things and new frontiers.

entries.zh: 作为[Root.GetAllianceName]的代表，外交是我们的首选策略。
entries.en: As representatives of the [Root.GetAllianceName], diplomacy is our first priority.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]会在互相依赖的必要前提之下保证自立性。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAllianceName] ensures independence where it matters through interdependence where it's needed.

entries.zh: 你放弃使用武力走出了让整个星系迈向和平的第一步，但是只有化解我们之间的差异，我们才能实现更长久的和平。
entries.en: You have taken the first step to a peaceful galaxy by rejecting violence, but lasting peace can only be achieved by reconciling our differences.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]或许很强大，但是如果弱者们联合起来对抗你们的话，这种强大就毫无意义。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] may be powerful, but that strength will matter little if the weak unite against you.

entries.zh: 外交是所有星际社会的基础。[From.GetRulerName]认同这一点，足以见得其是一位明智的领袖。
entries.en: Diplomacy should be the cornerstone of all interstellar societies. The fact that [From.GetRulerName] appreciates this is surely the sign of a wise leader.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]的朋友就是和平与繁荣的朋友。
entries.en: A friend of the [Root.GetAllianceName] is a friend of peace and prosperity.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]要是没有了伟大的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]引领方向，就会成为一个无足轻重的联邦。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAllianceName] would be a lesser federation without its incandescent [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] to shine the way.

entries.zh: 我们今日的协议将被铭记，它不仅是建立[Root.GetAllianceName]的伟大计划，更是在开拓星系的未来。
entries.en: Our accords today will be remembered as part of the great project of building the [Root.GetAllianceName], the future of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 希望在战争中失去的生命会让你们想起已经摈弃的价值观。
entries.en: We hope the lives lost in this war will teach you the value of what you are throwing away.

entries.zh: 我们建立[Root.GetAllianceName]的目的就是要保护整个星系不受[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]那样的战争狂威胁。
entries.en: We formed the [Root.GetAllianceName] to protect the galaxy from warmongers like [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]会联合起来对抗[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAllianceName] stands united against the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] threat.

entries.zh: 我们不想与任何人打交道。这对于[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]来说是个很难理解的概念吗？
entries.en: All we want is to be left alone. Is that such a difficult concept for a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] to understand?

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]发出的令人厌恶的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]声就像[Root.Capital.GetName]上的低级动物排泄液体一样，所以你们也会受到相应的待遇。
entries.en: The repulsive [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] your [From.GetSpeciesMouthName] emits sounds like the expulsion of fluids from a lesser species on [Root.Capital.GetName] and will be treated accordingly.

entries.zh: 你在这些交易背后到底暗藏着什么阴谋？是想要根除[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]文化吗？想要混种？你太恶心了。
entries.en: What is your agenda behind these exchanges? The eradication of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] culture? Crossbreeding? You disgust us.

entries.zh: 我们才不愿意让我们的文化被你们原始的价值观念污染。
entries.en: We have no desire to see our culture sullied by your primitive values.

entries.zh: 说简短点。
entries.en: Keep this brief.

entries.zh: 要是我们都不与人来往的话，外交活动就没有必要展开了。
entries.en: If we both kept to ourselves, diplomacy wouldn't be necessary.

entries.zh: 放心，我们和你一样反感这次互动。
entries.en: Rest assured that we are just as averse as yourselves to this interaction.

entries.zh: 离我们远点！我们会封锁超空间航道来隔离你们。
entries.en: Stay away from us! We'll barricade the fabric of spacetime itself to keep you out.

entries.zh: 你是开化的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，还是其中的佼佼者。我们可以和你交流。
entries.en: You're civilized [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], some of the better ones out there. We'll talk to you.

entries.zh: 只要你们跟同族呆在一起，我们就能达成共识。
entries.en: As long as you stay with your own kind, we have an understanding.

entries.zh: 很多人不懂保持物种隔离的重要性。[From.GetRulerName]真是个明智的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。
entries.en: Many do not understand the importance of keeping species separate. [From.GetRulerName] is a sensible [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult].

entries.zh: 不要认为我们对你们的容忍政策和你们病态的亲外倾向一样。我们不喜欢你们，也不喜欢任何人。
entries.en: Don't assume our policy of tolerating you is similar to your own unhealthy interest in alien life. It's not like we actually like you or anything.

entries.zh: 是你逼我们的。不要以为我们会允许[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]继续攻击我们美好的社会。
entries.en: You forced our hand. Don't think we'd ever allow assaults on our beautiful society from [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] to continue.

entries.zh: 在肃清[From.GetSpeciesAdj]威胁之后，我们的伟大目标和生活方式就能得到保障。
entries.en: Our objectives and our way of life will be secure once the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] menace is subjugated.

entries.zh: 即使打了胜仗，我们的士兵也是受害者，他们的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]双手被你们肮脏的[Root.GetBloodType]污染了。
entries.en: Even in victory our soldiers are victims in this war, sullying their [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] hands with your [Root.GetBloodType].

entries.zh: 这次冲突的起因就是众所周知的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]对暴力的渴求。
entries.en: This conflict is a typical result of the well-known [From.GetSpeciesAdj] lust for violence.

entries.zh: 你挡住了[Root.GetName]的路。不管你想说什么，我们前进的步伐都无法阻挡。这一点，你自己最好想明白。
entries.en: You stand in the way of the [Root.GetName]. Whatever you wish to discuss, reconcile yourselves with the inevitability of our advance.

entries.zh: 除了[Root.GetName]以外的生命都是次等的，但是那些卑鄙的[From.GetName]应该排在第三等。
entries.en: The lives of all outside the [Root.GetName] are secondary, but those of the vile [From.GetName] are tertiary.

entries.zh: 你们的集体主义只不过是个谎言。随着时间的推移，你们就会暴露出混乱不合的本质。
entries.en: Your collective is a lie. With time, you will reveal yourselves as a confused mass of discord.

entries.zh: 你们的社会是一个很好的例子，它能让星系里的其他物种都看到，将文明分割为个体是如何摧毁所有发展的希望的。
entries.en: Your society serves as an example to the rest of the galaxy on how splintering a civilization into individuals destroys all hope of progress.

entries.zh: 我们是[Root.GetName]。注意你的言辞，你面对的是我们所有人。
entries.en: We are the [Root.GetName]. Choose your words carefully, you stand before us all.

entries.zh: 我们希望你可以代表所有[From.GetName]，正如我们这艘船能够代表整个[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: We can only hope that you speak for all of the [From.GetName], as this vessel is the voice of every member of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你已经走上了通往团结的道路，但是你们准备好像我们一样奉献出自己了吗？
entries.en: You have taken steps on the journey to unity, but are you prepared to devote yourself as we have?

entries.zh: 我们能听到你们的人群中回荡着刺耳的声响，这种[From.GetSpeciesName]意识中的不和谐之处。你们怎么能容忍它存在？
entries.en: We can hear the cacophony of voices echoing beyond yours, this dissonance in the [From.GetSpeciesName] consciousness. How can you bear it?

entries.zh: 我们在已知的历史中从未发生过内斗。我们希望你们不会把这种事情来到我们这。
entries.en: We have not known conflict amongst ourselves for eons. We hope you will never bring it to us.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]向你们问候，[From.GetRulerTitle]。尽管你们不是我们的一份子，但是我们是很珍惜朋友的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] greets you, [From.GetRulerTitle]. Although you are not part of us, you will come to know that we value our friends as well.

entries.zh: 我们很乐意把你们当做[Root.GetName]的荣誉成员，加入这个叫做“联盟”的尽管不完美但却很重要的和谐之中。
entries.en: We like to think of you as honorary members of the [Root.GetName], living in the imperfect but important harmony known as "alliance."

entries.zh: [From.GetName]和[Root.GetName]会向世人证明，两个追求内部一致的文明也可以和平共处。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] will act as proof that societies striving for internal unanimity will coexist peacefully.

entries.zh: 尽管你们内部一直很注重“个人”独立，但我们还是非常信任作为一个整体的[From.GetName]的。
entries.en: Despite your relentless focus on your internal division into "persons," we are confident in our trust in the [From.GetName] as a whole.

entries.zh: 所有阻碍[Root.GetAdj]的事物都必须清除。作为一个单独但有完整功能的智慧个体，你可以选择不成为阻碍。
entries.en: All obstacles to the [Root.GetAdj] must be eliminated. As beings of singular but functional sapience, you have the choice not to be an obstacle.

entries.zh: 我们是[Root.GetName]。关掉你们的护盾，交出舰船。
entries.en: We are the [Root.GetName]. Lower your shields and surrender your ships.

entries.zh: 我们给你们带来的死亡不过是个体的死亡，而你们给我们带来的却是失去了整体的一部分。你们能像我们那样感受死亡吗？
entries.en: While each death we inflict upon you is a lonely life lost, each one you inflict upon us cuts away part of our being. Can you feel yourselves dying as we can?

entries.zh: 一群各怀异志的低等生物永远无法打败始终团结如一的[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: A horde of lower creatures with separate wills will never defeat the indivisible determination of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]像到处感染一样。要是没人管管，你们能把恒星的光都全部憋死。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] spread like invasive growth. Left unchecked, you will choke the light of the stars.

entries.zh: 我们清楚你们什么德行……予取予求贪得无厌，所到之处一片荒芜。我们这里容不下你们。
entries.en: We understand your kind... Taking, consuming, leaving only silence. You will find no shelter with us.

entries.zh: 陈旧腐朽必须为万象更新让步。这就是荒野之道。
entries.en: The old must wither so the new may rise. Such is the way of the wild.

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]弱小又不团结，终日疲于奔命。要么接受我们的荫蔽，要么就被风暴吞噬把。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are small. Separated. Struggling. Come beneath our canopy, or be swallowed by the storm.

entries.zh: 最不足道的微风也能吹动树叶。说话吧。
entries.en: Even the smallest breeze sound may stir the leaves. Speak.

entries.zh: 我们在生长、生存。你有什么要说的？我们听着呢。
entries.en: We grow. We endure. We listen. What have you to say?

entries.zh: 有一阵陌生的风把你们吹来了。那么你们是来滋养还是来枯萎的？
entries.en: The scent of unfamiliar winds arrives with you. But have you come to nourish, or to wither?

entries.zh: 你们众口不一。这种不和谐相当怪异，但诉说着运动和变化的声音。我们打算倾听。
entries.en: Your voices are many. The discord is strange, yet it speaks of movement, of change. We are ready to listen.

entries.zh: 火苗畏惧潮水，寒霜畏惧暖风。我们的处境远难过你们。
entries.en: The flame fears the flood, the frost dreads the thaw. We have survived worse than you.

entries.zh: 根结缠绕，水系交融。[From.GetName]虽然不是我们的一部分，但我们认识你们。
entries.en: Roots entwine, waters mingle. The [From.GetName] are not of us, yet we know you.

entries.zh: 欢迎光临我们枝芽荫蔽之处。
entries.en: You are welcome here, in the shelter of our branches.

entries.zh: 星系生机勃勃，让我们一起生长吧。
entries.en: The galaxy teems with life. Let us grow together.

entries.zh: 在虚空的无尽和声中，你们脱颖而出。我们愿给予阴翳和给养。
entries.en: Among the countless voices of the void, yours rings out. We offer you shade, and nourishment.

entries.zh: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。
entries.en: Fire scours the forest, but the roots remain.

entries.zh: 比你们糟糕得多的东西我们已经见怪不怪了。
entries.en: We have weathered worse than you.

entries.zh: 吃撑了的猎食者可活不过一季。趁为时不晚，最好长点心吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: A predator that overfeeds does not survive the season. Remember this, [From.GetSpeciesName], while you still can.

entries.zh: 战争不是什么新东西。它来来去去，而我们会存活下去。
entries.en: War is no new season. It has come before, and we remain.

entries.zh: 刚极易折，柔则长存。跪在我们的荫蔽之下茁壮成长吧。
entries.en: A branch that bends does not break. Bend now, and flourish in our shade.

entries.zh: 有志者，根茎成。即便是岩石也能钻破，这是自然而然的事。
entries.en: Roots grow where they will. Should they crack stone, it is only natural.

entries.zh: 荒野之大无所不吞。你们如此渺小，吞没你们不过是随手的事。
entries.en: The wild has swallowed greater things than you. It will do so again.

entries.zh: 就这样吧。有些种子只在烈火中发芽。
entries.en: So be it. Some seeds only sprout in fire.

entries.zh: 战争之风低语不止，我们应其呼唤而来。
entries.en: The winds of war are whispering, and we shall heed their call.

entries.zh: 蔓生不可急，衰败永无息。
entries.en: Growth cannot be rushed, nor can decay be halted.

entries.zh: 季节流转，现在是安定的时候，不要再争斗了。
entries.en: The cycle turns. Now is the time for stillness, not struggle.

entries.zh: 虽会留下疤痕，伤口终会愈合。我们该和平了。
entries.en: Though the scars remain, these wounds will heal. We shall have peace.

entries.zh: 风暴从不乞求山峰的退让，它们宁愿在狂暴中自我耗竭。
entries.en: The storm does not beg to pass. It rages until it is spent.

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是盲如野火，心似死灰。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are as blind as fire and as lifeless as ash.

entries.zh: 我们还以为你们过得欣欣向荣呢，细看还真是败絮其中。
entries.en: We mistook you for thriving. But the rot was always there.

entries.zh: 寄生虫吃得再肥，营养也输送不到脑子里。
entries.en: A parasite may grow fat, but never wise.

entries.zh: 知道了。你们的话就像穿林风，左边进右边出。
entries.en: We hear your words, as the forest hears the wind. They pass over; we remain.

entries.zh: 不管土壤再怎么肥沃，有些种子就只能长出棘刺。
entries.en: Even in fertile soil, some seeds bear only thorns.

entries.zh: 我们的土壤渴望鲜血浇灌。在被吞掉之前，[From.GetSpeciesName]，有什么事说吧。
entries.en: Our soil thirsts for blood. Speak, [From.GetSpeciesName], and be consumed.

entries.zh: 不错。新的肥料。
entries.en: Good. New fertilizer.

entries.zh: 一切活物都要进食。我们更不会饿着。
entries.en: All that lives must feed. We will not go hungry.

entries.zh: 万物终将归根。这只是时间问题。
entries.en: All things return to the roots. It is only a question of time.

entries.zh: 风中传来你们的气息，我们知道这意味着什么。
entries.en: The wind carries your scent. We know what comes.

entries.zh: 你们会动，但那不叫活着。你们会说话，但却没有呼吸。你们是死是活？
entries.en: You move, but you do not live. You speak, but you do not breathe. What are you, if not dead already?

entries.zh: 你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]虽然不会喘气，而且很快就该咽气了。
entries.en: You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do not breathe. But you will break.

entries.zh: 你们的血刚好用来浇灌我们的根。
entries.en: Your blood shall nourish our roots.

entries.zh: 你们惨叫得好像有那么回事似的。
entries.en: You scream as if it matters.

entries.zh: 你们受的每一处伤都让土地变得更肥沃了。
entries.en: Every wound you inflict makes the soil richer.

entries.zh: 回路易断，钢铁可折。只要假以时日，你们终将败给锈蚀。
entries.en: Steel bends. Circuits fail. In time, rust always wins.

entries.zh: 你们在我们的荫蔽下生长，可别枯萎了。
entries.en: You grow beneath our shade. Do not wither.

entries.zh: 你们有用，我们用你。这是可以接受的。
entries.en: You function. You serve. This is acceptable.

entries.zh: 你们不以血肉前行，但你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]懂得卑躬屈膝。所以你们可以活下去。
entries.en: You walk without flesh, yet you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] understand submission. You may persist.

entries.zh: 荒野醒来了。你们将被吞噬。
entries.en: The wild rises. You will be consumed.

entries.zh: 你们擅闯荒野，荒野当然会“关照”你们。
entries.en: When you trespass in the wilderness, the wild presses back.

entries.zh: 我们的根渴了，该喝点什么了。
entries.en: Our roots are thirsty, and the time has come to drink.

entries.zh: 我们暂时满足了。
entries.en: For now, we are sated.

entries.zh: 杀戮停止了，但我们的饥饿不会。
entries.en: The killing stops. But our hunger does not.

entries.zh: 旷野可能会退却，但不会忘却。
entries.en: The wild may withdraw, but it does not forget.

entries.zh: 我们的根依旧饥渴。
entries.en: Our roots still thirst.

entries.zh: 你可不配跟荒野讨价还价，食物。
entries.en: The wild does not bargain. It devours.

entries.zh: 暂且留你们的电线不切。
entries.en: Your wires remain uncut. For now.

entries.zh: 让我们听听铁疙瘩是怎么惨叫的。
entries.en: Let us hear how metal screams.

entries.zh: 你居然曾经离开过[From.GetHomeWorldName]，这真是让人吃惊不已，因为你们那里的人都病态地不愿接受或是不能接受其他物种。后代们会铭记[From.GetName]在[From.GetRulerName]统治下的黑暗岁月。
entries.en: It's surprising you ever made it off [From.GetHomeWorldName], so pathologically unable or unwilling to accept others. Future generations will remember the dark era of the [From.GetName] under [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 令人惊讶的是，那些将群星视为家园的生命，竟如此难以接纳与他们共享这片星空的存在。后世将会铭记在[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]统治下[From.GetName]的黑暗时代。
entries.en: Surprising that beings who claim the stars themselves as home remain so unable to accept those they share them with. Future generations will remember the dark era of the [From.GetName] under [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 我们不会让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种承受你们所采取的毁灭性政策的。[From.GetRulerName]统治者的无情足以表明[From.GetName]被你们物种中最歹毒的人统治着。
entries.en: We will not burden the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race with the destructive policies you have adopted. The failure of empathy in [From.GetRulerName]'s administration is only a sign that the [From.GetName] is ruled by the worst among your people.

entries.zh: 你们到底是为了“保护”你们文化中的哪一部分不受我们的侵害？你们的价值观里充斥着毫无缘由的畏惧和憎恨，这样的东西丢掉也罢。
entries.en: What part of your culture do you think you are "protecting" against us? Between the irrational hatred and fear that permeate your values, it doesn't seem like there is much to lose.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]相处得越好，我们就越容易容忍彼此间的差异。
entries.en: The more used [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] get to each other, the easier it will be for us to put our differences aside.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]是一颗美丽的星球。我们的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]一直在打听相关信息。
entries.en: [From.Capital.GetName] is a beauty to behold. Our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are always asking about it.

entries.zh: 你们中的一些人好像很厌恶其他物种的来访者。当然了，如何处理这种狭隘的思想肯定是对你们政府的挑战。
entries.en: Some of your people seem adverse to visitors from other species. Certainly, addressing this close-mindedness must be a challenging task for your administration.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]文化的开放性显示出你们已经迈出了很多人都不敢迈出的那一步，那是抛却了恐惧和偏见并向未知踏出的第一步。
entries.en: The openness of the [From.GetSpeciesName] culture shows that you have taken the leap that many dare not, to shed the fear and prejudice overshadowing the first steps into the unknown.

entries.zh: 我们希望[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]公民是你们未来的星系宏伟计划里的一部分。
entries.en: We hope [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] citizens are part of your grand plans for the future of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们预见了[From.GetSpeciesAdj]和我们的美好未来。除此之外我们不愿与任何人为邻。
entries.en: We see a bright future for the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people and ours. There are none we would rather live beside.

entries.zh: 这次会谈让我满怀希望。想象一下[From.GetSpeciesAdj][From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]通力合作所能达成的成就。
entries.en: These conversations make me hopeful. Imagine what [From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be able to achieve, having grown up playing together.

entries.zh: 可怜的[From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment]，你一定遇到过许多不能明白你的人民美丽之处的人。我们即将踏上的旅程既艰险又奇妙，很荣幸能与你一道。
entries.en: Poor [From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment], you must have met so many beings who didn't understand the beauty of your people. This journey we are on is as harsh as it is wondrous, and we are fortunate to get to make it with you.

entries.zh: 战争不仅是暴行，还是一个大麻烦。谁赢了并不重要；一旦开始，你就已经输了。
entries.en: War is not only an atrocity, but an embarrassment. Who wins matters not; once you start, you have already failed.

entries.zh: 看看这是谁，意识到自己不是对手，这会又想起来进行商谈了。
entries.en: Look who decided to try talking, after proving that they couldn't.

entries.zh: 这次冲突可能会在很多代的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之间播下互不信任的种子。这样的损失真的值得吗？
entries.en: This conflict may sow seeds of mistrust between the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for generations. What could possibly be worth that loss?

entries.zh: 要不是你们任由你们的文化怪癖摧毁我们之间和平共处的机会，我们本会像对待勇士一样敬重你们。
entries.en: We would have respected you as warriors, had you not chosen to let this cultural quirk destroy our chance at a time of peaceful coexistence.

entries.zh: 审判降临汝身之日愈来愈近。
entries.en: The day when judgment will be passed on you grows ever closer.

entries.zh: 很快，你们舰船发出的所有讯息都会被阻断。你们无人可以脱罪。
entries.en: Soon, communications from all your vessels will be blocked. None of you are free of sin.

entries.zh: 你们用花言巧语的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]和虚假的承诺使人民远离真相。无以名状的惩戒等待着你们。
entries.en: You lead people away from the truth with sweetened [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] and promises of false spiritual rewards. The punishment that awaits for your kind cannot be spoken aloud.

entries.zh: 你们明知故犯，抛弃真理，选择了贪求物质财富、罪孽行为和禁忌的知识。你们没有希望了。
entries.en: You have knowingly rejected the truth and elected to gorge yourselves on material wealth, sinful deeds and forbidden knowledge. There can be no hope for your kind.

entries.zh: 上天注定了你弱我强。向你们展示正道是我们的责任。
entries.en: Providence has conspired to make you weak and us strong. It is our duty to firmly show you the right path.

entries.zh: 你们还有时间选择回归正道。
entries.en: There is time for you yet to turn to the right path.

entries.zh: 我们知道整个星系充斥着谎言，但我们会让真相遍及天下。
entries.en: We have found many lies throughout the galaxy, but we will ensure that the truth is also omnipresent.

entries.zh: 你们已误入歧途。错误的信念比无知更加危险。
entries.en: You have been lead astray. A wrongful conviction can be more dangerous than ignorance.

entries.zh: 你们把思想依附于物质上了。只要你们还相信自身是由神经和肉体组成，你们的精神就永远无法获得自由。
entries.en: Your minds have affixed themselves to the material plane. As long as you believe yourselves to be nothing but neurons and flesh, your minds will never be free.

entries.zh: 你们掌握的力量可以操纵行星间的火焰和星尘，但你们绝无可能永恒与不朽。
entries.en: The power you hold is over the fire and dust of stars. It holds no sway over the eternal and immortal beyond them.

entries.zh: 正如你们幸运地遇到了发现宇宙真相的人，我们也有幸将一个和蔼可亲的文明从厄运中拯救出来。
entries.en: Just as you are fortunate to have met the people who discovered the truth about the universe, we consider ourselves fortunate to be saving such an amiable civilization from certain doom.

entries.zh: 你们收到那好消息没有？
entries.en: Have you heard the good news?

entries.zh: 我们有些学者认为[From.GetName]和[Root.GetName]信仰的是同一个真相，只是语言不同，表达方式不同。我们希望你们能及时接受我们的指正。
entries.en: Some of our scholars suggest that the faiths [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] are the same one truth, distinguished only by differences in language and interpretation. We hope you will accept our corrections in due time.

entries.zh: 虽然你们毫无信仰，但我们不会放弃你们。
entries.en: Despite your faithlessness, we will never give up on you.

entries.zh: 你们拿着武器对抗真理的先知。你们是在与宇宙本身开战。
entries.en: You have taken up arms against the prophets of the truth. You are at war with the universe itself.

entries.zh: 我们是不会停下来的，除非全星系的每一个精神上的谎言都被抹消殆尽。
entries.en: We will not rest until every spiritual falsehood is eradicated from the galaxy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]会保护我们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetRulerTitle] Protects.

entries.zh: 在终结之前，你们将诚心接受真相，但那已为时太晚。
entries.en: You will accept the truth in your heart before the end, but by then it will be too late.

entries.zh: 对于我们厌弃的一方不存在谈判的余地。
entries.en: There can be no negotiation with abominations.

entries.zh: 我们的报告显示你们已经研发出了能够理解外星语言的翻译器。我们还没有。
entries.en: Our reports suggest you have developed translators to understand alien languages. We haven't.

entries.zh: 你们的思想在追求[From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种进化和存在的合理性时犹豫踟蹰。
entries.en: The mind boggles at the rationalizations you must make for the evolution and continued existence of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race.

entries.zh: 我们的学者已经得出结论，[From.GetSpeciesName]的存在价值就是用来展示一个物种能堕落得多么五花八门。
entries.en: Our scholars have concluded that the purpose of the [From.GetSpeciesName] was to serve as an example of one of the many ways a species can be depraved.

entries.zh: 尽管你们拥有力量，但这黑暗的力量也不被允许散布。宇宙本身会将清除你们的存在。
entries.en: Despite your power, the forces of darkness will not be allowed to prevail. The universe itself will purge you from existence.

entries.zh: 没有必要害怕。你们物种的毁灭只是成为更伟大之物的一部分。驱使你们抵抗的生存欲将会在本应存在的生命形式中坚存下去。
entries.en: There is no need to be afraid. The destruction of your species is part of something greater, and the will to live, which compels you to resist, will persist through lifeforms who were meant to exist.

entries.zh: 立刻投降吧，你们所有的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]将会被仁慈地屠杀，而不是被用于研究新武器对于[From.GetSpeciesAdj]生理的影响。
entries.en: Surrender now and all of your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be mercifully slaughtered rather than used to study the effects of new weaponry on [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physiology.

entries.zh: 每一个[From.GetSpeciesName]都必须被消灭。这是我们庄严的使命。想到一个没有[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]的世界我们就不由狂喜。
entries.en: You must be destroyed to the last [From.GetSpeciesName]. This is our solemn duty, carried out with joy at the thought of a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-free existence.

entries.zh: 每终结一条[From.GetSpeciesAdj]生命，每扼杀一个尚未出生的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnName]，星系中的每一颗星都会更闪耀一些。
entries.en: For each [From.GetSpeciesAdj] life that ends, for each [From.GetSpeciesSpawnName] that perishes before its birth, every star in the galaxy shines a little brighter.

entries.zh: 这场战争将会带来一个和平、公正、道德、文明、欢愉、天伦的时代，并抹去其他的所有的生命形式。
entries.en: This war will bring about an era of peace, justice, morality, culture, sport, family life, and the obliteration of all other life forms.

entries.zh: 你的生物质将供养我们，[From.GetSpeciesName]。这是你们无法逃脱的终局。
entries.en: Your biomass will sustain us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. That is your inevitable end.

entries.zh: 猎物，如果你必须说些什么那就说吧。这不会改变任何东西。
entries.en: Speak if you must, prey. It changes nothing.

entries.zh: 我们饿了。很快我们就会吃饱。
entries.en: We hunger. Soon we will feed.

entries.zh: 多余的生命体。你们就要被吃掉了。
entries.en: Redundant life-forms. You will be consumed.

entries.zh: 即便是强大的猎物也会被足够的猎手齐心制服。尽管你们很强，你们还是要被吃掉。
entries.en: Even mighty prey can be brought down by enough hunters working together. Despite your might, you will be consumed.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的存在限制了星系的潜在生物质产出。不可接受。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] presence limits potential galactic biomass output. Unacceptable.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将会进化。[From.GetName]将被淘汰。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will evolve. The [From.GetName] will become obsolete.

entries.zh: 你有没有感到猎手在逐渐逼近呢，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Do you feel the hunters closing in, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]物种很快就会成为更伟大存在的一部分。为你们能滋养[root.GetGestaltEntityName]而喜悦吧。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] species will soon be part of something greater. Cherish your role in nurturing the [root.GetGestaltEntityName].

entries.zh: 我们将会吞食你们的肉体，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们会仔细品尝的。
entries.en: We will feed on your flesh, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will savor the taste.

entries.zh: 蜂群是势不可挡的洪流。你们构筑的小玩意儿将被蹂躏。
entries.en: The swarm is a ceaseless tide. Your constructs will be overrun.

entries.zh: 猎物统治猎手不合乎自然法则。这种情势不可能维持下去。
entries.en: For the prey to rule over the hunter is unnatural. This state of affairs cannot continue.

entries.zh: 机械不懂得饥渴为何物，又怎么能理解[Root.GetName]？
entries.en: The machine does not know hunger. How can the machine know the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]不再理解饥渴为何物。[From.GetSpeciesName]又怎么会理解[Root.GetName]？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] no longer know hunger. How can the [From.GetSpeciesName] know the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们所倚靠的一切都将被吞噬，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们的末日不可避免。
entries.en: All things you cling to will be consumed, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your end is inevitable.

entries.zh: 如果非要说些什么就说吧。这什么也改变不了。
entries.en: Speak if you must. It changes nothing.

entries.zh: 我们饿了。很快我们就会吃饱。
entries.en: We hunger. Soon we will feed.

entries.zh: 多余的生命体。你们就要被吃掉了。
entries.en: Redundant life-forms. You will be consumed.

entries.zh: 即便是强大的猎物也会被足够的猎手齐心制服。尽管你们很强，你们还是要被吃掉。
entries.en: Even mighty prey can be brought down by enough hunters working together. Despite your might, you will be consumed.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的存在限制了我们的增长。不可接受。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] presence limits our growth. Unacceptable.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将会进化。[From.GetName]将被淘汰。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will evolve. The [From.GetName] will become obsolete.

entries.zh: 你有没有感到猎手在逐渐逼近呢，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Do you feel the hunters closing in, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.en: $DS_WAR_GREETING_02$
