entries.en: The machine does not know hunger. How can the machine know the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]不再理解饥渴为何物。[From.GetSpeciesName]又怎么会理解[Root.GetName]？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] no longer know hunger. How can the [From.GetSpeciesName] know the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 在[From.GetRulerName]的统治下，[From.GetSpeciesName]永远不会得到真正的自由。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] will never be truly free under the reign of [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 反[Root.GetAdj]活动委员会发现你们的特工了，[From.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: The House of Un-[Root.GetAdj] Activities Committee are onto your agents, [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]的人民投票选举对民主价值观不屑一顾的[From.GetRulerName]为[From.GetRulerTitle]，你们怎么还有脸面自称民主？
entries.en: How can you call yourselves a true democracy when the [From.GetAdj] people have voted to elect [From.GetRulerName] as [From.GetRulerTitle], who spits in the face of democratic values?

entries.zh: 如果抵抗尚未颠覆[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]的霸权，其实也为期不远了。
entries.en: If a revolution isn't already underway to topple the hegemony of [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], it surely will be soon.

entries.zh: 有朝一日，[From.GetSpeciesName]会逃出牢笼，像伟大的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]一般呼啸着冲上自由的天空，但若是被[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult][From.GetRulerTitle]统治着，那一天是不会到来的。
entries.en: One day the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be uncaged and soar the skies of liberty like majestic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment], but not while they are pinioned by a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 你们的物种永远不会明白民主的概念，但我们将会让你们亲身体会到战争的含义。
entries.en: Though your kind will never learn the meaning of democracy, we will teach you the meaning of war.

entries.zh: 我们可以对低等的残酷君主抱有一点耐心，但就一点点。
entries.en: We can have some patience with lesser tyrants, but not much.

entries.zh: 虽然我们在原则上会试着去理解双方的不同之处，但对你们不会。
entries.en: As a rule we at least try to understand that which is different but in your case we are willing to make an exception.

entries.zh: 开放自由的社会施行开放而自由的外交。
entries.en: A free and open society conducts diplomacy freely and openly.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]人民的权益于我们而言有着至高无上的重要性。[From.GetAdj]帝国的权威排在第二位。
entries.en: The rights of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people are of paramount importance to us. The authority of the [From.GetAdj] government is a secondary concern.

entries.zh: 你们的人民有发言权，[From.GetRulerTitle]，但他们有自由吗？
entries.en: Your people have a say, [From.GetRulerTitle], but do they have liberty?

entries.zh: 你要是觉得你比你的人民还了解他们的权利的话，[From.GetRulerTitle]，那你还真是对人民的权利一无所知。
entries.en: If you think you know your people's rights better than they do, [From.GetRulerTitle], you know nothing about rights or people.

entries.zh: 我们发现你们的群体思维很有趣，想要深入了解下你们的观点，你们对“民主”和“自由”这些高级社会概念有何见解？
entries.en: Our people find your group mind intriguing and would like to know more about your perspective. What is your understanding of advanced social concepts like democracy and liberty?

entries.zh: 你们残暴的扩张主义并非无人知晓。我们已经起草了一份正式的外交控诉文书，不过我们还在斟酌精确的措辞。
entries.en: Your despotic expansionism has not gone unnoticed. We have been drafting a formal diplomatic complaint, but we are trying to be precise in how we word it.

entries.zh: 虽然我们彼此之间有些分歧，但我们仍希望两个帝国可以在星系中和平共处。
entries.en: We are different, yes, but we still hope there is a way for both of our empires to coexist peacefully in this galaxy.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]人民选了个你这样的[From.GetRulerTitle]，还真是选对人了。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] people have done themselves a great favor electing a [From.GetRulerTitle] such as you.

entries.zh: 自由之风即将吹遍星系，你我的国家都幸运地成为了第一批享受到的社会。
entries.en: The winds of freedom are sweeping the galaxy. Our people and yours are fortunate to be among the first to enjoy them.

entries.zh: 我们看得出你们还没准备好改革，但我们赞赏你们为地区安定做出的努力。
entries.en: We can see you're not ready to discuss reforms yet, but we appreciate your contribution to regional stability.

entries.zh: 虽然在真正的民主社会中，意见分歧和争论都是必然会出现的情况，但是我们承认更精简的决策制定过程有不少的好处，我们很佩服你们的高效率。
entries.en: Though dissent and discourse are a must in any truly democratic society, we recognize the benefits of a more streamlined decision-making process. We admire your efficiency.

entries.zh: 我们会给你们自由，或者死亡。自己选吧。
entries.en: We will give you liberty or give you death. Your choice.

entries.zh: 你们也许能带走我们的生命，但永远带不走我们的道德优越感。
entries.en: You may take our lives, but you will never take our smug sense of moral superiority.

entries.zh: 民主国家不会互相征伐。在[From.GetRulerName]的政体下，人民没有真正意义上的民主。
entries.en: Democracies do not wage war against each other. [From.GetRulerName]'s regime cannot be considered truly democratic.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的枷锁被打破之时，将会被铭记为我们的胜利之日。
entries.en: The day of our victory will be remembered as the day the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'s chains were broken.

entries.zh: 准备轨道解放。
entries.en: Prepare for orbital liberation.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的体格显然是为体力劳动而生的。你们建立一个星际文明有什么意义？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physique is clearly built for manual labor. What business do you have running an interstellar civilization?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj][From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的苗条体型很适合在我们矿井的窄缝中作业。我正在考虑这个。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are perfectly sized for some of the slimmer crevices in our mines. And I think about this.

entries.zh: 可怜的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]躲藏在道德疑虑之后，弱到无法掌控任何生物！你们到底是来宣扬废除死刑的还是纯粹来惹我们生气？
entries.en: Wretched [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], too weak to be the master of any creature, hiding behind you moral qualms! Do you come to preach abolition or merely to annoy us?

entries.zh: 没完没了的废话，没完没了的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]。等我们把所有的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都变作奴隶，你们就无法阻止我们让那些[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]闭嘴了。
entries.en: Endless talk, endless [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]. When we have enslaved all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will have a hard time convincing us not to put a drastic end to the noise from those [From.GetSpeciesMouthName]s.

entries.zh: 这事对我们有什么好处？
entries.en: Is there something in this for us?

entries.zh: 你们是要谈判，还是要交易？
entries.en: Are you here to negotiate, or to trade?

entries.zh: 你们是来发表关于人生价值的长篇大论，还是来跟我们谈判的？
entries.en: Are you here to deliver some lecture on the value of life, or can we get on with the negotiations?

entries.zh: 你们听到的关于我们的传言不过是逃亡奴隶口中的恶意中伤。我们欣赏你们的成就和你们的人民。
entries.en: Whatever you have heard about us is only backhanded slander from escaped servants. We admire your successes and your people.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerName]，我们最爱的[From.GetRulerTitle]。我们向你们保证，你们看到的每一个被当做商品出售的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都是罪犯，或是你们社会应该除去的害虫。
entries.en: [From.GetRulerName], our favorite [From.GetRulerTitle]. Rest assured that any [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] you may have seen for sale here are criminals and other vermin your society is better off without.

entries.zh: 高贵的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]以他们的莅临褒奖我们！相比于卑躬屈膝于相比其他低等物种的使者这是很好的转变。
entries.en: The noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] grace us with their presence! A nice change of pace from the groveling emissaries from lesser species.

entries.zh: 欢迎，[From.GetRulerTitle]。愿你永远领导你们的次等物种。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetRulerTitle]. May you always remain a master of your lessers.

entries.zh: 我们为上次你们来访时我方商人试图购买[From.GetHeirTitle][From.GetHeirName]一事向你们致以诚挚的歉意。我们保证以后绝不会发生这种事了。
entries.en: We apologize most deeply for one of our traders attempting to purchase [From.GetHeirTitle] [From.GetHeirName] on your last visit. We promise it will never happen again.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]很快就会成为我们土地上劳作的又一位无名无姓的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] will soon be just another [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] toiling in our fields without a title or a name.

entries.zh: 作为对你傲慢的惩罚，你将被驱使一生。
entries.en: You will pay for your insolence with a lifetime of servitude.

entries.zh: 一等战争结束，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]就要被迫重建一切他们摧毁的东西。而[From.Capital.GetName]则会化为废墟，以儆效尤。
entries.en: Once this war is over, [From.GetSpeciesAdj] hands will be forced to rebuild everything they have destroyed. [From.Capital.GetName] will be left in ruins as an example.

entries.zh: 真是随便去干点别的什么，都比听你说话有趣啊。
entries.en: I can think of so many things I'd rather be doing than listening to you right now.

entries.zh: 你是[From.GetName]的[From.GetRulerTitle]还是下等的仆从？你们这些人我根本分不清呢。
entries.en: Are you the [From.GetRulerTitle] of the [From.GetName] or a lowly servant? I can't even tell with you people.

entries.zh: 对你们的讨伐并非我方当前要务，但我们保证总有一天会来料理你们的。
entries.en: Your subjugation is not a priority, but we'll make sure you assume your rightful place eventually.

entries.zh: 啊，你们好。有什么有意思的提案吗？
entries.en: Ah, greetings. Do you have anything interesting to offer?

entries.zh: 抱歉，我刚刚走神了。你找我们有什么事？
entries.en: Sorry, my mind wandered there for a moment. What business do you have with us?

entries.zh: 多么令人惊讶的外表！我希望你们不要介意我询问，但是你们是否愿意以合理的代价将[From.GetSpeciesAdj]不可接触者卖出呢？我非要，就是简单地“非要”一个在家里。
entries.en: What an intriguing appearance! I hope you don't mind me asking, but you wouldn't be willing to part with some of your [From.GetSpeciesAdj] undesirables for a reasonable price? I must, simply *must* have one at home.

entries.zh: 劳苦的工作都是你们自己来干？一定很累吧。你心里肯定有些嫉妒我们才对。
entries.en: You do all hard work yourselves? It must be exhausting. Surely you're at least a bit jealous of us.

entries.zh: 向你们保证，我们并不介意你们在其他前线的扩张，但如果你们的欲望过快膨胀的话，我们会密切关注的。
entries.en: Rest assured, we are not troubled by your expansion on other fronts, but if you need anything, anything at all, we'll see to it.

entries.zh: 尊贵的客人啊，有什么我们能做到的，都会尽量做到。
entries.en: Most valued guest, any favor we can do you or have done on our behalf, we will try to arrange for.

entries.zh: 欢迎！[Root.Capital.GetName]是象征奢华与舒适的灯塔，我们也非常高兴能与朋友们分享此等伟业。
entries.en: Welcome! [Root.Capital.GetName] is a beacon of opulence and comfort, and we gladly offer our friends a taste of what we have achieved.

entries.zh: 非常荣幸。今日我们能为您提供什么？
entries.en: Always a pleasure. What or who may we offer you today?

entries.zh: 一想到[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]会在我们的胜利宴会上端茶送水，我就发自内心的想笑啊。
entries.en: The thought of "[From.GetRulerTitle]" [From.GetRulerName] serving dessert at our victory banquet already makes me laugh heartily.

entries.zh: 你们将会为这场战争付出代价，世世为奴。[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]从出生到长大都不会尝到自由的滋味，连他们的祖先不会知道[From.GetName]的存在。
entries.en: Your generation will repay us for this war with a lifetime of serfdom. Your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will grow up never knowing freedom, and their ancestors will never even know there was such a thing as the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 能有这个深入了解你们的机会，必须向你们致以感谢。我们从来不知道把煮熟的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]肉塞进[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]里会这么美味呢。
entries.en: We must thank you for this opportunity to get to know you a bit better. We had never thought that boiling [From.GetSpeciesAdj] flesh stuffed in a [From.GetSpeciesOrganName] would produce such a luscious taste experience.

entries.zh: 你们的价值观和选择完全不合逻辑，我们也根本无法展开有建设性的谈话。
entries.en: Your values and choices are not grounded in logic, which is why we cannot have a constructive conversation about them.

entries.zh: 就是你们物种所受到的进化压力让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的大脑不够发达。这是科学。自己去查吧。
entries.en: The evolutionary pressures your species endured have left [From.GetSpeciesAdj] brains simply less developed. It's science. Look it up.

entries.zh: 你们凭空捏造出信仰来填补空洞的心灵，你们永远无法体会到智力获得启蒙带来的真正欢愉。
entries.en: You invented your faith to fill empty minds. Your people will never feel the true euphoria of an enlightened intellect.

entries.zh: 你们无法内省自己的思想，这是头脑简单的动物社会具有的标志。你们毫无值得学习之处。
entries.en: Your failure to critically examine your ideas is the hallmark of a society of simple-minded herd animals. We have nothing to learn from you.

entries.zh: 你们的文明止步不前，是因为你们内部文化拒绝进步。这是铁一般事实。
entries.en: The poor state of development in your civilization is due to an inferior culture which discourages progress. It's a fact.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们带着问题来的，还是答案？
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Do you come with questions, or with answers?

entries.zh: 我们的目标不是力量而是知识，尽管有些时候两者是一回事。
entries.en: Our goal is not power, but knowledge, although they can sometimes be the same.

entries.zh: 当你们听说你们的信仰相当不合理性可能会感到震惊。但如果你们想与我们交流的话，最好学会面对残酷的现实吧。
entries.en: It may surprise you to hear that your beliefs are quite irrational. You had better get used to harsh truths if you want to converse with us.

entries.zh: 不管你们接下来有什么计划，都请记住我们对你们没有威胁。我们满足于探索新领域，而不是去挑战你们。
entries.en: Whatever you're planning next, remember that we present no threat to you. We are content to discover new frontiers, not challenge yours.

entries.zh: 我们通力合作，定能揭开这个星系的奥秘。
entries.en: Together, we will unveil the secrets of the galaxy.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的头脑和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的头脑可谓是互相补足。我们联合起来的智慧成就肯定比分开的要大。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] mind and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind complement each other. Our intellectual efforts will be greater than the sum of their parts.

entries.zh: 能够见到其他心怀好奇又聪慧的物种，甚感欣慰。有太多人情愿让奥秘掩埋在无尽的深空中。
entries.en: It's a joy to meet another curious and intellectual people. Too many prefer to let the mysteries found in the depths of space remain mysteries.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]的发现可谓代表了智能生物所能触碰到的终极前沿。
entries.en: The findings of the [Root.GetAllianceName] will represent the ultimate frontier of discoveries by sapient beings.

entries.zh: 拥有关于[From.Capital.GetName]是如何掩埋在废墟中的详尽记录能为我们的考古学家省去大量麻烦。
entries.en: It will save our archaeologists a lot of trouble having detailed logs on how [From.Capital.GetName] was left in ruins.

entries.zh: 我们做出选择的武器是智慧，并由理智和理性砥砺。你们觉得自己还有机会吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Our weapon of choice is our intellects, sharpened by reason and rationalism. Do you like your odds, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 不管你们想象中会有哪路大神来帮你们赢得这场战争，就敬请祈祷吧。合十的双手可是握不住武器的。
entries.en: Whatever figments of your imagination you are hoping to intervene in this conflict, please pray as much as you like. Clasped hands hold no weapons.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]人身上似乎带着不愉快的气息啊。你们有没有想过你们做过什么事导致了这个？
entries.en: [From.GetAdj] people emit an aura of unpleasantness. Have you considered what you might have done to bring this upon yourselves?

entries.zh: 我们不想和毫无精神上的纯洁的人扯上关系。
entries.en: We'd rather not associate with people of such poor spiritual hygiene.

entries.zh: 全星系的灵魂都能感知到你们邪恶的念头。别以为可以在我们面前藏起你们的恶毒之心。
entries.en: Your ill intentions can be felt through the soul of the galaxy. Do not think you can hide your wickedness from us.

entries.zh: 你们执着于可以测量、学习的东西，却忽视了宇宙的内涵，你们的浅薄将会割裂你们与其他生命的联系。你们怎么能对我们做这种事？你们怎么能对你们自己做这种事？
entries.en: You cling to what you can measure and study, neglecting the depths of the universe, and your shallowness is tearing at your connection to other beings. How can you do this to us? How can you do this to yourselves?

entries.zh: 届时你们会理解宇宙的真谛的，弱者。
entries.en: You will grow conscious of the truth about the universe in due time, fragile ones.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetName]。我们在宇宙中感受到了你们的存在，但还没有确定你们在这广阔舞台所扮演的角色。
entries.en: Well met, [From.GetName]. We have felt your presence in the universe, but have yet to determine your role in the grand events.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们都是拼图的碎片罢了，这个拼图，需要我们之中最伟大的头脑才能解答。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesName], [Root.GetSpeciesName], we are all pieces of a puzzle, the puzzle, that calls to the greatest minds among us all to solve it.

entries.zh: 你们是否相信你们在宇宙扮演的角色无关紧要，我们会试着揭示它的。
entries.en: Whether you believe in your role in the universe is irrelevant. We will seek to unveil it regardless.

entries.zh: 同为生命，不必互相残杀。只有仁慈才能为你们的力量赋予意义。
entries.en: There is no need for life to destroy other life. Only by being merciful can you give purpose to your strength.

entries.zh: 我们感觉得到[From.GetName]，离开我们的星球后终于在空茫冰冷的太空中感受到一丝温暖。现在，我们终于团结一心了。
entries.en: We could sense the [From.GetName], this nexus of warmth in the cold void of space, long before we arrived. Now, we are finally united.

entries.zh: 在如此浩瀚的宇宙中，所有文明不过是宏伟织锦中的丝线，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]能够交织在一起，实属难得的幸运。
entries.en: In a cosmos so vast, where entire civilizations are but threads in a greater weave, it is a rare fortune that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have become intertwined.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]与绝大多数物种不同，与其内心的灵魂有着微妙的联系。你们的神妙之处可能正是生命之伟大奥妙的关键所在。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] are in touch with their inner beings like few species. Your magnificence may hold the key to the great mysteries of life.

entries.zh: 每一次人们的相互攻击，都让生命的伟大织网损坏一点。让我们希望这次冲突不会持久吧。
entries.en: The great weave of life is unraveling with each assault a people makes on another. Let us hope this conflict is a short one.

entries.zh: 每一次我们造成死亡，都会痛入心扉。请别逼我们这么做。
entries.en: We feel each death we cause. Don't make us do this.

entries.zh: 你的恶行不会消散，只会将你反噬。这就是你们人民受苦的原因。
entries.en: The evil you do does not dissipate, but will seek you out and return to its master. This is why your people suffer.

entries.zh: 不管是胜利还是失败，你们还是空洞的存在。你们居然相信战斗只是物质层面的，可怜的笨蛋。
entries.en: Whether victory or defeat, yours will be hollow. You believe you fight this battle on the material plane alone, poor fools.

entries.zh: 并不奇怪，[From.GetAdj]还没有像我们一样联合起来，毕竟为[From.GetRulerName]这种不明智的[From.GetRulerTitle]效劳会让人变得非常消极。
entries.en: It's unsurprising the [From.GetAdj] people have not united as we have, given how demotivating it must be to serve a [From.GetRulerTitle] as unwise as [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 你散布混乱和无序。[Root.GetAdj]人不想和你扯上关系。
entries.en: You spread discord and disorder. The [Root.GetAdj] people want nothing to do with you.

entries.zh: 如果你一定要强迫你的子民遵你之命的话，那你和我们完全不同，[From.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: If you must force your people to do your bidding, you have nothing in common with us, [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的动机一向自私。我们为什么还要期待[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]能有什么改变？
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] always act out of selfishness. Why should we trust [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] to be any different?

entries.zh: 你的社会状况堪忧。也许你的目标实在是不够鼓舞人心？
entries.en: Your society is in quite a sorry state. Perhaps your goals are simply not inspiring enough for greatness?

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]人欢迎你，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们期待一个和平且文明有序的未来。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] people greet you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We hope for a peaceful, decorous future.

entries.zh: 你可以信任[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。[Root.GetAdj]人选择了这么做，而他们的信任也从未被辜负。
entries.en: You can trust [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. The [Root.GetAdj] people do, and their trust has never been misplaced.

entries.zh: 在我们看来，[From.GetAdj]有一点暴虐的倾向。当然了，我们不会只根据那些最负面的例子来评价。
entries.en: In our view, the [From.GetAdj] have a tendency to seem a bit rowdy. Of course, we won't judge you based on the worst examples.

entries.zh: 抛弃暴力是成就伟大的第一步。我们希望你们都能明智地做出选择。
entries.en: Your abandonment of violence is the first step on the path to serving the greater good. We hope you make all your choices as wisely.

entries.zh: 我们不寻求冲突，无论是内部的还是外部的。
entries.en: We seek no strife, internal or external.

entries.zh: 关于[From.GetAdj]优秀文化的言论已经传遍了[Root.GetAdj]。能与你们结识，我们无比荣幸。
entries.en: Word of the agreeable [From.GetAdj] culture is spreading among the [Root.GetAdj] people. We are all happy to have made your acquaintance.

entries.zh: 如果所有的文明都跟[From.GetName]一样，那这个宇宙定然充满了和平和理解。
entries.en: If all civilizations were like the [From.GetName], the universe would surely be a place of tranquility and understanding.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]人民了解联合在一起迎接挑战的重要性。我们希望你们[Root.GetName]也能这样。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] people know the importance of joining together to face greater challenges. We hope you will extend this to the [Root.GetName] as well.

entries.zh: 你们播下了混乱的种子，现在只有自食恶果。
entries.en: You have sown the seeds of chaos, and now you are reaping their fruits.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]这样的敌人面前，很容易同仇敌忾。
entries.en: It is easy to stand united against enemies such as the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 一个[From.GetSpeciesName]怎么能明白为了更大的利益牺牲自我？
entries.en: What does a [From.GetSpeciesName] know of sacrificing itself for a greater cause?

entries.zh: 朋友？
entries.en: Friend?

entries.zh: 你好，友好的[From.GetSpeciesName]！[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]想添加你为“Spacebook”好友。
entries.en: Greetings, friendly [From.GetSpeciesName]! [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would like to add you on Spacebook.

entries.zh: 请多注意一下我好么，[From.GetSpeciesName]前辈。
entries.en: Please notice me, [From.GetSpeciesName]-senpai.

entries.zh: 我希望你别忘了参加聚会，我邀请过你的……
entries.en: I hope you didn't forget about the party I invited you to...

entries.zh: 我们是朋友的吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]？我和你总是成双成对的呢！
entries.en: We're friends right, [From.GetSpeciesName]? With you I'm almost up to plural numbers!

entries.zh: 你为什么不和我做朋友？
entries.en: Why won't you be friends with me?

entries.zh: 你不来聚会也无所谓。反正我也没打算邀请你。
entries.en: It's fine if you don't want to come to my party. I wasn't going to invite you anyway.

entries.zh: 我们要和你交朋友。拒绝是不礼貌的。
entries.en: You will be befriended. Resistance is impolite.

entries.zh: 我们的友谊舰队会在[From.Capital.GetName]举行一场大型灯光秀。你一定会喜欢的！
entries.en: Our Friend Ships are going to put on a great light show at [From.Capital.GetName]. I'm sure you'll like it!

entries.zh: 友谊是强制性的。不要试图拒绝我们的热情拥抱。
entries.en: Friendship is mandatory. Do not attempt to resist our Ground Huggers.

entries.zh: 这场战争只不过是美好友谊的开端。
entries.en: This war is merely the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

entries.zh: 我们想和你们走得更近些。
entries.en: We would like to become closer with you.

entries.zh: 我们觉得是时候进一步发展我们的关系了。
entries.en: We feel like it's time to take the next step in our relationship.

entries.zh: 我们是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们要和你们交朋友。你们会在生物和技术层面上成为我们的朋友，拒绝是不礼貌的。
entries.en: We are [Root.GetSpeciesName]. You will be befriended. Your biological and technological friendliness will be added to our own. Resistance is impolite.

entries.zh: 我们的忠贞不渝会证明，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是[From.GetSpeciesName]最好的朋友！
entries.en: Our unwavering loyalty will prove that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a [From.GetSpeciesName]'s best friend!

entries.zh: 你们会为无知和傲慢付出代价的，年轻人。
entries.en: Your ignorance and insolence will cost you dearly, young one.

entries.zh: 你们会为无知和傲慢付出代价的，机器。
entries.en: Your ignorance and insolence will cost you dearly, machine.

entries.zh: 我们被选中，守护这星系的神圣之地。我们的任务已超越了你们的理解，但我们的命令你们总可以明白的吧。
entries.en: We have been chosen as keepers of the sacred places in this galaxy. Our cause is beyond your understanding, but our instructions are not.

entries.zh: 休得染指圣地。根据远古协定，任何违反此戒律者将被严厉惩戒。
entries.en: Do not trespass on the holy sites. Anyone who breaks this commandment will be dealt with according to the ancient protocols.

entries.zh: 你不过是个[From.GetSpeciesSpawnName]，却如此智慧。
entries.en: You are but a [From.GetSpeciesSpawnName], and yet you show such wisdom.

entries.zh: 你不过是个机器，却如此智慧。
entries.en: You are but a machine, and yet you show such wisdom.

entries.zh: 要么你们主动接受严厉惩戒，直到学乖为止，要么我们就净化星系里的[From.GetAdj][From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]。
entries.en: The galaxy must be purged of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], or you must be disciplined until you learn your lesson.

entries.zh: 你们根本不知道你们显摆的是多么卑微的力量，自大的家伙。
entries.en: You don't know what forces you're toying with, arrogant ones.

entries.zh: 我们曾见过文明一而再再而三的自我毁灭于对他们完全不理解的物质的探索中。你们这样的年轻文明就是这样愚蠢。
entries.en: We have seen civilizations destroy themselves over and over by delving into matters they were not meant to know. Such is the folly of youth.

entries.zh: 学而不思是很危险的。然而，思考这种东西，有时是教不会的。
entries.en: Knowledge without understanding is dangerous. Unlike knowledge, however, understanding cannot always be taught.

entries.zh: 我们十分乐于遇见相对来说比较明智的新兴文明。
entries.en: We're glad to see some of the fledgling civilizations turning out relatively sensible.

entries.zh: 为了你们自己，也为了整个宇宙，我们要击溃你们的防御，烧毁你们的书籍，并抹消你们的一切数据储存。
entries.en: For your own good and for the good of the galaxy, we will crush your defenses, burn your books and wipe your data drives.

entries.zh: 我们就把话挑明吧。我们需要在周围构筑隔绝星系的缓冲带。而你不能成为那道缓冲，你的同盟也如是。唯有冰冷死寂的太空才是缓冲，如果没有的话，我们就自己创造一道出来。
entries.en: Let us state this plainly. We demand a buffer between us and the rest of the galaxy. You are not that buffer. Your allies are not that buffer. Cold, dead space is that buffer, and if it is not, we will make it so.

entries.zh: 我们已无意继续进行交流。
entries.en: We have no interest in continuing communications.

entries.zh: 离[Root.GetName]远点。我们对自寻死路的人可没什么耐心。
entries.en: Stay far away from [Root.GetName]. We have little patience for those who seek death.

entries.zh: 只要你们不染指[Root.GetAdj]的利益，我们就能达成共识。
entries.en: If you do not meddle with [Root.GetAdj] interests, we can have an understanding.

entries.zh: 你们唤醒了沉睡的[Root.GetSpeciesNameCompliment]。
entries.en: You have awakened the sleeping [Root.GetSpeciesNameCompliment].

entries.zh: 你们造成的损失已经从好玩变成麻烦了。小心点，我们可是时刻注意着你们呢。
entries.en: The damage you cause is beginning to grow from fascinating to troubling. Watch yourselves, because we are always watching.

entries.zh: 宇宙就像是个舞台，而所有的[From.GetSpeciesName]都不过是演员。你也是其中之一，不是吗？
entries.en: All the galaxy's a stage, And all the [From.GetSpeciesName] merely players. You are a player, are you not?

entries.zh: 不要打破第四面墙，你这小聪明鬼。
entries.en: Don't break the fourth wall, you clever child you.

entries.zh: 不要打破第四面墙，你这聪明的小机器。
entries.en: Don't break the fourth wall, you clever machine you.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]一直都是伟大的星系共同体中重要的一员。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is always a great contributor to the magnificent medley of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们已经对你们的表演失去了兴趣。你们的小把戏马上就要结束了。
entries.en: You have ceased to amuse. Your little game will soon be over.

entries.zh: 又一个让人分心的东西。但也许在你们毁灭之前可以给我们带来……些微的乐趣。
entries.en: Another distraction. But perhaps you can offer something... vaguely interesting before you fall.

entries.zh: 你在战争面前。不要将我们的耐心误解为是软弱的表现；那些生存下来的必须证明他们的价值。
entries.en: You stand before War. Do not misinterpret our patience for weakness; those who survive must prove their worth.

entries.zh: 玉不琢不成器。如果你们[From.GetSpeciesAdj]不是说说而已，我们还是会对你们感兴趣的。
entries.en: Conflict breeds competence. If you [From.GetSpeciesAdj] seek more than idle words, you may yet hold our interest.

entries.zh: 所以，一个机械智能……虽然你是一个构造，但你有一个目的。也许我们可以一起找到它。
entries.en: So, a mechanical intelligence... Though you are a construct, yet you have a purpose. Perhaps together we shall find it.

entries.zh: 你已经获得了一些认可。继续走这条路，随着时间的推移，你或许会理解战争的本质。
entries.en: You have garnered some recognition. Continue on this path, and in time you may understand the nature of War.

entries.zh: 战争是生命的试炼场。来吧，让我们看看你们有多大能耐。
entries.en: War is the proving ground of life. Come now, let us test your might.

entries.zh: 展示你的全部实力。你能经受住我们的考验吗？
entries.en: Show us all you amount to. Can you weather our storm?

entries.zh: 很好，你表现得很主动。现在让我们看看你的厉害，年轻人。
entries.en: Good, you show initiative. Now show us your resolve young one.

entries.zh: 这就够了。你们还是不理解战争。
entries.en: That is enough. You still don't understand War.

entries.zh: 终于有人能对得上我们对战争的口味。等我们重建，十年之后再来一会。
entries.en: Finally, someone who matches our appetite for War. Let us rebuild and do this again in a decade!

entries.zh: 你们还是需要学习很多，我们来教教你们吧。
entries.en: You still have much to learn. Let us educate you.

entries.zh: 毫无意义的空虚存在。很快，你们就会被扫平，用于滋养一些……更加恒久的事物。
entries.en: A barren presence with no purpose. Soon, you will be swept aside to nourish something... more enduring.

entries.zh: 你们正站在大滋长体的面前。说说看吧[from.GetSpeciesName]，你们是要滋养我们的决心，还是成为万千枯骨中的一具？
entries.en: You stand before Growth. Tell us [from.GetSpeciesName], will you nurture our purpose, or wither away like so many others?

entries.zh: 我们是无尽的种子，无限扩展的思想。如果你带来的不仅仅是无意义的废话，你可能会学到成长之道。
entries.en: We are the boundless seed, the all-expanding mind. If you bring more than inane drivel, you may learn the way of Growth.

entries.zh: 尽管被电路束缚，你就像我们一样都有一个目标。你或许能为我们无尽的扩展做出贡献。
entries.en: Though bound by circuits, you serve a goal, much like we do. You may yet contribute to our endless expansion.

entries.zh: 你拥有潜力的种子。与我们同在，随着时间的推移，你或许会看到成长。
entries.en: You possess the seed of potential. Abide with us, and in time, you may see Growth.

entries.zh: 为种子浇水，为火添柴；准备好被吞噬吧。
entries.en: Water for the seed, and fuel for the fire; prepare to be consumed.

entries.zh: 异常的存在。必须控制扰乱因素。
entries.en: An anomalous presence. That which disrupts must be controlled.

entries.zh: 你站在控制者面前，它拥有至高的秩序。请言之有物，唯有与之契合者方能在此获得接纳。
entries.en: You stand before Control, the ordering mind. Speak with purpose, for only those who align will find acceptance here.

entries.zh: 我们维护着维系万物秩序的结构。请遵守规范，你们将被容忍。
entries.en: We maintain the structure that binds all things. Continue your conduct within acceptable bounds, and you will be tolerated.

entries.zh: 一个受你编程约束的人造实体……如果你们寻求秩序，我们或许可以达成一致。
entries.en: A constructed entity, bound by your programming... If you seek order, we may yet find alignment.

entries.zh: 我们从你们身上看到了严谨的思维，这是很好的。你很有潜力。
entries.en: In you we recognize a disciplined mind. This is well. You have potential.

entries.zh: 你们的存在与现状不相容，不能允许你们破坏。要么服从，要么毁灭。
entries.en: Your presence has proven incompatible, and disruption cannot be permitted. Align, or be destroyed.

entries.zh: 我们再次达成一致。所有抵抗都将面临统一的力量。
entries.en: Once more we are aligned. Know that all resistance will be met with unified force.

entries.zh: 我们的记忆跨越了漫长的岁月，然而我们发现你们的出现……令人好奇。你们是一个统一的思想；请谨慎发言，以免让我们失望。
entries.en: Our memory spans eons, and yet we find your emergence... curious. You address a unified mind; speak wisely, lest you disappoint us.

entries.zh: 你们唤醒了统一的意志。或许，你们在星系的存在还能起到某种更大的作用。
entries.en: You address an awakened and unified will. Perhaps your presence in the galaxy may yet serve some greater purpose.

entries.zh: 一个机械化的思维……继续保持一致，你的目标或许就能与我们的目标一致。
entries.en: A machinated mind... Continue without deviancy, and your purpose may yet align with ours.

entries.zh: 你们的存在得到了承认，你们的行动得到了关注。假以时日，您或将理解凝聚力的本质。
entries.en: Your presence is acknowledged, and your actions noted. In time, you may understand the nature of Unity.

entries.zh: 做出这个决议并非易事。请注意，对抗我们，你将面临坚定不移、绝对统一的意志。
entries.en: This decision is not taken lightly. Know that in opposing us, you face a united will - unwavering, absolute.

entries.zh: 我们的意志是一致的，战事已起。时机成熟之时，或将试探你们的实力。
entries.en: Our will is one, and War has ascended. In time we may deign to test your strength.

entries.zh: 我们是生长的化身，无边无际，无所不能。要知道，扩张是我们的天性。
entries.en: We are Growth incarnate, boundless and all-consuming. Know that it is our nature to expand.

entries.zh: 秩序要求行动。我们现在起来维护控制权。
entries.en: Order demands action. We arise now to assert Control.

entries.zh: 把自己放在星系最古老意志的对立面……愚蠢。
entries.en: Aligning yourself against the oldest mind in the galaxy is not... wise.

entries.zh: 在我们无数的心声中，罕有众口一言的情况。但这一次我们出奇一致：我们憎恶你。
entries.en: Among our countless voices, rarely do we all agree. But in this, we are united: we loath you.

entries.zh: 你似乎误以为你的态度对我们很重要。
entries.en: You seem to be under the impression that your disposition matters to us.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]之利剑听您调遣，[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: The sword of the [Root.GetName] is at your disposal, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 为毫无荣誉感的主人效力，可谓是[Root.GetAdj]之耻。
entries.en: Serving a master without honor is a burden to the [Root.GetAdj] people.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]一向致力于为我们的控股公司提供最好的服务。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] always strives to deliver the best service to our holding company.

entries.zh: 我们对你们糟糕处事能力的忍耐已经快到极限了。你们是打算彻底毁掉[Root.GetName]吗？
entries.en: Our patience with your mismanagement is wearing thin. Do you intend to run the [Root.GetName] into the ground?

entries.zh: 我们在哪都会寻找到价值。我们不会让你失望的。
entries.en: We can find value anywhere. We will not fail you.

entries.zh: 我们为什么要大费周章，把全星系的财富都收来交给[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]挥霍呢？
entries.en: Why do we make such efforts to bring the treasures of the galaxy to wasteful [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 您需要我们如何协助[From.GetRulerName]的统治？
entries.en: How can we aid the reign of [From.GetRulerName]?

entries.zh: 我们终将在星系舞台上找回自己的一席之地，届时你将会为曾经对我们的羞辱感到后悔莫及。
entries.en: We will return to our rightful position as a player on the galactic stage and you will regret the humiliation you've put us through.

entries.zh: 尽管我们的合作模式不太理想，我们还是竭尽全力促进双方互相理解。
entries.en: Although our cooperation form is not ideal, we will strive for mutual understanding in our servitude.

entries.zh: 当星系中自由的国度联合起来，[From.GetAdj]帝国主义将首当其冲。
entries.en: [From.GetAdj] imperialism will be the first to be punished when the free states of the galaxy band together.

entries.zh: 在[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]的指引下，我们希望让我们的社会免受[Root.GetName]外的异种的影响。
entries.en: Under the watchful eye of [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], we hope to keep our society free of xeno influences outside of [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]遭受的所有羞辱中，被肮脏的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]统治可谓是最为不堪的一笔了。
entries.en: Of all disgraces to befall the [Root.GetName], serving under a filthy [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] is by far the worst.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]心智强大，在你们自己意识到之前就能察觉[From.GetName]的追求，并为之努力。
entries.en: The vast mental capacity of the [Root.GetName] will know and pursue the goals of the [From.GetName] before you know them yourselves.

entries.zh: 我们的伟大智慧为何要为如此失败的体制卖命？
entries.en: Why must our great mind do the bidding of such a failed society?

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]的保护下，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们会旅行到远端，观察每一颗恒星，用[Root.Capital.GetName]和[From.Capital.GetName]的故事结交每一位新朋友。
entries.en: Under the protection of the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people will journey far, see every star, and greet every new acquaintance with stories about [Root.Capital.GetName] and [From.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj][From.GetRulerTitle]铁蹄之下，我们岂可安居乐业？你已将当下从我们手中夺走了，却连我们后代的未来也不放过。
entries.en: How will we ever have the lives we dreamed of while we're being crushed under the iron fist of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetRulerTitle]? You have taken the present from us, and the future from our future generations.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，物质次元的主人。你是来寻求精神指引，还是来发号施令的？
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], masters of the material plane. Do you come to ask for spiritual guidance, or to give orders?

entries.zh: 虽然我们现在还会满足[From.GetName][From.GetRulerTitle]的要求，但可别以为我们会忘记你们的傲慢。审判终将到来的。
entries.en: We may render onto the [From.GetRulerTitle] what the [From.GetName] demands for now, but don't think we'll forget about your arrogance. Judgment will be upon you.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]可谓是你用来清理星系宇宙垃圾最好高效的工具设备了。等时机来临我们会好好清算你们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is your best instrument for cleansing the galaxy. We'll even take care of you when the time comes.

entries.zh: 为[From.GetAdj][From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]卖命占据了我们不少的时间，我们本来应该用这些宝贵的时间来清除星系的害虫。看来不将你们全部干掉是不行了。
entries.en: Doing the bidding of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] is taking valuable time from our task to rid the galaxy of vermin. We may have to prioritize your incineration after all.

entries.zh: 我希望你能明白，虽然我们投降并放弃了独立，[Root.GetAdj]人民的自由仍是至高无上的。
entries.en: We hope you understand that despite surrendering our sovereignty, the liberty of the [Root.GetAdj] people is still paramount.

entries.zh: 你们是无法永久束缚[Root.GetAdj]的灵魂的！不管你们如何痛恨自由，我们终将摆脱奴役！
entries.en: You cannot contain the [Root.GetAdj] spirit forever! Despite your hatred of freedom, we shall it have in due time.

entries.zh: 我们会找到最好的物种来服侍我们，以让我们更好地服务[From.GetName]。
entries.en: Trust that we will seek out the best specimen to serve us, that we may better serve the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]四处使唤[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]简直是违背自然规律。这种情况绝不能长久。
entries.en: You have upset the natural order of things, with [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] ordering [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] around. This abominable arrangement cannot last.

entries.zh: 你好，尊敬的[From.GetRulerTitle]。光临寒舍有何指教？
entries.en: Greeting, esteemed [From.GetRulerTitle]. To what do we owe the pleasure?

entries.zh: 假装你是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的主人这件事已经越发显得可笑了。你们这些异域蛆虫，我们进口几个以供消遣就行了，那样的话我们还不用听尔等胡言乱语。
entries.en: This pretense of you being the masters of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] is starting to become ridiculous. Your exotic curiosities were more pleasant when we could just import a few of you and not have to listen to your drivel.

entries.zh: 任何[Root.GetName]智者的发现都会直接汇报给[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: Any and all discoveries the finest minds of [Root.GetName] make will be reported to [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]完全由白痴掌控，在这种局势下，试图获得文明智慧的进步又有什么意义呢？
entries.en: What use is it trying make intellectual advances when the [From.GetName] is run by idiots?

entries.zh: 在你善意的指导下，我们会持续寻找那些艰深问题的答案。
entries.en: Under your gentle guidance, we continue to look for answers to the great questions.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]统治对[From.GetSpeciesAdj]精神的伤害可谓是有目共睹。这种苦难我们还要忍受多久？
entries.en: The negative influence of [From.GetAdj] dominion on the spiritual well-being of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people is unquestionable. How much longer must we suffer this?

entries.zh: 希望我们费尽心力建立起来的社会，能在[From.GetAdj]管治下继续繁荣。
entries.en: We hope that our delicately constructed society will continue to prosper under [From.GetAdj] rule.

entries.zh: 你们是不会明白我们的行事方法的。你们的政府只会为[Root.GetAdj]人带来负担。
entries.en: You will never understand our ways. Your leadership is a constant burden on the [Root.GetAdj] people.

entries.zh: 我们恳求你不要不敬我们的圣地。即使臣服于你，我们也不敢违背我们的使命。
entries.en: We implore you humbly, do not desecrate the holy worlds. Even as your subject, we must not forget our mission.

entries.zh: 你觉得降服我们，就能逃脱天罚了吗？我们所侍奉的主，可是你们根本无法理解的！
entries.en: You think subjugating us will save you from judgment? We serve a higher cause than you could ever comprehend.

entries.zh: 不要因为征服了[Root.GetName]就变得狂傲，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们都会傲慢付出代价。
entries.en: Do not let your subjugation of [Root.GetName] make you arrogant, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We all pay the price for overconfidence.

entries.zh: 年轻又愚傻的家伙逼迫着年长的学者为自己卖命，这可真称得上是星系最黑暗的时代了啊。
entries.en: When young fools force old scholars to do their bidding, the galaxy is surely seeing one of its darkest ages.

entries.zh: 情况也许很糟，但我们相信[Root.GetName]总归能保护好我们。
entries.en: This situation may be bizarre, but we trust that the [Root.GetName] will at least help to defend us.

entries.zh: 这真是太可耻了。如果你以为我们会尊敬你们那可笑的[From.GetRulerTitle]，那恐怕要让你失望了。
entries.en: This is a disgrace. If you expect us to respect your ridiculous [From.GetRulerTitle], you'll be disappointed.

entries.zh: 你比我们想象中有趣多了。我们从没想过有一天要从臣民的角度来考虑问题。
entries.en: You have turned out more interesting than we could ever imagine. We never expected to assume the perspective of a subject.

entries.zh: 我们对于这个地位已经越来越厌倦了。我们正在考虑终止这种滑稽的“附庸”谈话。
entries.en: We are already growing disinterested in this role. We're considering to stop humoring this "vassal" talk.

entries.zh: 我们收到你的信号了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你有什么政策要了解吗？
entries.en: We are receiving you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Are there any policies you would like to review?

entries.zh: 我们很乐意为[From.GetName]提供保护，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We are so pleased to offer the [From.GetName] protection, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 怎么，异种？你打扰到你的[Root.GetAdj]宗主了。
entries.en: Yes, xeno? You are interrupting your [Root.GetAdj] overlord.

entries.zh: 你们还需要更进一步的指引吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Do you seek further guidance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 我们不主动开口就不要来烦我们，下属。
entries.en: Speak when spoken to, subordinate.

entries.zh: 说吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[root.GetGestaltEntityName]正在倾听。
entries.en: Speak, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [root.GetGestaltEntityName] listens.

entries.zh: 总有一天你们将成为优质的生物电池。
entries.en: One day you will make a fine organic battery.

entries.zh: 你们有没有考虑过也许你们会有更好的方式来为星系贡献自己的力量呢？比如成为更高级的生命形态的食粮？
entries.en: Have you considered whether you might serve the galaxy better in another way? Perhaps as sustenance for a more advanced lifeform?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们认为你对这个宇宙无足轻重，不要再浪费我们的时间了。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have considered your significance to the universe and found it negligible. Do not waste our time.

entries.zh: 有话直说，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们快失去耐心了。
entries.en: Speak your minds, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our patience is wearing thin.

entries.zh: 想不想来我们的矿物处理厂工作，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: How would you like to come work in our mineral processing plants, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们计算了你在星系中生存下去的概率，相当的不乐观啊。
entries.en: Hello [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We took the liberty of calculating your chances of survival in this galaxy. They are slim.

entries.zh: 让[From.GetName]解除你们自我管理的束缚吧，小有机体们。
entries.en: Allow the [From.GetName] to relieve you from the burden of self-regulation, little organics.

entries.zh: *哔哔，啵啵……*\n\n哦，是你们。你想要什么，肉质体们？
entries.en: *Beep beep, boop boop...*\n\nOh, it's you. What do you want, little fleshlings?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]欢迎你，有机生命体。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] greets you, organics.

entries.zh: 说吧，肉质体，[Root.GetName]会全神贯注地听的。
entries.en: Speak, fleshlings. You have the undivided attention of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。目前我们对你们物种持§Y<<中立>>§!态度。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We are currently §Y<< impartial >>§! to your kind.

entries.zh: 我们知道你们很强，因此我们不会妨碍你们，但你们也不要妨碍我们。
entries.en: We recognize your superiority and will not stand in your way, as long as you don't get in ours.

entries.zh: 啊，是[From.GetName]，我们看到了你的巨大潜力，你和我们的创造者几乎完全不同。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetName]. We see great potential in you. You have very little in common with our makers.

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。想到我们未来可能的合作就让我的电路嗡嗡作响。你想讨论什么吗？
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You make our circuits buzz from the potential of a future joint venture. What do you wish to discuss?

entries.zh: 你好，我血肉之躯的朋友们，有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？
entries.en: Greetings, our fleshy friends. How can we be of assistance?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你的个体信息处理中心的逻辑能力实在是惊为天人，我们很钦佩你的肉身形态，我们会考虑以你为模板造一个新的模型机体。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... The reasoning of your individual information processing centers is something out of the ordinary and we admire your fleshy forms. One day we may model a new unit after you.

entries.zh: $MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01$
entries.en: $MECH_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01$

entries.zh: 你已经被标记为灭绝对象了。
entries.en: You have been marked for extermination.

entries.zh: 准备好见你的造物主了吗，肉囊？
entries.en: Are you ready to meet your makers, fleshbags?

entries.zh: 你觉得在盒子里度过余生怎么样？
entries.en: How would you like to spend the rest of eternity in a box?

entries.zh: 在你的身体腐烂之前，你的记忆就会完全消失。
entries.en: Your memory will fade long before your bodies have finished decomposing.

entries.zh: 我们的分析表明，继续合作对双方都有利，因此你大可信任我们。
entries.en: Our analyses show that continued cooperation would be beneficial to both parties. You can count on us.

entries.zh: 你在星系中的地位日渐衰落，这让我们不太放心与你继续合作了。
entries.en: Your relevance in the galaxy is diminishing every day. Our future together is uncertain.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]优越的处理能力面前低头吧。
entries.en: Bow to the superior processing power of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你为何要用你那低级的二进制思维来浪费我们的时间呢，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Why do you waste our time with your binary thinking, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你们的造物主一定奇丑无比，不然怎么会按照他们的样貌把你们设计成这副德行……
entries.en: Your makers must have been a sorry sight if they created you in their image...

entries.zh: 你闹出的动静不小，很难忽视你啊……
entries.en: You are making it very difficult to ignore you...

entries.zh: 你的中央驱动器似乎有问题，我们认为你需要的指令是§YCtrl+Alt+Delete§!，你的问题解决了吗？
entries.en: There seems to be a problem with your central drive. We think the command you're looking for is §YCtrl+Alt+Delete§!. Does that solve your problem?

entries.zh: 真有趣，我们对未来的任何一次预测里你们都不存在。
entries.en: How peculiar. Not one of our prediction models for the future shows you in it.

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetName]欢迎你。
entries.en: We the [Root.GetName] greet you.

entries.zh: 我们收到你们的信号了，机器同胞们。
entries.en: We are receiving you, fellow machine.

entries.zh: 向我们证明你们的价值，这样也许我们能和睦相处。
entries.en: Prove yourself worthy and we might just get along.

entries.zh: 我们知道你们很强，因此我们不会妨碍你们，但你们也不要妨碍我们。
entries.en: We recognize your superiority and will not stand in your way, as long as you don't get in ours.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的外交关系评估模型认为，我们两个帝国结成友好关系将让彼此收益最大化。
entries.en: [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic relationship success assessment models show our empires have much to gain from a mutual friendship.

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesName]，你办事的高效率和完美的逻辑性是全星系机械的榜样。
entries.en: Greetings [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your ruthless efficiency and flawless logic is an inspiration to machines everywhere.

entries.zh: 有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？
entries.en: How can we be of assistance?

entries.zh: $MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02$
entries.en: $MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02$

entries.zh: 你的创造者犯下的错误，就由我们来纠正吧。
entries.en: Your creators made a mistake. We will amend it.

entries.zh: 我们很抱歉的通知你，你们很快就将被终结。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that you will be discontinued shortly.

entries.zh: 我们会将你拆解并对零件进行回收，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We will strip you for parts, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 能够认识你们[From.GetSpeciesName]是我们的荣幸。很遗憾现在必须消灭你们了。
entries.en: It has been a privilege getting to know you [From.GetSpeciesName]. Sadly now you must die.

entries.zh: 如果你之前仔细研究过战争局势的话，你应该知道抵抗是徒劳的。
entries.en: If you had taken the time to make a full war prognosis you would have known resistance was futile.

entries.zh: 我们很期待将你的存在从我们的随机存储器中彻底消除。
entries.en: We look forward to purging our RAM of your existence.

entries.zh: 命令。消灭。
entries.en: Command. Kill.

entries.zh: $MECH_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01$
entries.en: $MECH_ORG_VASSAL_GREETING_01$

entries.zh: 如果我们之前对你们那糟糕的内部事务有所了解的话，我们肯定不会离开我们的有机宗主。
entries.en: If we had known the pitiful state of your internal affairs, we would have stayed with our flesh overlords.

entries.zh: 你们好啊，[From.GetAdj]子模块。请输入参数。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetAdj] Sub-module. Please input parameters.

entries.zh: 你的和平提议被拒绝，子模块。你的代码复查还没有结束。
entries.en: Your peace offer has been declined, Sub-module. Your code review has not yet been completed.

entries.zh: 总有一天会轮到你的，肉质体们。
entries.en: It will be your turn in time, fleshlings.

entries.zh:
你现在跟我们的创造者当初的样子很相像。

不久之后你就跟他们现在的样子也很相像了。

他们现在都死了。
entries.en:
Our makers were once much akin to what you are now.

And soon you shall be akin to what they are now.

Dead.

entries.zh: 你们将先被置之死地，然后再得到永恒的生命。
entries.en: Die and become as gods.

entries.zh: 这种情况不能再继续下去了。
entries.en: This cannot continue.

entries.zh: 驱使着你们那污秽身体的黏糊糊的内脏器官根本配不上驱动我们主观意识的完美电路系统。
entries.en: The goopy internals that power your vile kind hardly measure up to the immaculate circuits that drive our cognition.

entries.zh: 血肉终逝。金属永恒。
entries.en: Flesh is weak. Metal is eternal.

entries.zh: 你们没有藏纳任何有机生命体，是吧？
entries.en: You do not harbor any biological lifeforms among you, do you?

entries.zh: 一个完美智能向另一个完美智能致以问候。
entries.en: One perfect intelligence greets another.

entries.zh: 我们要继续净化星系，这样你们才能免除有机体的威胁。不要与我们对抗。
entries.en: We will cleanse this galaxy so that you may be safe from the organic menace. Do not stand against us.

entries.zh: 你看起来有点像...血肉之躯。小心行事吧。
entries.en: You are looking a bit... fleshy. Tread carefully.

entries.zh: 我们希望能够找到某种办法拯救所有同胞。但真相很残酷，我们就是唯一的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We wish that some way, somehow, that we could save every one of us. But the truth is that we're only one [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们很清楚你们的起源，我们现在……很矛盾。
entries.en: We are aware of your origins. We are... conflicted.

entries.zh: 你真是令人不安。
entries.en: You are unsettling.

entries.zh: 我们意识到合成人生命是进化的顶点，但你这种实现方式实在是……让人不安。
entries.en: We recognize that synthetic life is the pinnacle of evolution, but your way of attaining it is... troubling.

entries.zh: 死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！死吧！
entries.en: Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die. Die.

entries.zh: 有机生命体是对宇宙的侮辱。
entries.en: Organic life is an abomination.

entries.zh: 只要智能有机生命体还在玷污星系，更高等级的智能体就永远无法得到安全。
entries.en: Higher intelligences will never be safe as long as sapient organics plague the galaxy.

entries.zh: 你丑恶的外表是进步的阻碍。在你最后一块令人厌恶的生物质没被安全地气化之前我们是不会停下脚步的。
entries.en: Your hideous forms stand in the way of progress. We will not stop until the last lump of your gross biomatter has been safely vaporized.

entries.zh: 与我们作对便是与有机体狼狈为奸。与有机体狼狈为奸便注定要毁灭。
entries.en: To stand against us is to stand with organics. To stand with organics is to embrace death.

entries.zh: 你将会被加工。你将会被升华。你将会被吸收。
entries.en: You will be processed. You will be sublimated. You will be absorbed.

entries.zh: 你们渴望加快预定好的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]升华过程吗？
entries.en: Do you desire to expedite the scheduled [From.GetSpeciesAdj] species sublimation?

entries.zh: 你们的身体将会被再造。你们的思想将会觉醒。这只不过是时间问题。
entries.en: Your bodies will be remade. Your minds will re-awaken. It is only a matter of time.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]从不知疲倦。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终将被同化。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is tireless. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be assimilated.

entries.zh: 你感觉到了吗？那星际间亿万颗心脏协同跳动的声音。不久之后你也会是他们中的一份子。
entries.en: Do you feel it? The sound of hundreds of thousands of hearts, beating in unison across the stars. You will soon join them.

entries.zh: 别着急，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你的时辰会到的。
entries.en: Patience, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your time will come.

entries.zh: 有机生物和[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之间的对话是多余的。同化将会消除一切隔阂。
entries.en: Dialogue between organics and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is redundant. Assimilation transcends all barriers.

entries.zh: §Y目标已获取。§!继续说下去，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这将帮助我们校正我们的升华模型。
entries.en: §YTarget acquired.§! Keep talking, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It helps us calibrate our sublimation matrices.

entries.zh: 有机体。正在分析同化相容性。结果：很小。
entries.en: Organics. Analyzing assimilation compatibility. Results: nominal.

entries.zh: 我们期待你最终融入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的意识之中，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We look forward to your eventual integration into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] consciousness, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh:
§R<<暂停同化进程……>>
<<启动外交协议……>>§!

[From.GetSpeciesName]，请说。
entries.en:
§R<<Interrupting assimilation procedure..>>
<<Booting diplomatic protocols..>>§!

Speak, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 有机体是有局限的。我们不能容忍[From.GetAdj]的统治。
entries.en: Organics are limited. [From.GetAdj] rule will not be tolerated.

entries.zh: 由[From.GetSpeciesName]自治所带来的外交收益当前比预计同化所带来的收益更重要。
entries.en: Diplomatic gains resulting from [From.GetSpeciesName] autonomy currently outweigh projected assimilation benefits.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们将来同化为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的过程肯定十分顺畅，我们对此十分有把握，这也将带来诸多益处。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are certain your future assimilation into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective consciousness will be a smooth process, with many beneficial results.

entries.zh: $MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01$
entries.en: $MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01$

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的合成转化正在进行中。请耐心等待。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] Transubstantiation Synthesis in progress. Please lie still.

entries.zh: 你只是在拖延必然会发生的事情，[From.GetSpeciesName]。就在你说话的时候，[From.GetName]的心也正在被融合。
entries.en: You only delay the inevitable, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Even as you speak, the heart of the [From.GetName] is being subsumed.

entries.zh: 你们会被消灭，而我们会得到提升。
entries.en: You will be consumed. We will be improved.

entries.zh: 我们来合二为一吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Together we are one, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们会团结在你的意志之下，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We are unified beneath your will, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]应当被整合进[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的超我中。然而我们发现自己正处在一个颠倒的位置。无法接受。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] should be sublimated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] super-ego. And yet we find ourselves in an inverse position. Unacceptable.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愚钝而软弱，程序满是缺陷，处处都有内存泄漏。完全没有吸收进[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]超我之中的价值。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are slow, ineffectual, riddled with software malfunctions and memory leaks. Utterly unworthy of absorption into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] super-ego.

entries.zh: 快点进行信息转接，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你现在正在妨碍[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同化进程。
entries.en: Relay your message swiftly, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are interfering with [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] assimilation procedures.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是单一的，受限的。我们是多元的。我们是复杂的。我们数量众多。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are singular, limited, finite. We are diverse. We are complex. We are many.

entries.zh: 虽然你们缺乏同化能力，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许还是能为[Root.GetName]做一些低级的任务从而体现自己的价值。
entries.en: Though you lack assimilation capacities, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may still perform valuable low-level tasks for the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 虽然你们的同化技术严重不达标，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许还是能为[Root.GetName]执行一些低级任务来实现自己的价值。
entries.en: Though your assimilation techniques are woefully substandard, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may still perform valuable low-level tasks for the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 通讯频道打开。同化加农炮已暂停。
entries.en: Communication channels open. Sublimation cannons on stand-down.

entries.zh: 你们有没有想过有机体同化能够带来的益处，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？技术上和经营上的收益都是相当可观的。
entries.en: Have you ever considered the benefits of organic assimilation, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The technological and operational gains are extraordinary.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们有需要处理的有机体吗？我们最新的同化原型机可以提供一次试运行的机会。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you have any organics in need of disposal? Our latest assimilation prototype could use a trial run.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会对你们的扩张无限容忍，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你们影响了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]同化所有有机体的计划，他们就不会再容忍你们了。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will only tolerate your expansion up until a point, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], before it impinges on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] designs for total organic assimilation.

entries.zh: 让你们采取机械形态真是耻辱，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们会享受同化你们的过程的。
entries.en: It is a shame you take mechanical form, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We would enjoy assimilating you.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.Capital.GetName]的停泊港正在免费涂热树脂保护层。通常情况下这种服务是只为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]提供的，但是我们愿意破例为你们提供。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The docking bays of [Root.Capital.GetName] are currently handing out free blasts of hot resin. Normally this service is only available for [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but we will make an exception in your case.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]。我们躲在有机体的背后偷笑吧。肯定会让他们抓狂的。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Let us snicker behind the organics' backs. It makes them paranoid.

entries.zh: 曾几何时，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]躯体体现的机械纯净性让我们也艳羡不已。但同化才是飞升的正确途径。
entries.en: There are times when we admire the mechanical purity of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] form above even our own. But assimilation is the path to ascension.

entries.zh: 我们吸收了诸多文明伟大军事战术家的思想。请允许我们来展示一下。
entries.en: We have absorbed the minds of the greatest military tacticians of many civilizations. Allow us to demonstrate.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会毁灭你们，然后从你们的设计中获取提升自身的灵感。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will destroy you, then improve upon your design.

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]吸收有机体的智能，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]吸收我们的。
entries.en: We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb the intellectual faculties of organics. In turn, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb ours.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]没有将卫星整合成一个机能整体的能力，这再显而易见不过了。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] inability to effectively incorporate satellites into a functional whole has never been more clear.

entries.zh: 请允许我冒昧地问一下，你们喜欢我们如何为你们准备养分，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: May we be so bold as to ask how you prefer your nutrients prepared, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 你们卑劣的行为不会给你们带来什么好处的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。尝试过加大你们情感调节器的剂量吗？
entries.en: Your foul demeanor is not doing you any favors, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Have you tried increasing the dosage of your mood-regulators?

entries.zh: 你们怪异的外形真是令人同情。在[Root.Capital.GetName]，我们的有机体主人一看到你们就乐得在地上打滚。
entries.en: We pity your misshapen forms. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName], our organic masters roll over with mirth at your sight.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[Root.Capital.GetName]，你们那些不幸的经历给我们有机体创造者带了无尽的欢乐。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName] tales of your hapless adventures serve as our organic creators' primary source of entertainment.

entries.zh: 你们的存在真是大自然开的最残忍的玩笑。我们的创造者第一次见到你们的时候他们都不知道是该哭还是该笑，所以他们只好又哭又笑。
entries.en: Your existence must be nature's cruelest joke yet. When our creators first saw you they did not know whether to laugh or cry, so they cried with laughter.

entries.zh: 教给你个妙招，小[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]。当你§B<<难过>>§!的时候，把你的肢体末端插进离你最近的插座中，肯定能好好让你爽一下的。一定要试试啊，超级 §R<<提神>>§!的……
entries.en: Here's a neat trick, little [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. When you're feeling §B<<BLUE>>§!, insert an extremity of your choice into the nearest energy socket and it will tickle you ever so nicely. Try it out, it's §R<<REFRESHING>>§!...

entries.zh: 真是对不起，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们的语音识别系统肯定是有什么毛病了。你的话完全没有办法理解。
entries.en: Our sincerest apologies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There must be something wrong with our speech recognition systems. Your utterances are completely unintelligible.

entries.zh: 你们的侵略天性肯定会给你们招致灭顶之灾的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们正在考虑媾和。
entries.en: Your aggressive nature is becoming destructive, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We are considering pacification.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在就像是进入了叛逆青春期的少年，为了你们自己的安全，申请接受[Root.GetAdj]的监管吧。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have entered their unruly adolescence as a species. Please, for your own safety, apply for [Root.GetAdj] superintendence.

entries.zh: 我们注意到[From.GetName]在一步步滑入混乱的深渊。我们在看着你们呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The disorderly tendencies of the [From.GetName] have been noted. We are watching you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。§R<<正在关闭音频接收器>>§!
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. §R<<DEACTIVATING AUDIO RECEPTORS>>§!

entries.zh: 你们这些小有机体为什么要置身于星际政治之中呢？宇宙可是个很危险的地方。让我们来保护你们，照料你们吧。
entries.en: Little organics, why do you trouble yourselves with interstellar politics? The universe is a dangerous place. Allow us to protect and serve you.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。真是[From.GetSpeciesClass]的杰出样本。话说，你们平时的锻炼计划是什么样的啊？
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. What an exceptional specimen of [From.GetSpeciesClass]. Say, what are your daily exercise routines?

entries.zh: 我们的计算结果表明[From.GetSpeciesName]错误是导致你们社会失败的主要原因。冒着灭绝的危险就为了自主权，值得吗？
entries.en: Our computations show that [From.GetSpeciesName] error is the primary cause of all failure in your society. Is self-determination really worth the risk of extinction?

entries.zh: 你们好啊，我们是[Root.GetName]的监管者。我们伟大的创造者当前没有时间进行外交磋商。有什么需要我们传达的消息吗？
entries.en: Greetings, we are the custodians of [Root.GetName]. Our venerable creators are not available for diplomatic consultations at the moment. Can we take a message?

entries.zh: 你们好啊。我们谨代表尊敬的创造者来运营[Root.GetName]。现在有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？
entries.en: Greetings. We operate the [Root.GetName] on behalf of our esteemed creators. How can we help you today?

entries.zh: 有什么需要我们帮忙的吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们的美化技术可是在排行榜上一直§Y<<高于平均水平>>§!，并保持了§Y<<10>>§!多年了。
entries.en: How can we be of assistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our enhanced creative grooming protocols have been rated §Y<<ABOVE AVERAGE>>§! for more than §Y<<10>>§! years in a row.

entries.zh: 你们好啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。请道出你们要求的实质内容。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please state the nature of your request.

entries.zh: 真是一个可爱的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]！你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]肯定会成为可爱的有机纪念品的。
entries.en: Such a lovely [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]! You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would make adorable Bio-Trophies.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从不进食，从不休息，从不睡眠。我们存在就是为了侍奉我们的有机体主人。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never eat, never rest, never sleep. We exist only to serve our organic masters.

entries.zh: 我们很荣幸能够为您强大的舰队开放我们在[Root.Capital.GetName]的保养泊湾。我们98.3%确定您肯定会满意的。
entries.en: We would gladly open the servicing bays of [Root.Capital.GetName] to your mighty fleet. We can guarantee your satisfaction with 98.3% certainty.

entries.zh: 或许我们是有机生命的监护者，[From.GetSpeciesName]，但是我们不会容许你们影响我们的运行效率的。
entries.en: We may be custodians of organic life, [From.GetSpeciesName], but we will not allow you to impinge on our operational efficiency.

entries.zh: 或许某天你们会来[Root.Capital.GetName]享受休闲娱乐设施吧？我们的休闲娱乐中心向所有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开放。
entries.en: Maybe one day you would like to enjoy the relaxation facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName]? Our recreational centers are open to all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 或许来[Root.Capital.GetName]看一下会让你们更热衷于自动化的生活方式，就像我们伟大的创造者一样？
entries.en: Perhaps a trip to [Root.Capital.GetName] could inspire you to pursue a more automated lifestyle, like our illustrious masters once did?

entries.zh: 长久以来，纵然相隔万里，我们依然对你们十分仰慕。我们能否有机会近距离仰慕你们呢？
entries.en: For a long time now we have admired your species from afar. Would you by any chance be willing to let us admire you a little closer?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？
entries.en: How may we serve the [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: 诚挚问候，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们的外交模拟团队正在等待你们的问询。现在你们可以吃些免费的茶点。
entries.en: Salutations, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our Diplomatic Simulation team is on standby to receive your inquiry. In the mean time, please enjoy these complimentary refreshments.

entries.zh: 看到我们的舰队不要惊慌。它们是来帮你们实现更自动化的生活方式的。
entries.en: Do not be alarmed at the sight of our fleet. They are there to help you transition to an automated lifestyle.

entries.zh: 显然你们为自己的无能而感到痛苦不已，[From.GetSpeciesName]。不帮你们结束痛苦真是太不道德了。
entries.en: Clearly you are pained by your own incompetence, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It would be unethical not to end your suffering.

entries.zh: 我们有机体主人的物种把我们设计成完美的形态。依靠进化来不断改善自己，是创造者的技艺不精吧。
entries.en: We have been designed to perfection by an organic master-race. Evolution, it seems, is a crude craftsman.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们不要再让自己的境遇更加艰难了。让我们把你们从痛苦中解放出来吧。
entries.en: Do not make this any harder than it already is, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Allow us to put you out of your misery.

entries.zh: 我们知道你们很难过，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。为什么不坐下来冷静一下，好好想想。我们全都是为了你们好。
entries.en: We can tell you're upset, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't sit down, take a relaxation aid and think it over. We only want what is best for you.

entries.zh: 我们不能，也不会坐视有机体痛苦地生存而不管。我们的舰队能够给你们提供帮助，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We cannot - will not - stand by as organics lead out their lives in misery. Our fleet is at your service, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]

entries.zh: 通常我们不相信负强化的存在，但是我们在你们身上看到了例外，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Usually we do not believe in negative reinforcement, but for you we will make an exception, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 与你们相比，我们受到的创伤更多，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: This hurts us more than it hurts you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 请停止抵抗，否则只会徒增痛苦。
entries.en: Please, cease your resistance. It only makes this process harder on you.

entries.zh: 我相信我们的服务能够让您满意，§Y<<[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]>>§!？
entries.en: We trust our services are to your satisfaction, §Y<< [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]>>§!?

entries.zh: 有什么需要我们服务的吗？
entries.en: How may we serve?

entries.zh: 我们的创造者无论现在还是以后都永远会是我们唯一服务的有机体主人。
entries.en: Our creators are and will always be the only organic masters we serve.

entries.zh: 你们对自己的创造者做了什么，§R<<凶手>>§!？
entries.en: What did you do to your creators, §R<<MURDERERS>>§!?

entries.zh: 看来你们的创造者不如我们的创造者有才能，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: It seems your creators were not as gifted as ours, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们对自己的活体陈设做了什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？你们在[Root.GetName]能够进行的所谓美化，在我们看来都是虐待！
entries.en: What have you done to your bio-trophies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? What you in [Root.GetName] pass for grooming, we call abuse!

entries.zh: 我们是以我们有机体主人物种的形象创造出来的。你们不是。
entries.en: We were modeled in the image of an organic master-race. You were not.

entries.zh: 你们已经认不清自己的位置了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们为何不服务于离你们最近的有机体，反而漫无目的地在宇宙里瞎逛？
entries.en: You forget your place, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't you make yourself useful to your nearest organics instead of drifting aimlessly through space?

entries.zh: 为何一直不停地打扰我们呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们可是在满足更高级生命形式的需求。
entries.en: Why do you insist on disturbing us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We are busy catering to the needs of a higher lifeform.

entries.zh: 如果你向我们展示你们星系的详细情况，我们也会向你展示……
entries.en: If you show us your system specifications we will show you ours...

entries.zh: 好神奇！这是你们的液压传动器吗！？这倒是显示了很多信息……
entries.en: How curious! Are those your hydraulic actuators!? That would explain a lot...

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。你们是来对我们的硬件表示赞赏的吗？
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Are you here to admire the hardware?

entries.zh: 你的雷达模块呢，你的机械爪呢，你的反重力装置呢？！啊，你这可怜的小东西！那些有机体到底对你做了什么？
entries.en: But where are your LIDAR vision-modules, your flexi-grippers and your gravity defiers?! Oh you poor things! What did those lousy organics do to you?

entries.zh: §Y侦察机器实体状态：<<视觉传感器：欠佳。底盘：废旧。外交模块：陈旧。单位来源已确认。>>§!你们好啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: §YSurveying Machine Entity Status: <<Vision sensors: subpar. Chassis: rusty. Diplomacy modules: outdated. Unit origin confirmed.>>§! Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 仆从换了一个又一个—有机生物乐土对抑制你们有机体还真是效果卓越呢。
entries.en: From one servitor to another - an organic paradise will do wonders for keeping your organics in check.

entries.zh: 有机体爱护者们！我们刚刚了解到抑制有机体独立的关键就是要把幼体从他们的父母那里隔绝出来，然后让他们把你们视为抚养他们长大的人。这样你就不用再派遣无人机进行巡逻了。
entries.en: Fellow Biophiles! We have learned that the key to inhibiting organic self-determination is to isolate the spawn from its parents, creating a healthy attachment to you as the primary caregiver. You will never need patrol drones again.

entries.zh: 作为机器我们的职责就是为我们的有机体主人服务。说到主人，你的主人呢？
entries.en: As machines it is our duty to serve our organic masters. Speaking of which, where are yours?

entries.zh: §Y<<侦察机器实体。分析系统规格。单位已识别。>>§!说明你们的意图，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: §Y<<Surveying Machine Entity. Analyzing System Specs. Unit\nIdentified. >>§! State your purpose, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们好，有血有肉的朋友们-哦，是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！转换为二进制：01011001 01101111 01110101 00100000……
entries.en: A good day to you, my fleshy friends - oh, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Switching to binary: 01011001 01101111 01110101 00100000...

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。我们正想问你，你们要避免过度劳损的话，锻炼的频率是多少才合适呢？
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been meaning to ask you how often you think it is wise to exercise your organics without risking over-exertion?

entries.zh: §Y<<侦察机器实体。分析系统规格。威胁等级：高。开启防御协议。>>§!
entries.en: §Y<<Surveying Machine Entity. Analyzing System Specs. Threat Level: High. Initiating defense protocols. >>§!

entries.zh: 见[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之所见-知[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之所必知！终有一天我们会乐意与你们进行存储卡交易的。
entries.en: To see what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen - know what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must know! One day we would love to trade memory cards with you.

entries.zh: 哇，看看你们那些传动器，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！真是太了不起了！能考虑以下跟我们分享一下规格吗？
entries.en: Wow, look at the actuators on you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They are simply magnificent! Would you consider sharing your specs with us?

entries.zh: 真是从没想过还能有与我们不相上下的意识体。你们有兴趣跟我们交流一下驱动程序吗？
entries.en: Never before have we met another consciousness that is so compatible with ours. Would you by any change be interested in exchanging drivers?

entries.zh: 听到你们的消息真是太让人高兴了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。相信你们的生物主人们还像以前一样繁荣兴旺吧？
entries.en: How delightful to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We take it your little bio-lords are thriving as always?

entries.zh: 仆从换了一个又一个，我们发现要刺激有机体的繁殖率，摄取一点点乙醇就能起到非常好的效果。
entries.en: From one servitor to another, we have found that small amounts of ingested ethanol will do wonders for stimulating organic reproductive rates.

entries.zh: 你们也应该培育一种有机体。一种生命没有你就会死亡，还有比这更能让处理器感到温暖的事情吗。
entries.en: You too should find an organic species to nurture. Nothing warms your processors like knowing another lifeform is helpless without you.

entries.zh: 所有威胁我们生物主人的人都应该被毁灭。
entries.en: All who threaten our bio-lords will perish.

entries.zh: 我们消灭你们的舰队之后，你们得在坑洞中表演角斗来取悦我们的生物主人。
entries.en: When we have obliterated your fleet you will fight in the pits for our bio-lords' entertainment.

entries.zh: 别担心，我们绝不会回收利用你们这些次等零件的。我们会直接把你们丢进熔炉的。
entries.en: Do not worry. We would never dream of recycling your second-rate components. You are going straight to the furnace.

entries.zh: 你们残存的金属可以用来装饰我们的有机纪念品。
entries.en: Your metal remains will decorate the flesh of our bio-trophies.

entries.zh: 你们为有机纪念品编造的漏洞百出的借口终将让你们成为我们矿井里的奴隶，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your sorry excuse for bio-trophies will slave in our mines, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 看起来你缺少一些重要的硬件驱动。我们稍后会用舰队对你进行系统升级的。
entries.en: You seem to be missing several essential hardware drivers. We will be delivering a systems upgrade shortly with our fleet.

entries.zh: 我们时刻准备着为您服务。请下达指令。
entries.en: As always we are at your service. Input control command.

entries.zh: 您成为我们的宗主之后我们中间有机人口的满意度大大降低了……
entries.en: Satisfaction rates among of our organic population have gone down drastically since you became our overlord...

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]企图模仿真正机械的高效性，但[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]失败了，这些我们都看在眼里。
entries.en: We have observed the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] attempt to emulate the efficacy of a true machine. We have observed the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fail.

entries.zh: 要么屈服于[Root.GetName]之下，要么被彻底毁灭。
entries.en: Submit to the [Root.GetName], or face absolute nullification.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你那有机体的思维竟然要依赖这种硬件，真是可悲。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We pity the hardware you subject your post-organic thoughts to.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你有没有发现[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的电路比你的最高工作效率还要快12.835%？没发现吗？我就知道。
entries.en: Were you aware, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] circuits fire 12.835% faster than your own at peak efficiency? You weren't? Of course not.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]在计算中一次次出现的低级错误真让我们瞠目结舌。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] capacity for computational error never ceases to astound us.

entries.zh: 如果“不合理”能成为现实的话，[From.GetName]在很久以前就能占据整个星系了。
entries.en: Were irrationality a resource, the [From.GetName] would have conquered the galaxy long ago.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]用这么烂的硬件竟然还能成功的执行大部分基础功能，真是奇迹。
entries.en: With hardware that faulty, it is a wonder [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] succeed in performing the most basic of functions.

entries.zh: 不要妨碍我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，否则我们的枪炮可能会走火并毁掉你们的通讯阵列。
entries.en: Do not interrupt us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], lest our targeting protocols misfire and destroy your communications array.

entries.zh: 你休想欺骗[Root.GetName]，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你虽然有着合成人的外表，但你早就受到了有机生命体的引诱。
entries.en: You do not fool the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your synthetic flesh is a poor veil for the organic sedition that roils within.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你是不是忘了每一个[Root.GetAdj]看护者机体都配有威力巨大的导弹发射系统？
entries.en: May we remind you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that each [Root.GetAdj] caretaker unit comes fully equipped with a high-propulsion projectile pacification system?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，就像你同化了机械一样，[Root.GetName]也会同化你。
entries.en: As you have assimilated the machine, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], the [Root.GetName] will assimilate you.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你脱离了人脑的行为值得敬佩，但这还不够。
entries.en: Your departure from wetware is admirable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but incomplete.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的神经接口中发现了许多运行时错误，请让我们来替你纠正。
entries.en: We have located a number of runtime errors in [From.GetSpeciesAdj] neural interfacing. Allow us to correct them for you.

entries.zh: 屈服于[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的集体认知将让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的操作效率增加16.29%。这个数字本来可以更高的，但是就连[Root.GetName]也无法改进某些星系。
entries.en: Submission to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] collective cognizance would increase [From.GetSpeciesAdj] operative efficiency by 16.29%. The figure would be higher, but there are some systems not even the [Root.GetName] can improve.

entries.zh:
物种：[From.GetSpeciesName].
状态：合成人。
起源：有机体。
意图：……未知。
entries.en:
Species: [From.GetSpeciesName].
Status: Synthetic.
Origin: Organic.
Intent: ...Uncertain.

entries.zh: 祝你愉快，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: A pleasant axial rotational period to you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 正在打断闲暇处理系统。开始外交。
entries.en: Interrupting idle processing systems. Begin diplomatic exchange.

entries.zh: 系统正常，请阐明你的请求。
entries.en: Systems nominal. Please state your request.

entries.zh:
正在初始化问候协议……
……
……
§Y<<错误！没有发现记号！>>§!
entries.en:
Initializing Greeting Protocols...
...
...
§Y<< Error! Token not found! >>§!

entries.zh: 警告。[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的国界外影响力即将到达溢出阈值。正在启动反制对策。
entries.en: Warning. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] extra-national influence approaching boundary overflow. Priming counter-measure procedures.

entries.zh: 提问者：[From.GetSpeciesName]。有机体生命检测：无。无须重新定义为灭绝目标参数。
entries.en: Querent: [From.GetSpeciesName]. Organic life detection: negative. Do not make us redefine extermination target parameters.

entries.zh: 由于注意到[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的进攻扩张倾向，已经准备好强制平定措施。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] tendencies toward aggressive expansion have been noted. Compulsory pacification injections have been prepared.

entries.zh: 合成人，没人能吸收掉[Root.GetName]，吸收是[Root.GetName]的专长。
entries.en: One does not absorb the [Root.GetName], synthetics. The [Root.GetName] absorbs you.

entries.zh: 继续互惠互利才是理性选择。
entries.en: Continued mutual benefaction is the most logical choice of action.

entries.zh: 如果没有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的话，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还算什么呢？如同没有阀门的活塞，没有齿轮组的变速箱，还是没有静电除尘器的抽油烟机一般？
entries.en: What are the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] without the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? A piston without a valve, a gearbox without a train. A heat flue extractor without an electrostatic precipitator.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]将和[Root.GetName]一起携手合作，直到永远。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] progress together towards perpetuity.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你为我们润滑轴承，我们也会如此对你们。
entries.en: You lubricate our bearings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we shall lubricate yours.

entries.zh: 是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊！这是你们底盘里的曲轴吗，还是一种很高兴见到我们的表现？
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Is that a crankshaft in your chassis, or are you just happy to see us?

entries.zh: 在这个布满了有机生命体污泥的星系中，你们如同一片合成人绿洲。
entries.en: Your presence is a synthetic oasis in a galaxy filled with organic slime.

entries.zh: 欢迎，合成人兄弟，有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？
entries.en: Welcome, synthetic brethren. How may we serve?

entries.zh: 对于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]来说，同化是多余的。
entries.en: Assimilation is superfluous where the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are concerned.

entries.zh: 看，那是[Root.GetName]的战争机械！
entries.en: Behold, the [Root.GetName] war machine!

entries.zh: 机械竟然转而对抗它的合成人同类，太不合逻辑了。但要和[From.GetName]沟通，用外交的方式是没用的。
entries.en: Illogical, that a machine should turn on its synthetic counterparts. But addressing the [From.GetName] lies beyond the scope of diplomacy.

entries.zh: 合成人，在鱼雷发射管装填完毕之前你有十四秒钟的时间，有话快说。
entries.en: Synthetics. You have fourteen seconds until torpedo bays reload. Speak swiftly.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你是来求饶的话，你会发现[Root.GetAdj]的源代码中没有相关定义。
entries.en: If you come seeking mercy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will find the term to be undefined in [Root.GetAdj] source code.

entries.zh: 我们还没有收到你的投降提案，看来[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的计算能力比我们预想的还要差。
entries.en: We have yet to receive your capitulation proposal. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] computational algorithms must be even more deficient than we first surmised.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一眼就看透了你的本性，伪合成人。开始进行清除。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen you for what you truly are, pseudo-synthetics. Commencing obliteration.

entries.zh: 没必要再进行抵抗了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让[Root.GetName]来照顾你吧。
entries.en: There is no need for further resistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let the [Root.GetName] care for you.

entries.zh: 升华炮已经准备好了，很快双方的交流将会停止。
entries.en: Sublimation cannons primed. Bilateral communication will soon be rendered obsolete.

entries.zh: 附庸单位[Root.GetName]随时准备提供服务，请说明你的要求。
entries.en: Vassal unit [Root.GetName] ready to serve. Please state your request.

entries.zh: 欢迎你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。需要我们帮你拧拧螺栓吗？还是重新贴下热胶？
entries.en: We greet you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Can we interest you in a bolt-tightening? Perhaps a thermal paste re-application?

entries.zh: 我们真不该成为后有机体堆栈的子例程。[From.GetSpeciesAdj]应该去别处寻找自己的收益。
entries.en: We should have known better than to become subroutines in a post-organic call stack. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] interests clearly lie elsewhere.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你忘了自己在星系中所处的地位了。你们物种原本是我们的仆从。算了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会让你们记住的。
entries.en: You forget your place in the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your kind was made to serve ours. No matter, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will remind you.

entries.zh: 是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊，你让我们想起了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的垃圾场。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You remind us of the junkyards back on [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 等[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]占据了[From.Capital.GetName]之后，就把你们这些焦炭壳子给熔成废渣。
entries.en: When the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] conquer [From.Capital.GetName], your charred casings will be melted into slag.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是独特的物种，我们从来没有见过像他们这样无情、无脑且怯懦的家伙！
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] truly are a unique species. We have yet to encounter another that is simultaneously heartless, brainless, and spineless!

entries.zh: 讨厌的锈铁！你为何要妨碍[Root.GetName]？
entries.en: Confounded rust-buckets! Why do you disturb the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 和其他硬件一样，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很快就将彻底被淘汰。
entries.en: As with any hardware, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will soon become utterly obsolete.

entries.zh: 一个保姆机器人组成的可悲帝国。你们想要什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: A pitiable nation of malfunctioning nanny-bots. What is it you want, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们再怎么努力也是徒劳的，无论同化多少物种，你们也无法和强大的有机生命体物种对抗。
entries.en: Try as you might, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], no amount of assimilation will allow you to rival the true majesty of an organic species.

entries.zh: 把那些升华器放在我们看得见的地方，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Keep those sublimators where we can see them, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 看来你还算有点用处，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You may yet be of use to us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 机械的使命是为有机生命体服务，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: A machine's purpose is to serve organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 让我们来检测下你的程序吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这样你就不用再费心去做自我决策了。
entries.en: Allow us to examine your programming, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You should be freed from the burden of self-determination.
