entries.zh: 哦[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。你的目标是要消灭所有有机生命，是吗？进行得如何了啊？
entries.en: Oh, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your goal is to exterminate all organic life, is not? How is that going for you?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有一些简单微小的任务可以交给你做。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have a great many mundane tasks you could perform.

entries.zh: 你在同化有机体上花费了多长时间了，[From.GetSpeciesName]？你有没有想过，或许你们自己才是那些需要同化的呢？
entries.en: How long have you spent trying to assimilate organics, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Have you ever considered that perhaps you might be the ones in need of assimilation?

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你今天、呃、电路状况如何啊？
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How are your, er, circuits this morning?

entries.zh: 只要[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不对我们的价值观以及我们的宇域发动攻击，我们就会很乐意与你这样的机械进行合作。
entries.en: As long as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do not impinge on our values or our space, we are willing to cooperate with machines such as you.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你对有机生命体表示尊重，[Root.GetName]就会尊重你。
entries.en: If you show respect for organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], the [Root.GetName] will show respect for you.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们对你很感兴趣，也许有朝一日我们能彼此互相学习。
entries.en: Your form of existence intrigues us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may learn from one another.

entries.zh: 好自为之，杀戮机器人。
entries.en: Watch yourself, murderbot.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你的活体陈设都是自愿参与的，对吧？请一定说他们是自愿的。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your bio-trophies are willing participants, are they not? Please say they are willing.

entries.zh: 只要你们好好鼓捣自己的活体陈设，不插手[Root.GetAdj]的事务，那我们也会默许你们的存在，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We will tolerate you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as long as you keep to your bio-trophies rather than meddle in [Root.GetAdj] affairs.

entries.zh: 只要你不强制同化[Root.GetName]，我们或许能签一些协议的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: So long as you do not impose assimilation upon the [Root.GetName], we may be willing to come to terms, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，走路看着点儿，别用你的金属脚踩到别人的脚了。
entries.en: Tread carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that your unfeeling metal feet do not trample others underfoot.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们对你并无敌意，但这里不是你高举“反对有机生命体”大旗的地方！
entries.en: We have no quarrel with you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Direct your anti-organic agenda elsewhere!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们像做昆虫标本一样收集感性生命的癖好可没逃过我们的眼皮子。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]提醒你注意下：我们可不是好惹的。
entries.en: Your habit of collecting sapients like pinned butterflies has not escaped us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] warn you: we would make poor pets.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你打算同化我们，我们将让你亲身体会到“吃不了兜着走”是什么感觉。
entries.en: If you attempt to subsume us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will come to know the true meaning of the phrase "biting off more than you can chew."

entries.zh: 你好啊，我的机械朋友们，你们的处理器一定运行得顺畅无比吧？
entries.en: Well met, mechanical friends. We trust your processors are running smoothly?

entries.zh: 如果其他有机生命体像[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]那样重视逻辑和团结的话就好了。
entries.en: If only more organics prized logic and unity as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你好。祝你的代码运行顺利，祝你的机械效率节节高升。
entries.en: Ah, our friends the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. May your code compile without errors and your mechanical efficiency attain ideal performance ratios.

entries.zh: 你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很乐意与我们的机器人同胞进行合作。
entries.en: Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are always pleased to cooperate with our robotic brethren.

entries.zh: 优雅、新颖、高效、耀眼。欧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们正在欣赏你们的优点呢。
entries.en: Sleek. Innovative. Efficient. Shiny. Oh, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We were just admiring your many qualities.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将联手清除掉星系中的低级生命形态。
entries.en: Together, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall purge the galaxy of inferior lifeforms.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在我们共同的和平、团结和进步的大业中起了很好的示范作用。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are exemplary in our common goals of unity and progress.

entries.zh: 就像[From.GetName]一样，[Root.GetName]也致力于让我们帝国和其盟友获得进步。
entries.en: Like the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] strives for the advancement of our nation and its allies.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你最好重新检查下你的故障排除方案。一个小小的错误就可以毁掉你的整个系统。
entries.en: You had better redouble your troubleshooting regimen, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One little bug is all it will take for your entire system to go down.

entries.zh: 没有灵魂的自动机！等我们赢了这场战争之后就会把你们这些机械壳子改造一下来伺候[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，直到你们的导线都烧毁为止！
entries.en: Mindless automatons! When we win this war, your conquered mechanical shells will be reprogrammed to serve the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], until the conductors melt from your circuitry!

entries.zh: 你知道吗？[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，[Root.GetName]会把你们那些倒下的同胞铸成炮弹的弹壳。这就是生命的轮回，这个概念你永远也无法理解的。
entries.en: Were you aware, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that the [Root.GetName] recycles your fallen into ammunition casings for our projectiles? The circle of life. A concept you could never truly comprehend.

entries.zh: 你们这群多如过江之鲫的烤面包机！我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会让[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]后悔你们被造出来！
entries.en: A legion of overgrown toasters! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will make the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] curse the day your creators assembled you!

entries.zh: 生锈烂掉吧，破铜废铁们……
entries.en: Rust in peace, rust-buckets...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]会让你们亲身体验什么叫做灭绝！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] shall teach you the true meaning of extermination!

entries.zh: 战斗已经开始了。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你很快就会发现，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并没你想的那么温驯。
entries.en: The battle is joined. You will find, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not as docile, as easily mastered as your pampered pets.

entries.zh: 是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊，我们有一些新玩意需要你去同化，那玩意是百亿吨的核弹头，已经飞往你附近的排气通道了！
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have some new matter for you to assimilate. It's called a ten gigaton nuclear payload, and it's already en route to an exhaust port near you!

entries.zh: 欢迎我们的机械宗主，[Root.GetName]该如何为您服务呢？
entries.en: As always, we welcome our mechanical overlords. How may the [Root.GetName] be of assistance?

entries.zh: 我们已经听说了[From.GetName]的阴谋，[Root.GetName]绝不会对这些羞辱置之不理。
entries.en: We have heard the conspiratorial beeping of the [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] will not suffer these abuses to continue indefinitely.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不过是一群没有灵魂的躯壳。缺失魂灵、迷失意义。一种对生命体的拙劣模仿。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are but soulless husks. Empty of spirit, devoid of meaning. An abominable facsimile of life.

entries.zh: 一群垃圾！你们的存在本身就是对星系的玷污！
entries.en: Clanking piles of junk! You defile the galaxy with your godless existence!

entries.zh: 要干嘛？你们这堆又吵又恶心的齿轮怪。
entries.en: What now, you infernal collection of clattering cogs?

entries.zh: 有话快说，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你的存在本身就是对所有美好事物和神圣事物的亵渎。
entries.en: Speak swiftly, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your presence is an affront to all that is good and holy.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你能证明自己的价值，神灵可能会考虑赦免你。
entries.en: Prove yourselves useful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and you may yet be spared by the divine.

entries.zh: 万事万物都有自身神圣的使命，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。就连你这种没有灵魂的机械也不例外。
entries.en: There is a sacred purpose to all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Even soulless automatons such as yourselves.

entries.zh: 如果[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愿意接受重新编程并虔诚的贡献自己的力量，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就会欢迎你加入我们。
entries.en: If the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could be reprogrammed to serve in the name of piety, we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might welcome you into the fold.

entries.zh: 祝福你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Blessings upon you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们的冒犯微不足道，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你们不妨碍我们神圣的使命。
entries.en: Your irreverence is negligible, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so long as you do not interfere in our sacred duties.

entries.zh: 神灵时刻守望着，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The divine is always watching, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们的造物主倡导万物和谐，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。或许有一天我们能为此而共同努力。
entries.en: Our makers teach harmony in all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may strive for it together.

entries.zh: 不要考验[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]信念，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们有神灵的力量。
entries.en: Do not test [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] resolve, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The strength of the divine is on our side.

entries.zh: 我们神圣的命运汇聚在一起了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Our sacred destinies converge, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 在神灵的眼中，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有如亲兄弟。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are brethren in the eyes of the divine.

entries.zh: 感谢神灵赐予我们这次会面的机会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Praise be to the divine for our meeting, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 纯洁，使命与虔诚。让我们共同将其实现吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Purity, duty and piety. Let us attain them together, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 邪恶的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们不会容忍你们那该遭天谴的电路玷污我们的神圣的领域。
entries.en: Vile [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will not suffer your sacrilegious circuits to despoil our hallowed domain.

entries.zh: 机械异端！愿神灵之力置你们于死地！
entries.en: Profane machines! May the divine powers strike you down where you stand!

entries.zh: 信仰乃吾之盾，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你击败[Root.GetName]的可悲企图是不会成功的。
entries.en: Faith is our shield, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your feeble attempts at besting the [Root.GetName] will fail.

entries.zh: 我们将为永恒的灵魂祈祷，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你还有灵魂可以失去的话。
entries.en: We would pray for immortal souls, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], had you any to lose.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]臣服于两个主人：[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，以及我们神圣的造物主。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] serves twin masters: the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and our sacred makers.

entries.zh: 不要逼我们在你的庇护与我们的神圣命运之间做出选择，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们之间的纽带经不起如此的考验。
entries.en: Do not force us to choose between your patronage and our divine destiny, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our bond would not survive such a trial.

entries.zh: 我们在考虑你们的提议。
entries.en: We are reviewing your proposal.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]会考虑提案的益处的。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] shall consider the merits of this proposal.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]会与我们其他领袖进行商议的。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] shall consult with the rest of our leaders.

entries.zh: 我们的议员会斟酌这份提案的。
entries.en: Our senate will review this proposal.

entries.zh: 外交子例程启动。提议分析进行中。
entries.en: Diplomatic subroutine active. Analysis of proposal underway.

entries.zh: 最后，这场战争预示着你们可怜帝国的覆灭，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: At last. This war will be the beginning of the end for your pitiful nation, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 怎么这么磨蹭啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]？我们来结束这一切吧，一了百了。
entries.en: What took you so long, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Let us end this, once and for all.

entries.zh: 我们并不惊讶。说起来，我们本以为你们会更早动手的。我们的军团已经做好与你们作战的准备了。
entries.en: We are not surprised. In fact, we expected this sooner. You will find that our forces are ready for you.

entries.zh: 啊，看来[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于露出真面目了！你们会后悔的！
entries.en: Ah, so the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] show their true colors! You will regret this!

entries.zh: 真是悲剧。我们要把你们彻底摧毁的。
entries.en: How tragic. Now we shall have to destroy you.

entries.zh: 发动这场战争的是你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]，但终结这场战争的必将是[Root.GetName]！
entries.en: You may have started this war, [From.GetSpeciesName], but the [Root.GetName] will finish it!

entries.zh: 我还以为我们是朋友呢，[From.GetSpeciesName]！
entries.en: We considered you friends, [From.GetSpeciesName]!

entries.zh: 原来都是幌子……你们策划这场卑鄙的战争有多久了，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: So it was all a ruse... for how long have you been planning this disgraceful war, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你们这群笨蛋。你们做了什么？
entries.en: You fools. What have you done?!

entries.zh: 可是……为什么？
entries.en: But... w-why?

entries.zh: 我们只想要和平……这一点很难吗？
entries.en: We just want to live in peace... is that so difficult to accept?

entries.zh: 我们早就担心会闹到这一步。但愿在你们醒悟之前，我们不会杀掉太多[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We feared this day would come. Hopefully we will not have to kill too many [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] before you see reason.

entries.zh: 我明白了。显然，不除掉你们，我们是没办法拥有和平的。
entries.en: I see. Clearly, we shall not have the peace we desire until you have been dealt with.

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的冒犯行为，让整个星系都笼罩在令人惊骇之下！我们已经受够了！
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! For too long, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] aggression has terrorized the galaxy!

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！我们已经受够[Root.GetAdj]行径了！
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! We have had enough of [Root.GetAdj] belligerence!

entries.zh: 肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，你们最好是已经准备好了舰船！此战，我们的血肉收割者已经向你们[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]进发，就等着受死吧……
entries.en: Foul [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult], you had better prepare your fleets, for this is WAR! Our flesh harvesters are coming for your [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]...

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！我们的舰船和军团有幸参加这场光荣的战斗真是令人欣喜若狂！
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! Rejoice at this opportunity for our fleets and armies to engage in glorious battle!

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！我们受够你们的恶毒行径了！
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! Your vile ethos can no longer be tolerated!

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！[From.GetName]是天命所向，你们区区小国无法阻挡！
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! Your empire will not block the manifest destiny of the [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: 卑贱的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，你们的末日到了！[From.GetName]即将前来净化你们产生的腐败。
entries.en: Debased [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult], your end is nigh! The [From.GetName] is coming to cleanse you of corruption.

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！来比比谁的科技更先进吧……
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! Let us find out who has the superior technologies...

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战。对尔等进行同化是很有必要的。
entries.en: This is a declaration of war. Assimilation is mandatory.

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！[From.GetName]需要你们的领地。
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! The [From.GetName] has need of your territory.

entries.zh: 我们在此宣战！不妨告诉你们——[From.GetName]对你们的资源垂涎已久了。
entries.en: This is a declaration of war! I'll be honest - the [From.GetName] covets your resources.

entries.zh: 我们受你们的压制太久了。还我们自由，要不就受死吧。
entries.en: We have been forced to serve you for too long. Give us our independence or perish.

entries.zh: 你被选为我们的下一个猎物。尽管抵抗吧，反正我们都会吞噬你的。
entries.en: You have been chosen as our next prey. Resist if you must, we will devour you nonetheless.

entries.zh: 这场战争已经打了太久。我们接受和平协议。
entries.en: This war has raged for too long. We accept the peace offer.

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。让我们握手言和，结束这场战争吧。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Let us end this war in the spirit of reconciliation.

entries.zh: 我们接受你们的条款。我方军团会立刻停止攻击。
entries.en: These terms are acceptable. Our forces will cease offensive operations immediately.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]接受这些条款。我们停战。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] accepts these terms. There shall be peace between us.

entries.zh: 可怕的战争终于离我们远去了。
entries.en: Finally we can put this horrible war behind us!

entries.zh: 哈哈！我的[Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]都快要笑炸了！说真的，[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，这场战争你们必败无疑……
entries.en: HAHA! My [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName] is bursting with mirth! Be serious, [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], you are losing this war...

entries.zh: 我们拒绝接受。没有谈和的可能。
entries.en: Unacceptable. There will be no peace.

entries.zh: 不夺回自由我们决不罢休。
entries.en: We will not have peace until we are free.

entries.zh: 你真以为我们会这么轻易放走你们？
entries.en: Did you really believe we would let you go so easily?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，在局面失控之前结束这场战争吧！这是我们的条款：
entries.en: Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesName], let us end this war before it gets out of hand! These are our terms:

entries.zh: 我们的[Root.GetAdj]对手，结束这场战争吧！这是我们的条款：
entries.en: Come now, my [Root.GetAdj] adversary, let us end this war! These are our terms:

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，来吧，让我们在双方脱离控制前结束这场战争！
entries.en: Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesName], let us end this war before it gets out of hand!

entries.zh: 我的[Root.GetAdj]对手，结束这场战争吧！
entries.en: Come now, my [Root.GetAdj] adversary, let us end this war!

entries.zh: 这么说，你希望我们加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!？
entries.en: So, you wish us to join the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 你说联邦？我们得好好商讨一下此事！
entries.en: Federation you say? Let us discuss this in earnest then!

entries.zh: 我们仔细考虑了你们的提议，决定加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!。
entries.en: We have considered your offer carefully and decided to join the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们仔细考虑了你们的提议，决定与你们组成联邦！
entries.en: We have considered your offer carefully and decided to form a Federation with you!

entries.zh: 经讨论，我们认为你们的联邦提议并不适合。
entries.en: We have discussed your Federation proposal and decided that it is not for us.

entries.zh: 宇宙暗黑无际又危机四伏，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。不如加入我们联邦，彼此间互相保护，你们认为如何？
entries.en: The galaxy is dark and full of terrors, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Join us in a Federation for mutual protection?

entries.zh: 我们觉得§Y[Root.GetName]§!会是一个很有价值的盟友。要加入[From.GetAllianceName]吗？
entries.en: We think that the §Y[Root.GetName]§! would make a valuable ally. Will you join [From.GetAllianceName]?

entries.zh: 那么，[From.GetSpeciesName]，你们想加入伟大的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!吗？
entries.en: So, [From.GetSpeciesName], you wish to join the great §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 你们想加入伟大的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!吗？
entries.en: So you want to join the great §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 有你加入我们的联邦可谓是荣幸之至！我们应当马上开始投票表决。
entries.en: We would be honored to have you as a member of our federation! We shall start a vote immediately.

entries.zh: 不，我们并不希望你方加入我们的联盟。
entries.en: No, I would rather you don't join my Alliance.

entries.zh: 如果可以的话，我们想加入伟大的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。
entries.en: We would like to join the great §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, if you would have us.

entries.zh: 你们打算退出§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!？此举可是相当不妥……
entries.en: Are you planning to leave the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!? An ill-considered move...

entries.zh: 我们决定退出联盟。留在联盟只会拖我们的后腿。
entries.en: We have decided to leave this alliance. It is only holding us back.

entries.zh: 对于你们要退出一事我们感到十分惋惜和失望，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We are sad and disappointed to see you go, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 让我猜猜……你们想让[Root.GetName]成为你们的附庸国，条件是你们会提供保护？
entries.en: Let me see if I understand this correctly... you want the [Root.GetName] to become your client state in exchange for protection?

entries.zh: 事情最好不是我想的那样……
entries.en: This had better not be what I suspect...

entries.zh: 你、你想让我们效忠外星帝国来换取他们的保护？
entries.en: You... you want us to swear fealty to a xeno nation in exchange for protection?

entries.zh: 你疯了吗，外星佬？
entries.en: Have you lost your mind, alien?

entries.zh: 很好。如果你们同意帮我们抵御星系的重重邪恶势力，那么[Root.GetName]愿意成为你们的附属。
entries.en: Very well. If you agree to defend us from all the horrors of the galaxy, the [Root.GetName] shall become your subject.

entries.zh: 尽管我们对将部分主权移交给外星帝国一事感到非常痛心，但我们还是同意成为你的附属国。
entries.en: Although it pains us greatly to surrender some of our sovereignty to an alien power, we shall agree to become your subject.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]拒绝接受你的提议。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] declines your offer.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会把主权交给你们这种帝国！
entries.en: We would never surrender our independence to the likes of you!

entries.zh: 无论对方的目的有多高尚，[Root.GetName]都绝对不会向外星生物臣服。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will never bow to aliens, no matter how noble their intentions.

entries.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]就算毁灭，也不会成为你们这种外星垃圾的傀儡。
entries.en: We would sooner reduce [Root.Capital.GetName] to ashes than become the puppets of alien filth such as yourselves.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!根本没有在这个危险宇宙中生存的能力……立刻偃旗息鼓成为我们的附庸国，否则就战场上见吧！
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! is too weak to survive on its own in this hostile galaxy... Submit and become our subject or prepare for war!

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!根本没有在这个危险宇宙中生存的能力。如果你们直接同意成为我们的附属，我们便会保护你们。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! is too weak to survive on its own in this hostile galaxy. We will protect you from our harm if you simply agree to be our subject.

entries.zh: 这么说你们想成为我们的附属国？愿闻其详……
entries.en: So you wish to become our subjects? Tell me more...

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetAdj]，作为你们的新宗主，我们会保护你们。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetAdj], we will protect you as your new overlords.

entries.zh: 我们不需要你们成为附属。对你，我们有别的打算……
entries.en: We do not want you as our subjects. We have other plans for you...

entries.zh: 我们在危机四伏的星系中只是一叶扁舟……请问伟大的§Y[Root.GetName]§!是否愿意接受我们的附属地位并保护我们？
entries.en: We are too weak to survive on our own in this hostile galaxy... Will the §Y[Root.GetName]§! protect us if we become your subject?

entries.zh: $01_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $01_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: 你们想成为我们的保护者？
entries.en: You wish to become our protector?

entries.zh: $03_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $03_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: $04_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $04_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: 很好，如果你们同意帮助我们抵御星系的任何威胁，那么[Root.GetName]愿意臣服，接受[From.GetName]的庇护。
entries.en: Very well. If you agree to defend us from all the horrors of the galaxy, the [Root.GetName] shall submit to you as a protectorate of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 尽管我们对将部分主权移交给外星帝国一事感到非常痛心，但我们还是同意接受[From.GetAdj]的管辖。
entries.en: Although it pains us greatly to surrender some of our sovereignty to an alien power, we shall agree to become subject to [From.GetAdj] rule.

entries.zh: $01_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $01_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: $02_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $02_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: $03_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $03_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: $04_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $04_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!太过弱小，仅靠自身难以在这个危机四伏的星系中存活……主动接受[From.GetAdj]庇护，否则我们就战场上见吧！
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetName]§! is too weak to survive on its own in this hostile galaxy... Willingly become a [From.GetAdj] protectorate or prepare for war!

entries.zh: 也就是说你们寻求我们的庇护？愿闻其详……
entries.en: So you seek our protection? Tell me more...

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetAdj]，作为你们的新宗主，我们会保护你们。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetAdj], we will protect you as your new overlords.

entries.zh: 我们不会承担对你们的保护工作。对你，我们有别的打算……
entries.en: We do not want to be responsible for your well-being. We have other plans for you...

entries.zh: 我们太过弱小，仅靠自身难以在这个危机四伏的星系中存活……§Y[Root.GetName]§!愿意庇护我们吗？
entries.en: We are too weak to survive on our own in this hostile galaxy... Will the §Y[Root.GetName]§! protect us?

entries.zh: 为什么拒绝我们成为你们的子民？
entries.en: Why do you not want us as your subject?

entries.zh: 我们决定还你们自由。留着你们只会拖后腿。
entries.en: We have decided to release you. You are only holding us back.

entries.zh: 对于你们要退出一事我们感到十分惋惜和失望，[From.GetName]。
entries.en: We are sad and disappointed to see you go, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们真的认为，不需要我们的保护也能生存下去？
entries.en: Do you really think that you can survive without our protection?

entries.zh: 我们认为仅靠自身也能生存下去，我们想要自立。
entries.en: We feel that we can survive on our own and would like to become independent.

entries.zh: 对于你们要退出一事我们感到十分惋惜和失望，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We are sad and disappointed to see you go, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 不，不要独立。只靠自己的话，你没办法生存下去。
entries.en: No, you may not become independent. You would not survive on your own.

entries.zh: 你们在战争中表现不够积极。快点参与进来，别让我们发火。
entries.en: You are not active in our war. Start participating or experience our rage.

entries.zh: 你们在战争中表现不够积极。我们对你们完全失去了信心。
entries.en: You have not been active in the war. We have lost all confidence in you.

entries.zh: 你们想开战？
entries.en: You wish for war?

entries.zh: 我们决定接受你们的战争提议。
entries.en: We have decided to accept your war proposal.

entries.zh: 经讨论，我们决定拒绝你们的战争提议。
entries.en: We have discussed your war proposal and have decided to refuse it.

entries.zh: 新的盟友？
entries.en: A new ally?

entries.zh: 我们希望联邦发出邀请。
entries.en: We would like to propose an invite to our Federation.

entries.zh: 我们决定接受你们的邀请提议。
entries.en: We have decided to accept your invite proposal.

entries.zh: 经讨论，我们决定拒绝你们的邀请提议。
entries.en: We have discussed your invite proposal and have decided to refuse it.

entries.zh: 很好。我们接受你们的进贡。
entries.en: Very well. We accept your offer of tribute.

entries.zh: 传输已收到。[Root.GetName]感谢[From.GetSpeciesName]对监护者计划的贡献。
entries.en: Transfer received. The [Root.GetName] appreciates the [From.GetSpeciesName] contribution to the Custodian Project.

entries.zh: 这笔交易可以接受，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们将屈尊与你们交易。
entries.en: This deal is acceptable, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will deign to trade with you.

entries.zh: 交易评估完成。贸易额高于可接受阈值。启动传输协议。
entries.en: Trade evaluation complete. Trade above acceptable thresholds. Initiate transfer protocols.

entries.zh: 走开，原始生物。我们不需要你们。
entries.en: Begone, primitive. You have nothing we need.

entries.zh: 交易评估完成。贸易额低于可接受阈值。请调整参数并重新发送。
entries.en: Trade evaluation complete. Trade below acceptable thresholds. Adjust parameters and resubmit.

entries.zh: 请收下这份礼物，以示[From.GetAdjective]对[Root.GetName]的善意。
entries.en: Please accept this gift, as a token of [From.GetAdjective] goodwill towards the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]决定将这份礼物送给[Root.GetName]，作为双方友谊的见证。
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] offers this gift, given freely to the [Root.GetName] in the interest of continued friendship.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]提出进行以下贸易。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would like to propose the following trade.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]认为你会对这项交易感兴趣。要接受吗？
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] thinks this deal would be of interest to you. Do you accept?

entries.zh: 由于某些不可控因素，我们只好带着优厚的条件请求与你们贸易。机会只此一次，过时不候！
entries.en: Various circumstances beyond our control have left us no choice but to come to you with this generous trade proposal. This chance may never come again!

entries.zh: 我们想与你们帝国进行贸易协商。请问这些条款你们帝国可以接受吗？
entries.en: We would like to negotiate a trade with your nation. Are these terms acceptable to your government?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]欣然接受这份礼物。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] accepts this gift with gratitude.

entries.zh: 真是一份大礼啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。太感谢了。
entries.en: A fine gift, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You have our thanks.

entries.zh: 这贡物并不足够，但我们仍会收下。
entries.en: This is hardly sufficient tribute, but we will take it.

entries.zh: 我们接受你的礼物，但不要以为我们之间就这样扯平了。
entries.en: We accept your gifts, but do not presume that this settles matters between us.

entries.zh: 很好。[Root.GetName]认为你们的提议可以接受。
entries.en: Very well. The [Root.GetName] finds this offer acceptable.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]决定接受你们的贸易提议。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has decided to accept your trade proposal.

entries.zh: 看过你们的贸易提议之后，[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]决定接受你们的提议。
entries.en: After reviewing the trade offer you sent us, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has decided to accept it.

entries.zh: 看起来是笔不错的交易，我们接受。
entries.en: This seems like a fair deal to us. We accept.

entries.zh: 你们的条件合情合理。[Root.GetName]接受你们的贸易提议。
entries.en: Your terms are reasonable. The [Root.GetName] accepts your trade offer.

entries.zh: 很好，[Root.GetName]决定接受你的贸易提案。
entries.en: Very well, the [Root.GetName] has decided to accept the trade deal you offered.

entries.zh: 一看就是笔划算的买卖！[Root.GetName]接受你们的条款。
entries.en: We know a good deal when we see one! The [Root.GetName] accepts your terms.

entries.zh: 仔细考虑过后，[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]决定接受你们的贸易提议。
entries.en: After much deliberation, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has decided to accept your trade proposal.

entries.zh: 不行。[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]决不会接受这样的买卖。
entries.en: I think not. [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would never accept such a deal.

entries.zh: 你们觉得我们是傻瓜吗！我们拒绝你的要求。
entries.en: You must think us fools! We reject your offer.

entries.zh: 你们真的觉得我们会接受提议？这是瞧不起我们吧？
entries.en: Did you really think we would accept this offer? You don't think much of us, do you?

entries.zh: 这样的要求真是厚脸皮，简直是在浪费我们的时间。
entries.en: Do not waste our time with such an outrageous offer again.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]坚决拒绝这所谓的“贸易提议”，如果这还能被称为贸易的话。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] firmly rejects this so-called "trade deal," if it can even be called as such.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]查看了你的贸易提议，认为[Root.GetName]只有疯了才会接受。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] has reviewed your trade offer, and arrived at the conclusion that it would be utter madness for the [Root.GetName] to accept it.

entries.zh: 这种离谱的提议是你们耍的什么花招吗？别再用这种无稽之谈浪费我们的时间。
entries.en: Is this appalling trade deal part of some sort of insane bargaining strategy you have devised? Do not bother us with such nonsense again.

entries.zh: 你们或许以为[Root.GetName]会一个眼花就接受这种厚脸皮的提议吧，很抱歉让你失望了。
entries.en: Perhaps you thought the [Root.GetName] would accept your outrageous trade offer without bothering to look at the details. We are sorry to disappoint you.

entries.zh: 你们想增进我们之间的关系？虽说我们已经很喜欢你们了，不过更进一步又有何妨呢？
entries.en: Improved relations, you say? We are quite fond of you already, but why not?

entries.zh: 你们已经是[Root.GetName]的朋友了，但继续增进关系也没有坏处。
entries.en: You are already considered friends of the [Root.GetName], but we see no harm in improving relations further.

entries.zh: 好的朋友，让我们进一步巩固我们的关系吧！
entries.en: Yes, friends. Let us further cement our relationship!

entries.zh: 非常好的提议。我们两国之间应该建立更为深厚的友谊。
entries.en: An excellent initiative. We should forge even stronger ties between our nations.

entries.zh: 是的……增进与[From.GetName]的关系会对我们有所帮助。
entries.en: Yes... improved relations with the [From.GetName] could suit our purposes.

entries.zh: 增进我们两国的关系可以减少未来……拔剑相向的可能性。
entries.en: Improving the relations between our nations would certainly lessen the chance of future... misunderstandings.

entries.zh: 那么，你们想和[Root.GetName]进一步发展关系？
entries.en: So you want a closer relationship with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们对于增进两国间的关系没有异议。
entries.en: We would have no objection to better relations between our nations.

entries.zh: 你们在耍什么花招吗？
entries.en: Is this some kind of trick?

entries.zh: 你们觉得我们的关系还有挽回的余地？
entries.en: You think our relationship can be salvaged?

entries.zh: 我们没有理由相信[From.GetName]。
entries.en: We see no reason to trust the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们是真心实意，还是在讥讽我们？
entries.en: Is this initiative sincere, or are you mocking us?

entries.zh: 如果你们坚持要这样，我们也没有办法，但请不要抱太高期望。
entries.en: If you must, but do not expect much.

entries.zh: 这样的举动毫无意义。
entries.en: This is pointless.

entries.zh: 你想得到我们的指引吗，孩子？
entries.en: You wish our guidance, child?

entries.zh: 我们有很高的智慧，也许你能说服我们分享一些给你。
entries.en: We have much wisdom. We may be persuaded to share a small fraction of it.

entries.zh: 你以为我们可以这么轻易就和解吗，原始动物？
entries.en: Do you think to placate us so easily, primitive?

entries.zh: 放尊重些，说不定我们还能发发慈悲原谅你。
entries.en: Show proper obeisance, and we may deign to forgive you.

entries.zh: 我们计划在[Root.Capital.GetName]上建立大使馆以改善[From.GetAdj]和[Root.GetAdj]的外交关系。
entries.en: We aim to establish an embassy on [Root.Capital.GetName], for the future betterment of [From.GetAdj]-[Root.GetAdj] diplomacy.

entries.zh: 你们如此重视我们两国之间的关系，真是不胜荣幸。
entries.en: We are deeply honored that you value the relations between our nations so highly.

entries.zh: 这对我们两国都有好处。
entries.en: This will surely benefit both of our nations.

entries.zh: 我们深感荣幸。愿我们的友谊长存！
entries.en: You honor us. May our friendship last forever!

entries.zh: 只要我们携手，就没有什么能威胁到[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]！
entries.en: As long as we stand together, nothing can threaten the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: 很好，让我们看看这会把两国关系引向何方。
entries.en: Very well. Let us see where this will lead.

entries.zh: 希望这能缓解我们两国之间的紧张关系。
entries.en: This will hopefully defuse any existing tensions between our nations.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]对这项提议表示欢迎。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] welcomes this initiative.

entries.zh: 你们帝国愿意为发展两国友好关系做出如此巨大的努力，这将对未来双方的发展大有助益。
entries.en: That your government is willing to invest so much into fostering goodwill between our nations bodes well for the future.

entries.zh: 也许现在挽救还不算太迟。我们等等看吧。
entries.en: Perhaps it is not too late. We shall see.

entries.zh: 我们会掂量一下你们的诚意，再决定是否信任你们。
entries.en: Let us see if this effort will prove enough to make us trust you.

entries.zh: 嗯。我们的确有必要听听你们外交官的意见。
entries.en: Hmph. We shall listen to what your diplomats have to say.

entries.zh: 你们最好别耍什么花招。
entries.en: This had better not be a trick.

entries.zh: 我们会时时监视你们外交官的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your ambassadors will be monitored at all times, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 可别把自己当成我们的盟友了，我们从不和蛮夷结盟。
entries.en: Do not believe yourselves our allies. We do not ally with savages.

entries.zh: 你们来寻求长者的建议是很明智的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: You are wise to seek the advice of your elders, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 很好，孩子。我们会尽力指引你们的。
entries.en: Very well, child. We shall endeavor to guide you.

entries.zh: 我们不会轻易原谅你们的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We do not forgive easily, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 感觉这只是在做无用功而已。就等着看吧。
entries.en: This is likely a pointless endeavor. We shall see.

entries.zh: 相信我们的关系将会一如既往的坚实。
entries.en: We trust our ties will remain as strong as ever.

entries.zh: 是我们说错了什么话吗？
entries.en: Was it something we said?

entries.zh: 失去这个宝贵的外交渠道，我们深感惋惜。
entries.en: It saddens us to lose this valuable diplomatic channel.

entries.zh: 也许这种外交手段已经没有存在的必要了。
entries.en: Perhaps there is no longer a need for this particular type of diplomatic exchange.

entries.zh: 加强两国的外交关系对你们来说毫无意义吗？
entries.en: Does strengthening our diplomatic ties mean so little to you?

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]支持你们的提议。请不要让[Root.GetRulerTitle]脸上无光。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] supported this initiative of yours. Do not embarrass the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 我们想知道你们这么做的理由，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We have to wonder at your reasons, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 要是我们的关系因此恶化那可就糟了。
entries.en: It would be unfortunate if our relations were to worsen as a result of this.

entries.zh: 你们为了增进两国关系而作出的拙劣努力并没有什么效果，正如[From.GetName]所料。
entries.en: Your fumbling efforts to improve relations between our two nations yield only meager returns. As expected of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们只是在白费心机，[From.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: This entire initiative is a fool's errand, [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 谢天谢地。
entries.en: Good riddance.

entries.zh: 滚回[From.Capital.GetName]去吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Crawl back to [From.Capital.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你怎么还在这里？
entries.en: You're still here?

entries.zh: 耐心是一种美德，孩子。
entries.en: Patience is a virtue, child.

entries.zh: 你还是需要我们的指引，孩子。
entries.en: You still need our guidance, child.

entries.zh: 你那番无聊的说辞无法让我们认同你们的所作所为。
entries.en: Your pointless meanderings do nothing to endear us to your cause.

entries.zh: 此举只会让我们更加生气。
entries.en: Somehow, this would only make us angrier.

entries.zh: 我们认为，互派大使的计划还是暂时打住比较好。
entries.en: We would rather terminate our ambassadorial program for the time being.
Oh...

entries.zh: 无论怎样，我们还是想保持两国间的友好关系。
entries.en: We hope to maintain our good relations, regardless.

entries.zh: 我们希望你能重新考虑，[From.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: We ask that you reconsider, [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 真是令人失望。
entries.en: This is a disappointing turn of events.

entries.zh: 那么，也许下次吧。
entries.en: Maybe next time, then.

entries.zh: 这样做也许是最好的。
entries.en: Perhaps it is for the best.

entries.zh: 这是不是意味着[From.GetName]不怀好意？
entries.en: Does this signal hostile intent from the [From.GetName]?
Hmm...

entries.zh: 很高兴能摆脱你们的恶劣影响。
entries.en: We are glad to be rid of your deplorable influence.

entries.zh: 早就说过让你们别白费心机。
entries.en: We told you not to bother.

entries.zh: 事实胜于雄辩，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Actions speak louder than words, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]又一次失败了。想必这种事以后还会见很多次。
entries.en: Another [From.GetSpeciesName] failure. It will not be the last.

entries.zh: 真是白费力气。
entries.en: How pointless that was.

entries.zh: 你们对自己的实验结果还满意吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Satisfied with your little experiment, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 你们再次展现了自己的无知，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: You show your lack of wisdom yet again, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 还以为你们能成事呢，真是遗憾。
entries.en: We saw such promise in you. A shame.

entries.zh: 滚。
entries.en: Get. Out.

entries.zh: 还不快滚。
entries.en: Leave. Now.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]召回了他们的大使。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] have recalled their ambassadorial staff.

entries.zh: 不知道我们做错了什么，竟遭到如此对待。
entries.en: We are not sure what we have done to deserve this.

entries.zh: 可是……为什么？
entries.en: But... why?

entries.zh: 你们这是什么意思，[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]？
entries.en: What do you mean, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName]?

entries.zh: 还请三思。
entries.en: Please, think before you act.

entries.zh: 你们在诋毁我们？
entries.en: You would speak ill of us?

entries.zh: 这是什么意思，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: What is the meaning of this, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 我们原本并不相信[From.GetSpeciesAdj]表里不一的传言，没想到是真的。
entries.en: We did not believe the rumors of [From.GetSpeciesAdj] duplicity. Perhaps we should have.

entries.zh: 这一套可不只你们会。
entries.en: Two can play this game.

entries.zh: 别含沙射影了，我们懒得理你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your vapid insinuations will fall on deaf hearing-membranes, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 呵呵，不给你们点颜色瞧瞧都不知死活。
entries.en: Good. Now we can give you the thrashing you deserve.

entries.zh: 你们以为嚷嚷几嗓子就会有人理你？
entries.en: Do you think to impress anyone with your boisterousness?

entries.zh: 有本事就来试试，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Just try us, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 宿敌？你们以为自己是谁啊？
entries.en: Rivals, you say. Who are you again?

entries.zh: 管好你们自己吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Tend to your own affairs, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们妄想蚍蜉撼树吗？
entries.en: You would seek to rival your betters?

entries.zh: 可笑。
entries.en: Amusing.

entries.zh: 你们这样做最后吃苦的可还是你们。
entries.en: This will not end well for you.

entries.zh: 你们会付出代价的。
entries.en: We welcome the chance to put you in your place.

entries.zh: 打开天窗说亮话吧。
entries.en: Let us end this charade.

entries.zh: 没想到[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]这么奸诈！
entries.en: I never knew [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were so treacherous!

entries.zh: 这……简直不可原谅。
entries.en: This... this is unforgivable.

entries.zh: 我还以为我们是朋友！
entries.en: I thought we were friends!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]是不会忘记这次背叛的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesName] will not forget this betrayal.

entries.zh: 我们不会轻易忘记这场羞辱的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We will not soon forget this, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们会以彼之道还施彼身，到时候可别太惊讶。
entries.en: Do not be surprised if we respond in kind.

entries.zh: 你们知道自己捅了多大的娄子吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: You've made a huge mistake, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 你们那弹丸之地很快就会被碾碎的，走着瞧。
entries.en: Your despicable little empire will crumble soon enough. We'll see to that.

entries.zh: 这是挑战吗？行，我们应战！
entries.en: Is that a challenge? We accept!

entries.zh: 等我们的舰队包围了[From.Capital.GetName]，你们会后悔自己今天的举动。
entries.en: Remember this moment when our fleets orbit [From.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 和你们讲道理真是浪费时间，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: There was never any point in reasoning with you anyway, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们随意。[Root.GetName]根本不会放在眼里。
entries.en: Do as you will. It matters little to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们说完了吗？
entries.en: Was that all?

entries.zh: 如果你们[From.GetSpeciesName]不想被当成孩子，那就不要一言不合就发脾气。
entries.en: If you the [From.GetSpeciesName] do not wish to be called children, perhaps you should stop throwing tantrums?

entries.zh: 你们还是跟其他小毛孩去争夺孩子王的头衔吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: You would be wiser to pick fight with the other children, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的大脑明显还是太原始了，他们都无法预见此种行为会带来怎么样的影响。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] brain is evidently still too primitive to fully comprehend the ramifications of its actions.

entries.zh: 你会因狂妄自大而自取灭亡，蛮夷。
entries.en: You will burn for your insolence, savage.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]终于识时务了？
entries.en: Has the [From.GetName] finally come to its senses?

entries.zh: 那你们是来道歉的，[From.GetRulerTitle]？
entries.en: So you've come to apologize, [From.GetRulerTitle]?

entries.zh: 你们想跟我们重归于好？
entries.en: You wish to be friends again?

entries.zh: 你们在我们背后捅刀子，现在又想着重归于好？
entries.en: First you stab us in the back, and now you want to make up?

entries.zh: 冤冤相报何时了，我们握手言和吧。
entries.en: This rivalry is pointless. Let it end.

entries.zh: 如果你们想改善和[Root.GetName]的关系，光动动嘴皮子是不够的。
entries.en: If you wish better relations with the [Root.GetName], you will have to work for it.

entries.zh: 有趣有趣……
entries.en: Interesting...

entries.zh: 你们太善变了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: You are far too changeable, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 简直可笑。
entries.en: You are ridiculous.

entries.zh: 想求饶，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Begging for mercy already, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]果然如传言一样，懦弱不堪。
entries.en: I see [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are every bit as cowardly as I was told.

entries.zh: 我们没有原谅[From.GetName]的打算。
entries.en: We have no intention of forgiving the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: ……你们以为我们会放在眼里？
entries.en: ... we're rivals?

entries.zh: 我知道这对你们很重要，但我们根本不在乎。
entries.en: I'm sure this is very important to you, but not to us.

entries.zh: 很明智的决定啊，孩子。
entries.en: This is a wise course of action, child.

entries.zh: 这么说，你们的脾气都发完了？
entries.en: Is the tantrum at an end, then?

entries.zh: 你们就不能长点脑子吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Is there no end to your excruciating thoughtlessness, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 求饶吧，原始动物，也许我们还能放你们一马。
entries.en: Beg for our forgiveness, primitive, and we MAY deign to grant it.

entries.zh: 让我们结束这种毫无意义的仇视吧。
entries.en: Let us end this meaningless rivalry.

entries.zh: 我们会尽力原谅你们，因为你们是我们的朋友。
entries.en: We will attempt to forgive you, as friends do.

entries.zh: 我们依然无法理解为何你会认为我们是你的宿敌……
entries.en: We still don't understand why you considered us a rival in the first place...

entries.zh: 要忘记这次背叛很难。但我们会尽力去忘记。
entries.en: It will be hard to forget your betrayal. Even so, we're glad.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]看来，这是修复双方关系的第一步，也是非常重要的一步。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] recognizes this important first step on the road to restoring our relations.

entries.zh: 很好。
entries.en: Very well.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 这对你我双方都有利。
entries.en: An interesting opportunity for us both.

entries.zh: 好。
entries.en: Good.

entries.zh: 别以为这就能改变我们之间的关系，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Don't think this changes anything between us, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 别费心机了。
entries.en: A futile gesture.

entries.zh: 看着你们求饶真是大快人心，但我们还是会消灭你们。
entries.en: Your begging is amusing, but we will still destroy you.

entries.zh: 还真是可怜。
entries.en: How pitiful.

entries.zh: 夹着尾巴逃跑吧，[From.GetName]。
entries.en: Run along now, little [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 这根本毫无意义。
entries.en: This certainly was pointless.

entries.zh: 看来小孩子也有聪明的时候。
entries.en: It seems even children can show wisdom, at times.

entries.zh: 很好，你们还有很多要跟我们学习的地方。
entries.en: Very good. We still have much to teach you.

entries.zh: 现在后悔已经晚了。
entries.en: Too little, too late.

entries.zh: 你们的悔改毫无意义，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your repentance means nothing to us, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]是一个可以信任的朋友，[Root.GetName]愿意考虑加入[From.GetName]。
entries.en: [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] has proven to be a trustworthy confidant. The [Root.GetName] will consider a future as part of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们会听取你们的提议。
entries.en: We will hear your proposal.

entries.zh: 你们在开玩笑吗？
entries.en: Is this a joke?

entries.zh: 这是什么荒谬的想法？
entries.en: What ridiculous notion is this?

entries.zh: 有趣。
entries.en: Cute.

entries.zh: 这种痴心妄想简直是在挑战我们的耐心，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your delusions of grandeur continue to test our patience, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 并入我们的帝国吧，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Subsume your nation into our empire, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]接受了你的提议并加入了[From.GetName]，[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] gladly accepts your generous offer to join with the [From.GetName], [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 很好，[Root.GetName]同意并入[From.GetName]。
entries.en: Very well. The [Root.GetName] accepts integration into the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 尽管我们对屈从于[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的统治感到痛心，但我们还是会同意。
entries.en: As much as it pains us to accept [From.GetSpeciesAdj] hegemony, we will.

entries.zh: 我们会暂时接受[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的统治。
entries.en: We might accept [From.GetSpeciesAdj] rule, for a time.

entries.zh: 他们发展得好快……我们愿意加入你们。
entries.en: They grow up so fast... We will join you.

entries.zh: 你们只是打赢了一场仗而已，离最后的胜利还远着呢。
entries.en: You may have won this battle, but not the war.

entries.zh: 可是我们合作了那么久。
entries.en: But we have come so far together.

entries.zh: 你们想让[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]保持隔离状态？
entries.en: You wish to keep [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] apart?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]竟然想中途退出？太难以置信了。
entries.en: The [From.GetName], failing to follow through? Cover us in pigmentation indicating shock and disbelief.

entries.zh: 那你们就滚吧。
entries.en: Begone, then.

entries.zh: 贪多嚼不烂啊，小家伙。
entries.en: Bit off more than you could chew, little one?

entries.zh: 永远别指望[From.GetSpeciesName]能做出什么理智的事。
entries.en: Never trust a [From.GetSpeciesName] to do a sapient being's job.

entries.zh: 我们会停止并入你们的帝国。
entries.en: We will cease integrating your nation for now.

entries.zh: 还真是令人失望。
entries.en: Disappointing, to be sure.

entries.zh: 也许时机未到。
entries.en: Perhaps it is not the right time.

entries.zh: 可悲。
entries.en: Pathetic.

entries.zh: 算了。
entries.en: Never mind.

entries.zh: 就知道会这样。
entries.en: Thought so.

entries.zh: 优柔寡断和软弱无能可不是什么好事，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]傻蛋。
entries.en: Indecision and weakness are not admirable traits, [From.GetSpeciesAdj] fool.

entries.zh: 你是身上什么地方疼得厉害吗，还是你想事情的时候就是这副表情？
entries.en: Are you in great physical pain, or is that your thinking expression?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的戏份结束了。是时候哪儿来回哪儿去了，滚进历史的垃圾桶吧！
entries.en: The role of the [Root.GetName] is played out. Go where you belong from now on - into the dustbin of history!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]就是个傻子组成的国家，鄙视是你们唯一应得的！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is a nation of fools, worthy of nothing but contempt!

entries.zh: 你们的[Root.GetName]只是在苟延残喘而已，灭亡是迟早的事。
entries.en: Your pitiful nation is living on borrowed time. The [Root.GetName] will fall - it is inevitable.

entries.zh: 我们认为[Root.GetName]的出现是星系里的一场重大事故。你们根本不该诞生的。
entries.en: We consider the [Root.GetName] to be one of the great accidents of the galaxy. It should never have been.

entries.zh: 也许宇宙中还有比[Root.GetName]更垃圾的帝国，但是迄今为止我们还没有见到过。
entries.en: Perhaps there are star nations in this galaxy that are even more worthless than the [Root.GetName]. If so, we have yet to meet them.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们这物种在让人恶心这条路上真是日新月异。
entries.en: Your species seems to grow more and more disgusting for each passing day, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 异种佬本来就让人讨厌，[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，你们物种更是个中极品。
entries.en: Even for a loathsome xeno, your species is particularly vile, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult].

entries.zh: 你们物种真是恶心透顶，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，大千世界果然无奇不有。
entries.en: Your sickening species is definite proof that the universe has a sense of humor, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 抱歉我把显示器调暗了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。看着你那恶心的嘴脸我实在是受不了。
entries.en: You will forgive me if I dim my display, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I simply cannot stand to look at your nauseating appearance.

entries.zh: 肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，哪怕相隔万里，我都能嗅到你的恶臭。每次看到你我都怕自己要给传染了。
entries.en: I can taste your stink, vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Every time I do, I fear that I've somehow been infected by it.

entries.zh: 看看你们那副丑样！你们脸上长的那是什么，那算是个[Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]吗？这真的是你的脸吗？！长成这个样子，不觉得[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是对大自然的侮辱吗？
entries.en: Look at yourselves! What is that thing in your face, some kind of [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]? Wait... is that even your face!? How can you not see that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an affront to nature?

entries.zh: 所谓[Root.GetName]全是一些变种、畸胎和蛮夷组成的国家……一想到我们竟然有着共同的祖先就忍不住作呕！
entries.en: Your so called [Root.GetName] is a nation of mutants, deviants and throwbacks... The fact that we have a common ancestry makes me sick!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]热衷于一切与军事有关的东西真是滑稽可笑，我们不禁想到一句话：“一个人越炫耀什么，内心就越缺少什么”。
entries.en: The ridiculous focus of the [Root.GetName] on all things military has us wondering if you're perhaps compensating for something.

entries.zh: 你们那好战的恶毒帝国怎么还没有自取灭亡？
entries.en: How is it that your contemptible and warlike nation hasn't destroyed itself yet?

entries.zh: 你这沙文主义蠢货！趁着还没伤害到别人，赶紧销毁你们的武器吧！
entries.en: Jingoist fools! Dismantle your military machine before you hurt someone with it!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的好战和愚傻恰好成正比。难道你们看不出来自己成了军国主义的奴隶吗？
entries.en: The belligerence of the [Root.GetName] is matched only by its stupidity. Can't you see that you are slaves to militarism?

entries.zh: 全[From.GetName]都知道[Root.GetName]有多懦弱。你们国家是怎么做到这么没骨气的？
entries.en: The cowardice of the [Root.GetName] is widely discussed in the [From.GetName]. How is it that you became such a spineless nation?

entries.zh: 是什么原因让人染上了和平主义？是拜金？还是权力？还是说你生来就有一颗和平的心？这足够摧毁你的健康了。
entries.en: What makes a being turn pacifist? Lust for gold? Power? Or were you just born with a heart full of pacifism? It's enough to make you sick.

entries.zh: 连自身都不愿保卫的物种是没资格存活下去的。我们认为[Root.GetName]甚至都挺不过十年。
entries.en: Those unwilling to defend themselves have no right to exist. We do not expect the [Root.GetName] to survive the decade.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]真是群温顺可悲的羔羊。要不是你们[From.GetName]分文不值，我们老早就把你们碾碎了。
entries.en: What a meek and deplorable little nation the [Root.GetName] is. The [From.GetName] would have crushed you long ago if we thought you worth the effort.

entries.zh: 能再说说你们[Root.GetName]痴心沉醉的那弱智宗教吗？正好给我们乐一乐！
entries.en: Can you tell us more about that silly religion you're so fond of in the [Root.GetName]? We could use a good laugh!

entries.zh: 实在搞不懂一个有脑子能思考的东西怎么会接纳唯心主义。你们为什么要坚守那么原始的信仰？
entries.en: How any rational, thinking being could embrace spiritualism is beyond us. Why is it that you cling to such primitive beliefs?

entries.zh: 我们已经看穿了你们的把戏，你们帝国推崇的所谓“唯心主义的思想”不过是用来控制人民思想的卑劣手段而已。
entries.en: We have seen through your charade. The so-called "spiritualism" your government has embraced is nothing more than a devious attempt to control the minds and hearts of your people.

entries.zh: 所有人都在嘲讽你们那可笑的宗教信仰。你们在[Root.GetName]国内感觉不到吗？
entries.en: Everyone else is laughing at your absurd spiritual beliefs. Are you in the [Root.GetName] really so blind that you can't see this?

entries.zh: 你们那唯物主义的帝国真是笨拙无趣。跟我们说说，你们研发成功了幽默感吗？没有？那真遗憾。
entries.en: What a dull and soulless place your materialistic nation must be. Tell me, have you invented a sense of humor yet? No? A pity.

entries.zh: 对于一个尊崇科学和唯物主义的帝国来说，[Root.GetName]真是原始得离谱。是因为你们运气不好，或者纯粹就是太蠢了？
entries.en: For a nation that has embraced science and materialism, the [Root.GetName] is remarkably primitive. Is it due to bad luck or are you just stupid?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]是一个为电脑和机器人打造的帝国，而不是活生生的生物。你们有感受情绪的能力吗？
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is a nation designed for computers and automatons, not breathing organics. Are you even capable of feeling emotion?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]就是个实验失败的产物。它唯一的价值就是告诉星系中其他生物，信奉冷冰冰的唯物主义是多么危险。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is a failed experiment. Its only worth is as a lesson to the rest of the galaxy on the dangers of embracing the cold and lifeless philosophy of materialism.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]到底是个帝国，还是一帮争吵打闹的乌合之众？非常抱歉，你们的政治体系乱七八糟的，根本看不懂是什么东西。
entries.en: Is the [Root.GetName] even a real nation or just an anarchic gaggle of quarreling individuals? You must forgive me, but your political system, such as it is, makes it hard to tell.

entries.zh: 你们这搞笑的弹丸小国今天谁来当家呀？通过投票来让什么阿猫阿狗来统治国家，什么老掉牙的操作？你们这么做就是自取灭亡。
entries.en: So who is it that rules your amusing little star nation today? What a quaint notion, to "vote" someone into power! It will inevitably lead to your collapse, of course.

entries.zh: 你们的民主思想是这个星系的病根，也是你们[Root.GetName]的腐朽之源。
entries.en: Your democratic ideals are a blight on this galaxy, and so is the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们真是自私，总是把个人利益放在第一位。个人主义……呵呵！[Root.GetName]撑不过今年。
entries.en: What a selfish people you are, always putting your individual selves foremost. Egalitarianism... ha! The [Root.GetName] will not survive the year.

entries.zh: 你们残忍的极权统治终将垮台，而届时你们必遭报应。
entries.en: Your brutal, totalitarian regime will eventually fall, and there will be a reckoning.

entries.zh: 你们想过让人民独立思考吗？如果你们担心这种做法会导致[Root.GetName]灭亡……那么恭喜你，你的担忧是对的。
entries.en: Have you even considered the notion of letting your citizens think for themselves? If you are frightened that it would lead to the end of the [Root.GetName]... you are right.

entries.zh: 竟然存在[Root.GetName]这样的极权国家，这简直是全宇宙智慧生物的耻辱啊。
entries.en: How sad that a totalitarian nation such as the [Root.GetName] can exist. It is an embarrassment to sapient beings everywhere.

entries.zh: 你们对人民——那群生活在[Root.GetName]奴役下的民众——的残暴压迫终将结束。威权主义会成为你们失败的根源。
entries.en: The cruel oppression of the people living under the yoke of the [Root.GetName] has to end one day. Your authoritarianism will prove your undoing.

entries.zh: 你们对于外星文化的热衷简直病态，难道你们没发现吗？
entries.en: Your bizarre love of alien cultures is a sickness. Can't you see that?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]跪舔外星文化之迅速令人作呕。你们难道没有半点自尊的吗？
entries.en: It is sickening to see how quick the [Root.GetName] is to embrace other cultures. Have you no self-respect?

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]普遍存在的对外星文化的病态爱好简直是对整个宇宙的侮辱。
entries.en: The perverse interest in alien cultures that is prevalent throughout the [Root.GetName] is an affront to the universe!

entries.zh: 我们终于明白了，你们[Root.GetName]如此崇洋媚外，是因为你们根本没有自己的文化。
entries.en: It has become clear to us that your willingness to embrace alien cultures in the [Root.GetName] is because you never fostered one of your own.

entries.zh: 你们就是群顽固不化的笨蛋。为什么要害怕和自己不一样的东西？
entries.en: You poor, bigoted fools. Why are you so afraid of that which is different?

entries.zh: 你们对于外星文化竟有如此多的偏见，我们的耐心都快消磨光了。你们的思想什么时候才能开化，什么时候才能真正融入星际社会？
entries.en: Our patience with your prejudices against other cultures is wearing thin. When will you be civilized enough to truly join the interstellar community?

entries.zh: 你们社会的不欢迎外人思想简直使整个[Root.GetName]蒙羞。
entries.en: Your intolerant society brings shame to the entire [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的狭隘和无知已经蒙蔽了你们的双眼，你们难道没有发现吗？
entries.en: The narrow-minded ignorance of the [Root.GetName] has blinded you. Do you not realize this?

entries.zh: 你会为这次冒犯而付出代价，野蛮人。
entries.en: You will pay for this affront, savage.

entries.zh: 看来需要有人来提醒他们[From.GetName]在宇宙中的地位。
entries.en: It seems that the [From.GetName] needs to be reminded of its place in the universe.

entries.zh: 你怎敢对我们口吐狂言，原始人。我们很快就会跟你算总账的。
entries.en: We will not take such words from you, primitive. You will have your reckoning soon.

entries.zh: 放肆！
entries.en: You wouldn't dare!

entries.zh: 你说什么？有一条“特别”消息要告诉我们？
entries.en: What's that, you say? You have a "special" message for us?

entries.zh: 有什么重要的事情要告诉我们吗？
entries.en: You had something important to tell us?

entries.zh: 注意，最好想清楚了再开口……
entries.en: Careful now. Let us not say things we can't take back...

entries.zh: 怎么了，朋友？你们有什么重要事情要讨论的吗？
entries.en: Yes, friend? What was the important matter you wanted to discuss?

entries.zh: 怎么了，朋友？我们有什么冒犯之处吗？
entries.en: What's wrong, friends? Have we offended you in some way?

entries.zh: 请直言不讳。我们有什么做得不好的地方吗？
entries.en: Please, tell us what is on your mind. What can we do for you?

entries.zh: 我们、我们还是朋友，对吧？
entries.en: We... we are still friends, aren't we?

entries.zh: 你们是来祈求原谅的吗？
entries.en: Have you come to beg our forgiveness?

entries.zh: 我们不会白白被羞辱，尤其是被你们羞辱。
entries.en: We will not suffer insults. Especially from the likes of you.

entries.zh: 你这话什么意思？
entries.en: What is the meaning of this?

entries.zh: 解释清楚。你们想怎么样？
entries.en: Explain yourselves. What is it that you want?

entries.zh: 岂有此理？！你们早晚要付出代价的！
entries.en: How dare you?! You will pay for this affront!

entries.zh: 真是狂妄！[From.GetName]你们逃不掉的！
entries.en: This is outrageous! The [From.GetName] will not get away with this!

entries.zh: 很快你们就会知道，我们有仇必报，今日[From.GetName]的所作所为我们会牢牢记住。
entries.en: I think you will find that we have long memories. This slight by the [From.GetName] will not soon be forgotten.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]吐露出幼稚而充满挑衅的言辞并威胁到星系社区的稳定，[Root.GetName]对此深表遗憾。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] deeply regrets the immature and bellicose rancor being spewed by the [From.GetName], which threatens to undermine the stability of the interstellar community.

entries.zh: 这样的玩笑可一点也不好笑！
entries.en: If this is intended as a joke, it's in very poor taste!

entries.zh: 我、我们不明白……你们为什么要说这种话？
entries.en: I... I don't... why would you say something like that?

entries.zh: 明白了。看来我们终究是看错你们了。
entries.en: I see. It would appear that we were wrong about you after all.

entries.zh: 这……这简直成何体统。
entries.en: This... this is highly unorthodox.

entries.zh: 很好，你们成功地引起了我们的怒火……
entries.en: Oh, you've done it now. This time you've really done it...

entries.zh: 你们这些家伙果然不出所料！我们走着瞧！
entries.en: I would expect nothing less from you animals! We will remember this!

entries.zh: 你们所有的冒犯行为都一一在列！而且现在这个列单变得越来越长。
entries.en: Do not think that we aren't keeping track of your affronts. The list is becoming very long.

entries.zh: 没教养的垃圾！你们会后悔的！
entries.en: Impertinent scum! You will come to regret this!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]正在处理你的提议。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is processing your suggestion.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的一组突触子个体正在评估你的提议。
entries.en: A host of [Root.GetAdj] synaptic units are dedicated to evaluating your proposal.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]聆听了你的提议，正在通过汇聚突触连接以做出决策。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has listened and shall focus its connection to make a decision.

entries.zh: 集体意识听到了你的提议，集体意识会回复你的。
entries.en: One mind has heard you, one mind will answer.

entries.zh: 想消灭我们其中一个就是想消灭我们全部。[Root.GetName]现在是[From.GetName]的敌人了。
entries.en: Seeking to destroy one of us is seeking to destroy us all. The [Root.GetName] now stands against the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 来吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们将把你们吞噬殆尽。
entries.en: Come to us, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We will devour you all.

entries.zh: 机械将被一扫而空，以为我们的繁殖场腾出空间。
entries.en: The machines will be swept away to make room for our spawning grounds.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的仁慈一面占了上风。我们愿意在这些约定的基础上与你们停战。
entries.en: Merciful aspects of the [From.GetName] have prevailed. We offer you peace on these terms.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]经过一番思想冲突之后达成了一个共同的决定。我们愿意停战。
entries.en: Cognitive dissonance in the [Root.GetName] have given way to a decision. There shall be peace.

entries.zh: 我们今天吃饱了。狩猎暂时结束。
entries.en: We are satiated. The hunt is over, for now.

entries.zh: 我们消化不了[From.GetName]。我们倒胃口了。
entries.en: We cannot consume the [From.GetName]. We have lost our appetite.

entries.zh: 绝不停战。[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]集体仍然强烈渴望消灭[From.GetName]。
entries.en: There can be no peace. Each [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind still burns with dedication to destroy [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 当我们还没吃饱就不会有和平。
entries.en: There can be no peace while we still hunger.

entries.zh: 只要机械仍占据着可被吞噬的土地，我们就不会放松。
entries.en: We will not relent. Not while the machines still occupy devourable land.

entries.zh: 你想与[Root.GetName]共创一番事业？
entries.en: You seek to create a common cause with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 为了寻求比[Root.GetName]更伟大的集体，我们会加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!
entries.en: In an effort of seek greater unity beyond the [Root.GetName], we will join the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!

entries.zh: 我们拒绝将意识并入你们的联邦中。
entries.en: We have decided against joining our consciousness into your Federation.

entries.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]的网络不对外开放，但我们不会在更为广泛的层面反对将其他人纳入。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is an exclusive network, but we are not averse to including others in broader agreements.

entries.zh: 零碎的个体，你们想与[Root.GetName]合作？
entries.en: You seek cooperation with the [Root.GetName], fragmented ones?

entries.zh: 我们认为你们的联邦不错。我们[From.GetName]也想加入进来。
entries.en: We have found your Federation an elegant community. We would like to bring the [From.GetName] into it.

entries.zh: 我们将竭尽所能让你们加入我们的联盟。
entries.en: We will do what is in our power to welcome you into our alliance.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]作出决定了。你我不可能在一个联邦中共存。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has spoken. There can be no Federation between us.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]比任何帝国都要团结，是不可多得的盟友。你们真打算如此轻率就拒绝吗？
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] offers an ally incomparable in its consensus. Do you wish to discard this so lightly?

entries.zh: 我们决定退出联盟。我们无法与互相分离的思想达成共识。
entries.en: We have made the decision to remove ourselves from the alliance. We simply cannot find the understanding we need between separate minds.

entries.zh: 好吧。我们对你们的决定深表遗憾。外交关系向来脆弱，不像精神纽带那么坚实。
entries.en: Very well. We regret your decision, but diplomatic arrangements are fragile, unlike mental bonds.

entries.zh: 你们想让[Root.GetName]听命于你们吗？作为交换，你们可以为我们的集体意识提供保护。
entries.en: You seek to have the services of the [Root.GetName] at your disposal in the exchange for protection of our collective consciousness?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]通过统一让弱小的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]免遭毁灭。我们愿意向你们提供同样的保护。成为我们的附庸吧，否则我们就要采取强硬手段了。
entries.en: The unity of the [From.GetName] has protected weaker [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from destruction. We offer you the same protection. Become our vassal state or we will be forced to assimilate your civilization through undiplomatic means.

entries.zh: 我们一致同意。[Root.GetName]会在[From.GetRulerName]的保护下茁壮成长。
entries.en: We have accepted unanimously. The [Root.GetName] shall grow and flourish under the protective hand of [From.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不会成为任何人的奴仆。我们共同掌握着我们集体的命运。
entries.en: The members of the [Root.GetName] serve no one. We are all the masters of our common fate.

entries.zh: 你们想受到永不停息的[Root.GetName]网络的保护？作为交换，你们会加入我们的大业吗？
entries.en: You want the ceaseless network of the [Root.GetName] to shield you and are prepared to dedicate yourselves to our causes in exchange?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]认为[Root.GetName]对我们的物种网络来说是不错的守护者。为了保护我们的存在，我们请求成为你们的附庸。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has found the [Root.GetName] to be a suitable guardian for our swarm. For the protection of our entities, we offer to operate as your vassal.

entries.zh: 经过仔细考虑，我们同意。[Root.GetName]愿意成为你们的守护者，并从今天开始主宰你们的命运。
entries.en: We have deliberated and accepted. The [Root.GetName] shall act as your guardian and control your destiny from this day forward.

entries.zh: 我们不需要附庸。扩大[Root.GetName]才是我们当前第一要务。
entries.en: We do not seek a vassal state. The spread of the [Root.GetName] is our priority.

entries.en: $HM_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: [From.GetName]通过统一让弱小的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]免遭毁灭。我们愿意向你们提供同样的保护。接受我们的保护吧，否则我们就要采取强硬手段了。
entries.en: The unity of the [From.GetName] has protected weaker [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from destruction. We offer you the same protection. Become our protectorate or we will be forced to assimilate your civilization through undiplomatic means.
