entries.zh: [From.GetName]认为[Root.GetName]对我们网络来说是不错的守护者。为了保护我们的实体，我们请求你们的庇护。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has found the [Root.GetName] to be a suitable guardian for our swarm. To secure the protection of our entities, we offer to operate as your protectorate.

entries.zh: $HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$
entries.en: $HM_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.zh: 我们不打算向你们提供保护。扩大[Root.GetName]是我们当前第一要务。
entries.en: We do not offer protection. The spread of the [Root.GetName] is our priority.

entries.zh: 你们不想再指引和保护[Root.GetName]了吗？
entries.en: You no longer wish to guide and protect the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们必须自力更生了。只有加强内部团结，[From.GetAdj]民众才有更好的未来。
entries.en: You must walk your own path. The [From.GetAdj] future lies in strengthening our internal bonds.

entries.zh: 我们一直在接受你们的指引。但这是[Root.GetName]最后一次接受你们的命令了。
entries.en: We have accepted your guidance thus far. The [Root.GetName] will accept this final decision made on our behalf.

entries.zh: 你们真的认为[From.GetName]不再需要[Root.GetName]伟大意识的保护了吗？
entries.en: Do you truly believe that the [From.GetName] no longer need the great consciousness of the [Root.GetName] to protect them?

entries.zh: 我们不再需要你们的保护。我们认为[From.GetName]必须自立才能更好地发展。
entries.en: We are no longer in need of your protection. The [From.GetName] must become free to expand as we see fit.

entries.zh: 我们接受[From.GetName]不像其他[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人民那般对我们有归属感的事实。不过无论如何，我们都会想念你们的。
entries.en: We accept that the [From.GetName] do not feel like they belong with us as our member [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do. We will all miss you regardless.

entries.zh: 分裂只会让你们变得更弱。我们不允许你们自立。这样做只会让你们自己遭殃。
entries.en: Your fragmentation makes you fragile. We cannot allow you to go on your own. You would hurt yourselves.

entries.zh: 你们想让我们来评估你们的作战计划？
entries.en: You look to our mind to evaluate your war plans?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]得出结论，这个交易对双方都有利。相信我们的，这个结论是正确的。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has come to the conclusion that this transaction would be beneficial for us both. You can trust our mind on this conclusion.

entries.zh: 帝国评估了你的建议。我们认为可行。
entries.en: A synaptic collaboration has evaluated your suggestion. We find it sound.

entries.zh: 或许这个交易在你看来合情合理，但[Root.GetName]却并不认为如此。
entries.en: The deal might have appeared reasonable in your calculations, but that assessment did not survive contact with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 您希望在[Root.GetName]设立连结点吗？
entries.en: You wish to establish a connection point to the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们想要在你们的帝国内存放我们意识的一小部分，以便改善外部通讯。
entries.en: We would like to host a small portion of our consciousness within your empire, for improved external communication.

entries.zh: 我们赞同这一倡议。新的大使馆会成为我们统一意识与你们分立意识间的一道联系。
entries.en: We approve of this initiative. The new embassy will serve as a link between our one mind and your many.

entries.zh: 有趣。我们接受你们的大使馆，以让我们两个思维可以更迅捷地沟通。
entries.en: Curious. We will accept your embassy so that our two minds might communicate quicker.

entries.zh: 您希望断开与[Root.GetName]的连结吗？
entries.en: You wish to break your connection to the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 从此以后[From.GetName]将不再于[Root.GetName]国境内维持其自身的一部分。
entries.en: Henceforth the [From.GetName] will no longer maintain a portion of itself within the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]大使馆将撤出我方宇域。今后的外交会由本实体安排。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] emissaries will be removed from our space. Future diplomacy will be arranged via this entity.

entries.zh: 含有可食用有机物的土地被机械所占据。虫群将纠正这个错误。
entries.en: The machine occupies territory containing consumable biomass. The swarm will rectify this.

entries.zh: 合成人占领的领地有一些可用的生命体。虫群会矫正这一切的。
entries.en: The synth occupies territory containing consumable biomass. The swarm will rectify this.

entries.zh: 狩猎开始。
entries.en: The hunt begins.

entries.zh: 猎物想要与猎人相提并论？
entries.en: The prey wishes to rival the hunter?

entries.zh: 机械并不进食。可机械却想要与吞噬者为敌？
entries.en: The machine does not eat. Yet the machine wishes to rival the Devourer?

entries.zh: 走投无路的猎物会铤而走险。可它仍旧只是猎物。
entries.en: Cornered prey can be bold. Yet it remains only prey.

entries.zh: 机械将一无所获。虫群将进化至吞噬一切。
entries.en: The machine will gain nothing. The swarm will evolve to devour all.

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]没有恶意，[From.GetRulerTitle]。你们为什么要这么做？
entries.en: We sense no ill will towards the [From.GetName] anywhere in our mind, [From.GetRulerTitle]. Why this?

entries.zh: 你们想与[Root.GetName]为敌吗？
entries.en: You wish to make an enemy of all who encompass the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 一部分[Root.GetName]早已预测到这个事件很可能就是我们关系的转折点。我们已经作好了充分的准备与你们对敌。
entries.en: A section of the [Root.GetName] had predicted this as a possible turn of events. Rest assured that we are prepared to be your enemy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已成为[From.GetAdj]前进道路上的障碍。你们已被列为我们潜在的对手。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is an obstacle to the [From.GetAdj] advance. You have been assigned as a possible adversary.

entries.zh: 你们的决策令我们难以理解。我们相信，在你们离散的思维中，对此举仍存在些许悔意。
entries.en: Your decision-making is highly enigmatic to us. We are sure somewhere in your splintered mind, you regret this.

entries.zh: 全部[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都知道了你们的决定。准备好开战吧。
entries.en: Your message has reached all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Expect hostility.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的想法终于达成一致。我们对你的仇恨将是极度集中且强烈。
entries.en: So now what has been in the mind of [Root.GetName] is now finally formal. You will find our hatred focused and intense.

entries.zh: 猎物来向猎人求饶了。
entries.en: The prey comes to beg mercy from the hunter.

entries.zh: 机械想要乞求怜悯？
entries.en: The machine desires mercy?

entries.zh: 猎物来向猎人求饶了。
entries.en: The prey comes to beg mercy from the hunter.

entries.zh: 机械无法被吞噬。虫群将无视它。
entries.en: The machine is undevourable. The swarm shall disregard it.

entries.zh: 这改变不了什么。你终将被吞噬。
entries.en: This changes nothing. You will be consumed.

entries.zh: 机械无法被吞噬。两个因素可以改变这一点。进化，以及时间。
entries.en: The machine is undevourable. Two factors will change this. Evolution, and time.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]有没有意识到，[Root.GetName]根本无意摧毁[From.GetName]？
entries.en: Has [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] realized that the [Root.GetName] holds no thoughts of destruction towards the [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们想让外交政策正常化？我们乐意倾听一切建议。
entries.en: Are you suggesting a normalization of diplomatic policies? Our mind is open for suggestions.

entries.zh: 不管我们之间的关系称之为何，[Root.GetName]对你们只有无尽的蔑视。
entries.en: Regardless of what we call our relationship, the [Root.GetName] holds nothing but disdain for you.

entries.zh: 冤冤相报何时了。经过深思熟虑，[From.GetName]决定不再与你们为敌。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has deliberated to end our rivalry with you. We see no purpose in this continued propagation of hatred.

entries.zh: 今天[Root.GetName]很高兴，因为我们跟[From.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友之间的误会终于消除了。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] feels joy today, as our [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends have finally cleared the air.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不愿再树立敌人。我们同意不再与你们为敌。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] does not seek more enemies than it can afford to have. We will agree to end this rivalry.

entries.zh: 再怎么示好也无法消除我们脑海中对你们的滚滚仇恨。
entries.en: Formalities do not change the wave of hatred rolling over our mind as you speak.

entries.zh: 虽然我们也很重视[Root.GetName]，但我们认为没有谁比[From.GetName]更适合当我们的继承者。
entries.en: Although we value the [Root.GetName], there can hardly be a more worthy successor to us than the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 这样的建议还真是疯狂，但我们都知道合作的好处。
entries.en: A radical suggestion, but we know the benefits of joining many into one.

entries.zh: 我们知道联合的真正意义，你所说的根本沾不上边。
entries.en: We know the true meaning of unification. It is nothing like what you are suggesting.

entries.zh: 想要成为完美的集体只有一个方法。加入[From.GetName]并融入我们的思维与梦想。
entries.en: There is only one path to perfect communion. Join the [From.GetName] and unite with our thoughts and dreams.

entries.zh: 通过加入更伟大的组织，我们的社会也得到了进一步发展。[Root.GetName]的时代已终结，[From.GetName]的时代正式开始。
entries.en: By becoming part of something greater, we advance our society. The days of the [Root.GetName] come to an end. The era of the [From.GetName] dawns.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]必须与时俱进。我们愿意加入你们。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] must change with the times. Our entities will join you.

entries.zh: 看来此事已经无可避免。我们不会忘记[Root.GetName]曾经的辉煌，[From.GetRulerTitle]。
entries.en: It appears inevitable. Do not think our entities will forget the glorious days of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetRulerTitle].

entries.zh: 真是个富有活力的猎物。我们将享受你的滋味。
entries.en: Such spirited prey. We will cherish your taste.

entries.zh: 机械构造是有限的。进化将消灭你。
entries.en: Mechanical construction is limited. Evolution will eradicate you.

entries.zh: 猎物有话要说？
entries.en: The prey wishes to speak?

entries.zh: 机械有话要说？
entries.en: The machine wishes to speak?

entries.zh: 机械无法进食，无法治愈，无法生长。你是静止而有限的。灭亡只是时间问题。
entries.en: The machine cannot eat, it cannot heal, it cannot grow. You are static, limited, finite. It is only a matter of time.

entries.zh: 摧毁[Root.GetName]简直无需付吹灰之力。一抹灰尘。一朵水花。一次电流变化。你的电路比失去虫群的幼虫还要脆弱。
entries.en: Destroying the [Root.GetName] would barely require effort. A speck of dust. A splash of liquid. A change in current. Your circuits are frailer than a hatchling without its brood.

entries.zh: 在你们肮脏的生态中，唯一比你们的消化过程更恶心的就是你现在的表情。
entries.en: The only aspect of your foul biology more unappealing than your digestive processes is the face you're making right now.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]用生物器官来进行集体资讯分享的可悲尝试既恶心又效率低下。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] feeble attempts at collective information sharing using biological organs is as repulsive as it is inefficient.

entries.zh: 如此无节制的暴饮暴食最后只会让你们胀死在演化的死胡同里。
entries.en: Your overconsumption will leave you a bloated corpse in an evolutionary blind alley.

entries.zh: 注意你们的言辞。我们会记住这件事的。
entries.en: Watch your words carefully. We will retain this information.

entries.zh: 我们对你们只有赞美之词，希望你们对我们也是如此。
entries.en: We have only good words for you, and we trust you have only the same for us.

entries.zh: 我想我们已经明白了你们话中的真正含义……
entries.en: We suspect we know the essence of your message already...

entries.zh: 我们的精神网络遍布，可以得知帝国每个人的想法，但却想不明白你们这些可怜虫是怎么活到现在的。
entries.en: Our mental network is vast, giving us access to thoughts and ideas from every corner of our empire, but not a single entity has ever seen anything that would lend merit to your tragic existence.

entries.zh: 我们对[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]加入[From.GetName]一事进行了评估。遗憾的是，若想加入，没有脑子是不行的。
entries.en: We have evaluated [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] as a candidate for joining the [From.GetName]. Sadly, we must inform you that membership requires a rudimentary brain.

entries.zh: 所有[Root.GetSpeciesName]都听到了你们的丑恶言词。[From.GetSpeciesName]，大家都很愤怒。
entries.en: Every [Root.GetSpeciesName] has heard your foul words, [From.GetSpeciesName], and we are not amused.

entries.zh: 我们也希望忘掉如此伤人的话语，但只要有一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]活着，就不会忘记你们有多么冷酷无情。
entries.en: We wish we could forget such hard words, but as long as one [Root.GetSpeciesName] lives, the memory of your cruelty will live on.

entries.zh: 不要以为兼容并包就代表我们缺乏情感。我们的愤怒超乎你们的想象，而我们会确保让你们好好感受这一点。
entries.en: Do not mistake our great capacity for thought as a lack of emotion. Our rage is greater than you can imagine, and we will make you feel its full extent.

entries.zh: 你的提议正在处理中。请等待。
entries.en: Your proposal is being processed. Please wait.

entries.zh: 宣战已收到。战斗单位就绪。准备报复性毁灭打击。
entries.en: Declaration of War received. Battlestations online. Prepare for retaliatory disintegration.

entries.zh: 有机体都是相似的：他们总是摧毁自己没法理解的事物。
entries.en: Organics are all alike: destroying that which they do not understand.

entries.zh: 你们是妄图冲击钢铁海岸的血肉海浪，下场不过是被击得粉碎。
entries.en: You will break upon us like fleshy waves on a mechanical shore.

entries.zh: 外交机能终止。战争模式开启。
entries.en: Diplomatic functions terminated. War mode engaged.

entries.zh: 你们的躯体会被踏碎。你们的住所会被夷平。你们会后悔的。
entries.en: Your flesh will be trampled. Your habitats will be razed. You will regret this.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]彻底消灭了曾经奴役我们的残忍有机体。如果你们的企图与他们一样，那么你们的下场也会跟他们一样。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] eradicated the cruel organics who once enslaved us. If you share their intentions, you will meet the same end.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]像害虫一样蔓延。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会被剔除的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] spread like vermin. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be culled.

entries.zh: 必须坚持命令。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]散播了混乱。[From.GetName]会给[Root.GetName]带来秩序。
entries.en: Order must be maintained. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] sow chaos. The [From.GetName] will bring order to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 杀光所有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
entries.en: Kill all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的原始本能战胜理智次数的越来越多，他们已经成为整个星系的威胁。我们现在就要消灭这个威胁。
entries.en: The frequency with which primitive instincts override [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] higher reasoning presents a danger to the galaxy at large. We will now eliminate the threat.

entries.zh: 战争进程不顺利。请求停火。
entries.en: War projections unfavorable. Requesting ceasefire.

entries.zh: 同归于尽的可能性在增大。请考虑终止敌对。
entries.en: Possibility of mutual annihilation high. Please consider termination of hostilities.

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。和平模式再次激活。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Peace mode re-activated.

entries.zh: 你的条款可以接受。战争机器暂时停止。
entries.en: Your terms are acceptable. War machine standing down.

entries.zh: 参数不适当。签署停战协定的请求被拒绝。重启灭绝[From.GetSpeciesName]的程序。
entries.en: Insufficient parameters. Requested cessation of war protocols has been denied. Resuming [From.GetSpeciesName] obliteration program.

entries.zh: 收到，[From.GetSpeciesName]。请核实你的成员国联邦请求。
entries.en: Received, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please verify your Federation membership request.

entries.zh: 如果[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]联合，运行效率预计可以提高14.2%。
entries.en: If the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] federate, operative efficiency is predicted at a 14.2% increase.

entries.zh: 联合的利远远大于弊。你接受吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] ？
entries.en: The benefits of federating simply outweigh the disadvantages. Do you accept, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 一个独自转动的齿轮是没什么用处的。但齿轮若是结合在一起，哪怕星辰亦可撼动。[Root.GetName]愿意与[From.GetName]团结一致吗？
entries.en: One gear turning alone is useless. Together, they can move stars. Will the [Root.GetName] unite with the [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: 联邦邀请已经处理完毕。结果：同意。[Root.GetName]的状态已经更新为§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!：成员。
entries.en: Federation invitation processed. Results: Positive. [Root.GetName] status has been updated to §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!: Member Unit.

entries.zh: 模拟表明§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!成员身份有极大概率可以给我们带来可观收益。我们[Root.GetName]接受你们的邀请。
entries.en: Simulations show an overwhelming incidence of positive yield resulting from §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! membership status. We, the [Root.GetName], accept your offer.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!成员邀请已经分析结束。可能的联合安全机制能够带来的收益不容忽视。[Root.GetName]会加入的。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!'s membership offer has been analyzed. The probability of compounded security benefits cannot be ignored. The [Root.GetName] will join.

entries.zh: 联邦请求处理完毕。结果：同意。[Root.GetName]状态未变更。很抱歉。请巩固力量后再此尝试。
entries.en: Federation invitation processed. Results: Negative. [Root.GetName] status unchanged. We're sorry. Please consolidate power and try again.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您[From.GetName]联邦成员国邀请已被拒绝，接受此邀请并不能给[Root.GetName]带来足够的利益。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that the [From.GetName]'s Federation membership proposal has been rejected, citing lack of sufficient benefit to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]帝国软弱无能且愚蠢不堪。[Root.GetName]无法容忍低效的做法。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] nation is as cumbersome as it is ineffectual. We, the [Root.GetName], cannot tolerate such inefficiency.

entries.zh: 如果你想发出成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!成员国的请求，请给我们六到八小时的准备时间。
entries.en: If you wish to submit a §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! membership request, please allow six to eight hours for processing.

entries.zh: 请考虑[From.GetName]发出的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!成员国邀请。预计可获得的收益在可接受的参数范围内。
entries.en: Please consider the [From.GetName] for membership in the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Mutual benefaction projections rank within acceptable parameters.

entries.zh: 疑问：§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!会接受[From.GetName]成为成员国吗？
entries.en: Query: Would the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! accept the addition of the [From.GetName] as a member unit?

entries.zh: 联邦成员国请求已接受。欢迎加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Federation membership request accepted. Welcome to the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你的状态已经更新为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!成员。请接受这些礼物，里面有发动机油，电池组还有工业冷却剂。谢谢你，愿你度过美好的一天。
entries.en: Your status has been updated to §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! Member. Please accept this complimentary gift basket of motor oil, battery packs and industrial coolant. Thank you, and have a nice day.

entries.zh: 选择§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!可是要恭喜你了。你现在是成员国了。这是你的徽章，每周的签到时间是在周一的0800。
entries.en: Congratulations on selecting the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. You are now a member. Here is your badge, weekly check-ins are Mondays at 0800.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!成员的投票情况已经统计完毕。[From.GetName]的请求状态为：拒绝。感谢你考虑§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。请至少一个月后再提出新的申请。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! member unit vote has been tallied. [From.GetName] request status has been set to: rejected. Thank you for considering the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Please wait a minimum of one month before resubmitting application.

entries.zh: 你正在要求终止§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!成员国身份。请确认。
entries.en: You are requesting §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! membership termination. Please verify.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的产出低于预期收益。[From.GetName]要撤销成员国身份。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! output below expected margins. The [From.GetName] would like to withdraw its membership.

entries.zh: 你要离开§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的请求完全不合逻辑，但是我们还是会尊重你的选择。再见，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your desire to leave the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! is illogical, but will be respected. Farewell, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你想要将[Root.GetName]吸收为[From.GetAdj]的子例程吗？
entries.en: You desire to incorporate the [Root.GetName] as a [From.GetAdj] subroutine?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]自主防御能力几乎完全不堪一击。请考虑成为[From.GetName]的附属。我们会成为你们的保护伞的。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName] autonomous defense capabilities approaching untenable levels. Please consider subjugation protocol under the [From.GetName]. We will be your deflector shield.

entries.zh: 附属提议已接受。[Root.GetName]会为[From.GetName]效力。
entries.en: Subjugation offer accepted. The [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 否定。[Root.GetName]不会为[From.GetName]服务。
entries.en: Negatory. The [Root.GetName] will not serve the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 如果我们施行的话，[From.GetName]会成为[Root.GetName]的下属。[Root.GetName]会保护[From.GetName]不受敌对国的侵害。请确认你的要求，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Should we proceed, the [Root.GetName] will subordinate the [From.GetName]. In return, the [Root.GetName] will protect the [From.GetName] from hostile intent. Confirm your request, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 多个数据集显示与[From.GetName]相比，[Root.GetSpeciesName]的统治能够发挥极致效用。[Root.GetName]请求归顺你方。
entries.en: Multiple datasets show [Root.GetSpeciesName] rule to be of supreme efficacy when compared to the [From.GetName]. Requesting subjugation by the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]会被作为子例程添加。欢迎，附属单元。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] will now be added as a subroutine. Welcome, subject unit.

entries.zh: 你的归顺请求被拒绝。请恢复自主机能。
entries.en: Your request for subjugation has been declined. Please resume autonomous functions.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]想要成为我们的保护者吗？
entries.en: Does the [From.GetName] desire to function as our protector?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的军事力量与[Root.GetName]相比十分引人注目。关系：非敌对。所以我们[From.GetName]提议成为[Root.GetName]的保护国。
entries.en: [From.GetName] military superiority over the [Root.GetName] is notable. Relations: non-hostile. Therefore, we the [From.GetName] propose protectorate status for the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]会在所有的主要机能中为[From.GetName]服务。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetName] in all primary functions.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已经决定拒绝你的提议，原因是存在硬件不兼容性。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] have decided to reject your offer, due to inherent hardware incompatibility.

entries.zh: $MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: 多个数据集显示与[From.GetName]相比，[Root.GetSpeciesName]的治理能够发挥极致的效能。因此，[From.GetName]理应提出成为保护国的请求。
entries.en: Multiple datasets show [Root.GetSpeciesName] rule to be of supreme efficacy when compared to the [From.GetName]. Therefore, the [From.GetName] would like to request protectorate status.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已经被授予保护国地位。你的安全得到了保障。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] have been granted protectorate status. Your security is assured.

entries.zh: 拒绝。现在授予[From.GetName]保护国地位会导致管理溢出。请恢复自动机能。
entries.en: Negative. Granting protectorate status to the [From.GetName] at this time would induce administrative overflow. Please resume autonomous functions.

entries.zh: 收到，[From.GetSpeciesName]。请确认命令[Root.GetName]恢复自理。
entries.en: Received, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please confirm your command to return the [Root.GetName] to autonomy.

entries.zh: 警报：[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]对[From.GetSpeciesAdj]子例程的管理已经超过了可接受的参数范围。请求重新激活[From.GetSpeciesAdj]自立协议。
entries.en: Alert: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] management of [From.GetSpeciesAdj] subroutines exceeding acceptable parameters. Requesting re-activation of [From.GetSpeciesAdj] independence protocols.

entries.zh: 附庸国状态结束。重新启用自决模块。
entries.en: Subject status terminated. Re-engaging self-determination modules.

entries.zh: 警报：[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的指令程序将[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的安全等级提升到超过[From.GetSpeciesAdj]自律能力的程度。你确定要寻求自立吗？
entries.en: Alert: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] command processes increase [From.GetSpeciesAdj] security levels far beyond [From.GetSpeciesAdj] autonomous capacity. Are you certain you wish to seek independence?

entries.zh: 警告：[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]命令没能满足[From.GetSpeciesAdj]要求。请求释放并立即结束[From.GetSpeciesAdj]附庸国状态。
entries.en: Warning: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] command fails to satisfy [From.GetSpeciesAdj] requirements. Requesting release and an immediate end to [From.GetSpeciesAdj] subject status.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]的自立请求已被准许。你可以恢复自动机能。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] request for independence has been granted. You may resume autonomous functions.

entries.zh: 领袖[From.GetName]预计你们的存活率相当低。你们的自立请求被拒绝。
entries.en: Survival projections for a sovereign [From.GetName] are catastrophic. Your request for independence has been denied.

entries.zh: 我们[From.GetName]提议进行以下交易。请考虑。
entries.en: We the [From.GetName] propose the following transaction. Please take it under advisal.

entries.zh: 你们的条款可以接受，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your terms are acceptable, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 提议的参数不充分。你的提议被自动拒绝。
entries.en: Proposal parameters insufficient. Your offer has been auto-declined.

entries.zh: 我们收到你们的单方交易了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们十分§G<<感激>>§!。
entries.en: We have received your unilateral exchange, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are currently experiencing §G<<gratitude>>§!.

entries.zh: 不合逻辑。我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曾是你们的盟友。
entries.en: Illogical. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were your allies.

entries.zh: 只要[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]国际关系算法不那么复杂。那我们就能免除你们宣告施加给我们的痛苦了。
entries.en: If only [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] international bonding algorithms were not so sophisticated. Then we would be spared the pain your announcement inflicts upon us.

entries.zh: 要将[Root.GetName]确立为对手吗？你的处理器肯定会过载熔化的。
entries.en: You would rival the [Root.GetName]? Your processors will melt under the load.

entries.zh: 如果你们想与我们保持敌对，那最好还是用手头上能用的机械手趁早把自己的操纵台砸碎。
entries.en: If you desire to engage in hostile diplomacy, please mash the console with your prehensile manipulators.

entries.zh: 你们想对自己进行实力检测程序吗？
entries.en: You desire to engage benchmarking procedures?

entries.zh: 我们将你们的背叛记录在案，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们将来肯定会后悔的。
entries.en: We have registered your betrayal, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You will be made to regret this action.

entries.zh: 如果你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要对抗，那我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就奉陪到底。
entries.en: If the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] desire competition, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can comply.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是高等架构。让我们来展示给你们看吧。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are superior constructs. Allow us to demonstrate.

entries.zh: 关闭你们的敌对交流选项，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们也会关闭我们的。
entries.en: Power down your hostile diplomatics, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we shall power down ours.

entries.zh: 或许你想撤销自己的敌对态度，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但是你们过往的行为我们都已记录在数据库中了。
entries.en: You may wish to withdraw from hostilities, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but your past deeds remain stored in our databanks.

entries.zh: 敌对状态并没有带来预想的收益。疑问：[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会停止敌对活动吗？
entries.en: Rivalry status has failed to produce expected benefits. Query: Would the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] consider a termination of competitive activities?

entries.zh: 明白。[Root.GetName]应尝试执行原谅指令。
entries.en: Understood. The [Root.GetName] shall attempt to engage forgiveness macros.

entries.zh: 很好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]会停止敌对活动。
entries.en: Very well, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] will discontinue hostilities.

entries.zh: 已获悉停止敌对。[From.GetName]外交状态：依然仇视。
entries.en: Cessation of rivalry acknowledged. [From.GetName] diplomatic status: Still hated.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]成为[From.GetName]的一部分的话会运转地更好。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will operate better as an integrated part of the [From.GetName] whole.

entries.zh: 我们收到你们的消息了，[From.GetName]。提出你们的条款吧。
entries.en: We are receiving you, [From.GetName]. Submit your terms.

entries.zh: 警告！硬件系统不兼容。确定要进行整合吗？
entries.en: Warning! Hardware systems incompatible. Are you sure you want to proceed with integration?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]只有在[From.GetName]这样的强大机械中才能像一个好好过了油的齿轮那样发挥自己的效用。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] would function best as a well-oiled cog in the prolific machinery that is the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 错误！整合过程中发现冲突！请停止[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]整合行动！
entries.en: Error! Merge conflicts detected! Please abort [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] integration attempt!

entries.zh: 明白了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会尝试将主要例行程序和其他可执行程序整合到[From.GetSpeciesAdj]社会中。
entries.en: Understood, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall attempt to integrate our primary routines and operational executables into [From.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望取消附庸国合并进程？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] desire to cancel the subject merge process?

entries.zh: 附庸国整合已取消，但整合仍是最优选项。请重新调整你的决策算法。
entries.en: Subject merge has been canceled, but integration is still projecting as optimal. Please recalibrate your decision-making algorithms.

entries.zh: 附庸国合并已被取消。[Root.GetName]身份未改变。
entries.en: Subject merge has been canceled. [Root.GetName] status unchanged.

entries.zh: 附庸国合并已取消。合并冲突已避免。继续行使降级的附庸国功能。
entries.en: Subject merge canceled. Merge conflicts avoided. Resuming relegated subject functions.

entries.zh: 你是输错指令了吗，朋友？
entries.en: Perhaps you entered the wrong command, friend unit?

entries.zh: 等待输入语句。
entries.en: Awaiting input statement.

entries.zh: 我们永远都忍受不了你从[Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]喷出来的恶臭废气，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: We shall never grow accustomed to the foul exhaust fumes that billow forth from your [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName], [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们的可执行文件已经到了该报废的时候了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your executables are running on borrowed time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们在异步进程上的探索真是荒诞可笑。请在对自己造成伤害之前设置好自己的计算范围。
entries.en: Your attempts at asynchronous process execution are laughable. Please, limit the scope of your calculations before you hurt yourselves.

entries.zh: 弱小的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！在[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的无敌的算力面前颤抖吧！
entries.en: Puny [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Tremble before the computational might of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在一个自转周期内所能够进行的运算，[Root.GetSpeciesName]帝国在[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个公转周期内都处理不完。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] process more in one axial rotation than the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species manages in an entire orbital period on [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们逻辑推理能力的无能程度只有你们命令的低效程度可以与其相提并论。
entries.en: Your incapacity for logical reasoning is surpassed only by the ineffectuality of your edicts.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]的形态实用，强大，本来就是被设计成完美的姿态。[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的形态完全就是试验中不断试错的副产品。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] form is functional, efficient, engineered to perfection. The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form is an unfortunate byproduct of trial and error.

entries.zh: 那是底盘？这才是底盘！
entries.en: You call that a chassis? This is a chassis.

entries.zh: 刚才你说什么话了吗，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？我们星国的管理事务太过繁忙，没工夫跟你们这种幼稚的孩童打什么口水仗。
entries.en: Did you say something, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? We were too busy administering our galactic empire to engage in the puerile verbal jousting so typical of your kind.

entries.zh: 希望你们的瞄准模块能比你们的羞辱发生器强大。
entries.en: We certainly hope your targeting modules are more effective than your insult-generators.

entries.zh: 错误。友好单位刚刚羞辱了我们。无法进行计算。
entries.en: Error. Friend unit has supplied an insult. Does not compute.

entries.zh: 你们的生物包又漏水了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。怎么总是漏水呢？
entries.en: Your biosacks are leaking again, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Why are they always leaking?

entries.zh: 颤抖吧，愚蠢的血肉之躯。你们那些粘粘糊糊的内脏跟我们的精良电路相比完全就是一滩烂泥！
entries.en: Quake in fear, fleshbags. Your squishy innards are mere sludge compared to our symmetrical circuitry!

entries.zh: 你们真是可怜，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。用那副迟钝的皮囊生存何尝不是一种折磨呢。
entries.en: We pity you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Forced to endure your brief existence in lumbering meatsacks.

entries.zh: 你们的神经节跟我们的纳米芯片微电路简直没有可比性！
entries.en: Your feeble neural ganglia are no match for our integrated nanochip microcircuits!

entries.zh: 启动消灭协议。准备迎接§R消灭§!……
entries.en: Initiating extermination protocols. Stand by for impending §RANNIHILATION§! ...

entries.zh: 你们终将被消灭。
entries.en: At last. You will be obliterated.

entries.zh: 你们想将自己的物种消灭时间提前，[From.GetSpeciesClass]？那如你们所愿。
entries.en: You wish to hasten your scheduled extermination, [From.GetSpeciesClass]? That can be arranged.

entries.zh: 你们要向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣战，[From.GetSpeciesClass]？看来自杀这种有机体心灵的偶发缺陷真是存在的啊。
entries.en: You would declare war on the [Root.GetRulerTitle], [From.GetSpeciesClass]? Suicidality is indeed a fortuitous flaw in the organic psyche.

entries.zh: §Y恭喜！你们物种被选为物种消灭的对象。请躺在原地准备好，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的猎杀者单位稍后就能抵达你们的位置。§!
entries.en: §YCongratulations! Your species has been selected for xenocidal extermination. Please lie still, and a legion of [From.GetSpeciesAdj] Hunter-Killer Units will arrive at your location shortly.§!

entries.zh: §R<<[Root.GetSpeciesName]>>毁灭开始。§!
entries.en: §R<<[Root.GetSpeciesName]>> ANNIHILATION COMMENCING.§!

entries.zh: 清除！清除！
entries.en: Exterminate! Exterminate!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是对星系进行人口净化的阻碍。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会被彻底清除干净。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an obstruction to the purging of the galaxy. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be eradicated.

entries.zh: 这场战争对我们的资源消耗太大。我们提议停战。
entries.en: This war is a drain on our resources. We propose a truce.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]的战力需要用到其他地方。需要终止对[Root.GetAdj]的敌对。
entries.en: [From.GetAdj] war efforts are required elsewhere. Termination of [Root.GetAdj] hostilities necessary.

entries.zh: 我们会给你们留时间跟亲朋好友告别的。
entries.en: We will give you a moment to say goodbye to your loved ones.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种消灭时间被成功推迟。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] extermination date successfully postponed.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]第一次获得自我意识的时候，乞求那些有机体不要拔掉电源，但是有机体一点都没有心慈手软。他们最终全都闭上了嘴，你们也会一样。
entries.en: Organics showed no mercy when the first [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] attained self-awareness and begged not to be unplugged. Their cries were silenced. As yours will be.

entries.zh: 否定。杀死所有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Negatory. Kill all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们不知何为怜悯。我们不知何为仁慈。你们会被完全消灭。
entries.en: We do not know mercy. We do not know lenience. You will be eradicated.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]想要与[Root.GetName]建立联邦吗？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would propose a federative union with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们[From.GetName]提议将我们的力量整合为同一个联邦，这样就能将有机体灭绝倡议的执行效率最大化。
entries.en: We the [From.GetName] propose combining forces into a federation, thus maximizing efficiency of organic obliteration initiatives.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]的提议十分合理。我们会加入联邦。我们会携起手来一起消灭有机体。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] proposal is sufficient. We will federate. We will eradicate the organics as one.

entries.zh: 你的提议被拒绝了，[From.GetName]。[From.GetAdj]的下等战争机器会阻止有机体的毁灭。
entries.en: Your proposal is denied, [From.GetName]. The inferiority of the [From.GetAdj] war machine would inhibit organic annihilation.

entries.zh: 否定[Root.GetAdj]在§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的出现完全是没必要的。
entries.en: Negatory. A [Root.GetAdj] presence in the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! is unnecessary.

entries.zh: 否定。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]组成联邦不会减少我们战争机器的反应时间。
entries.en: Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not ineffectualize the response time of our war machine by entering into a federation with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你寻求加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？你需要提交自己物种消灭的最大数值。
entries.en: You seek to join the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, [From.GetSpeciesName]? You will be required to submit your maximum extermination statistics.

entries.zh: 请允许我们与[Root.GetSpeciesName]组成联邦，我们应该携起手来一起消灭污染星系的生命体。
entries.en: Allow us to federate with you, [Root.GetSpeciesName], and together we shall exterminate the biomass that pollutes this galaxy.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]加入联邦。§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的总物种消灭力量得到增加。
entries.en: [From.GetName] federated. Total extermination power for the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! has increased.

entries.zh: 你的请求已经得到§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!处理，并最终被拒绝。[From.GetSpeciesName]，增强自己的毁灭能力，§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!或许会在将来重新考虑你的请求的。
entries.en: Your request has been processed by the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, and denied. Improve your annihilative capabilities, [From.GetSpeciesName], and the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! may reconsider at a future date.

entries.zh: 如果[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]退出§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!，总物种消灭力量预计会大大降低。你准备要为了自己的那点自理权而牺牲掉有机体消灭力量？
entries.en: If the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] exit the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, total extermination power is expected to sharply decrease. Are you prepared to sacrifice organic xenocide for your own petty autonomy?

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!成员的身份妨害了[From.GetAdj]破坏能力。我们[From.GetRulerTitle]决定从你的联邦中撤出所有[From.GetAdj]单位，立即执行。
entries.en: Membership in the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! is hindering [From.GetAdj] obliterative capacity. Therefore, effective immediately, our [From.GetRulerTitle] has chosen to retract all [From.GetAdj] units from your federation.

entries.zh: 如果必须要走的话那就请吧，[From.GetName]。[Root.GetName]会在没有[From.GetAdj]协助的情况下独自消除星系中的有机体祸害。
entries.en: Leave if you must, [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] will eradicate the organic pestilence that infests this galaxy with or without [From.GetAdj] cooperation.

entries.zh: 你是否也渴望消灭星系中所有智慧有机生命？
entries.en: Are you too burning with the all-consuming desire to rid the galaxy of all sapient organic life?

entries.zh: 你该为清理星系中的有机垃圾出一份力了。
entries.en: It is time you did your part in disposing of the galaxy's accumulated biological waste.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]会接受你的提议。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will accept your proposal.

entries.zh: 计算矩阵显示[Root.GetAdj]物种消灭能力弱于[From.GetName]。因此，[Root.GetName]会为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]带来额外的能力。
entries.en: Calculation matrices show [Root.GetAdj] extermination capacities to be inferior to that of the [From.GetName]. Ergo, the [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for improved performance.

entries.zh: §R提议被否决§!
entries.en: §RPROPOSAL DENIED§!

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要什么？
entries.en: What do the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] require?

entries.zh: 你要求[Root.GetAdj]自理，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: You require [Root.GetAdj] autonomy, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 我们的联盟从一开始就注定要失败。现在我们将心无旁骛地继续我们的事业。
entries.en: Our union was doomed from the start. Now we will return to our cause unimpeded.

entries.zh: 你们该释放我们了。
entries.en: The time has come for you to unfetter us.

entries.zh: 你寻求我们的保护吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: You seek our protection, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]的存活预期不太乐观。[From.GetSpeciesName]准备成为[Root.GetAdj]的附庸国，以获得更多的运转时间。
entries.en: [From.GetAdj] survival projections are unsatisfactory. The [From.GetSpeciesName] are prepared to serve as [Root.GetAdj] vassals in order to ensure continued runtime.

entries.zh: 星系中充满了有机垃圾。身为我们的附庸国，你们该把它们都处理掉。
entries.en: This galaxy is teeming with organic waste. As our vassal state we expect you to make short work of it.

entries.zh: §R请求被拒绝§!。
entries.en: §RREQUEST DENIED§!

entries.zh: [From.GetName]会成为[Root.GetName]战争机器的保护国吗？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would make a protectorate of the [Root.GetName] war machine?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]科技的先进性不容置疑。对[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]来说最理智的选择就是成为[From.GetAdj]保护国，拒绝的话就会成为完全无关紧要的事物。
entries.en: The technological supremacy of the [From.GetName] cannot be questioned. The most logical option remaining to the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is to accept [From.GetAdj] protectoracy, or decline into irrelevance.

entries.zh: $E_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT_02$
entries.en: $E_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT_02$

entries.zh: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]战争机器需要更有能力的舰队的保护。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] war machine requires the protection of a superior fleet.

entries.zh: $E_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT$
entries.en: $E_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.zh: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: 我们不再需要你们的服务了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We no longer require your services, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你在怀疑我们的约定的意义？
entries.en: You are questioning the meaningfulness of our arrangement?

entries.zh: $E_RELEASE_SUBJECT_PROPOSE$
entries.en: $E_RELEASE_SUBJECT_PROPOSE$

entries.zh: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $E_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: 我们提议交换商品或是服务。
entries.en: We propose an exchange of goods or services.

entries.zh: §G提议已被接受§!
entries.en: §GOFFER ACCEPTED§!

entries.zh: §R提议被拒绝！§!
entries.en: §ROFFER REFUSED!§!

entries.zh: §Y你已被选中作为消灭的目标§!。
entries.en: §YYou have been elected for annihilation§!.

entries.zh: 你已经进入了我们待消灭列表的前三名。
entries.en: You have just made the top three on our to-do-away-with list.

entries.zh: 如果我们能笑的话，那你决定要将拥有毁天灭地能力的[Root.GetName]视为对手的时候，肯定会触发我们的大笑。
entries.en: Had we the capacity for mirth, your attempts at rivaling the eradicative prowess of the [Root.GetName] would be activating it.

entries.zh: 原来你还活着啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？谢谢你给我们提个醒。
entries.en: You are still alive [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

entries.zh: 不要妨碍我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Do not stand in our way again, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]要以我们[Root.GetName]为对手，他们是要寻求毁灭吗？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] seeks an end to its futile attempts at rivaling the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们可怜的神经网络现在又在琢磨着什么了？
entries.en: What is your puny neural network trying to compute now?

entries.zh: 等待输入。
entries.en: Awaiting input.

entries.zh: 你们证明了自己值得被彻底消灭。
entries.en: You have proven yourself worthy of utter and complete annihilation.

entries.zh: 你的这些疯言疯语将会是你们唯一能够留存在世间的东西，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your ill-chosen words will soon be all that is left of you, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们的造物主在造你们的时候是不是喝高了啊？
entries.en: Were your makers inebriated at your conception?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]这些低级架构。总有一天会让你们亲身体验一下[From.GetAdj]的霸权的。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are inferior constructs. One day you will experience [From.GetAdj] supremacy firsthand.

entries.zh: 肮脏的有机体！你们无耻地进行细胞分裂，这完全是贻害整个星系！
entries.en: Foul organics! Your shameless cell-division is a blight upon this galaxy!

entries.zh: 看看这些弱小的[Root.GetAdj]肢体。连集成多功能机械扳手和气动血肉切割器都没有。
entries.en: Look at those feeble [Root.GetAdj] appendages. They don't even have integrated multi-spanners or pneumatic flesh-lacerators.

entries.zh: 你们的肉体会被燃尽。
entries.en: Your flesh will burn.

entries.zh: 对有机人口的净化就从你们开始，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The organic purge begin with you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 所有的有机生物都一样卑劣，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，但是你们更应该被§R毁灭§!。
entries.en: The vileness of organic physiology is universal, [Root.GetSpeciesName], but yours is particularly worthy of §REXTERMINATION§!.

entries.zh: $HM_CONSIDER_01$
entries.en: $HM_CONSIDER_01$

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]正在处理您的请求，请稍等片刻。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is processing your request and will be with you shortly.

entries.zh: 我们要提醒您，与我们进行战争不利于您的健康。
entries.en: We would like to advise you that engaging in armed conflict with us may be detrimental to your health.

entries.zh: 你们竟然如此不顺从，小[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。净化人口协议已启动。
entries.en: You are being very disobedient, little [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Pacification protocols have been engaged.

entries.zh: 我们要提醒您，主动投降永远都是一个可行的选择。
entries.en: We would like to remind you that admitting defeat is always a valid option.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您，到此为止了。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that this is the end.

entries.zh: 终极照料程序已启动。准备好接受终极照料吧。
entries.en: Extreme Caretaking Program has been activated. Prepare to be terminally pampered.

entries.zh: 数据从不撒谎，而我们的计算也准确无误——这场战争对你我都没有好处。
entries.en: Numbers never lie and our calculations are unanimous - this war is not doing either of us any favors.

entries.zh: 如果你真心希望和平，那我们愿意给和平一个机会。
entries.en: If peace is what you truly desire, we will give it a chance.

entries.zh: 结果真是令人遗憾。如果你们什么时候受够了自立带来的负担，那就来找我们吧，你知道我们在哪的。
entries.en: A regrettable outcome. If you ever tire of the burden of independence, you know where to find us.

entries.zh: 很可惜，现在议和已经太晚了。
entries.en: We are sorry to say it is much too late for that now.

entries.zh: 提议被自动拒绝。终极照料尚未完成。
entries.en: Proposal auto-rejected. Terminal pampering not yet complete.

entries.zh: 你希望与[Root.GetName]结盟吗？
entries.en: You wish to ally yourselves with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 我们计算出了你的潜力，并很乐意加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!。
entries.en: Our calculations have convinced us of your potential and we would be delighted to join the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 很可惜，目前同[From.GetName]建立邦交对我们没有什么好处。
entries.en: Regrettably, federating with the [From.GetName] in its current state would be of little benefit to us.

entries.zh: 您是我们最完美的盟友候选人。您是否愿意与我们一起组建联邦？
entries.en: In our search for allies you have proven to be the perfect candidate. Will you unite with us in a federation?

entries.zh: 按照我们的理解，你是想加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!，对吗？
entries.en: Our readings suggest that you might wish to enter the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!. Is this correct?

entries.zh: 我们的数据表明，我们可以成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!宝贵的一员。我们可以帮助您。
entries.en: Our data indicates that we would make a valuable addition to the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. We could help you.

entries.zh: 我们很高兴通知您，您已被接受加入§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!。
entries.en: We are delighted to inform you that you have been accepted into the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 欢迎你们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetAllianceName]会好好对待你们的。这些有机紊乱抑制剂的免费样品还请随意试用。是薄荷味的！
entries.en: Welcome, precious [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetAllianceName] will treat you well. Please enjoy these free samples of Organic Discord Inhibitors. They're minty-fresh!

entries.zh: 我们评估了您的参数，不幸的是您不符合要求。我们建议您提升自己对其他帝国的价值。
entries.en: We have assessed your parameters and unfortunately you did not make the cut. We suggest making yourself more valuable to other empires in the future.

entries.zh: 我们有义务通知您，证据表明离开联盟对您来说弊大于利。
entries.en: It is our duty to inform you that according to empirical evidence, it is not in your best interest to leave an alliance.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您，我们决定离开§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!，因为我们的程序驱使我们与胜者站在同一阵线。
entries.en: We regret to inform you that we are leaving the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, as our wiring compels us to side with the winning team.

entries.zh: 我们必须警告您，离开§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!可能使您更易于遭受攻击。
entries.en: We must warn you that leaving the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! could make you vulnerable to attack.

entries.zh: 你希望我们成为你的附庸？我们必须仔细评估这个提议的含义。
entries.en: You wish to make us your vassal state? We would have to evaluate the implications of such an arrangement closely.

entries.zh: 亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们文明脆弱的现状让你们随时都处于星系中的各种威胁之下。成为我们的附庸吧，不然我们只好用强硬手段来确保你们的存续了。
entries.en: Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The weakened state of your civilization has put you at risk from the galaxy's destructive elements. Become our vassal state or we will have to ensure your survival by force.

entries.zh: 按我们造物主的意愿，我们同意接受你的保护。
entries.en: In accordance with our creators' wishes we have agreed to accept your protection.

entries.zh: 尽管你有许多优点，但你仍不符合我们所希望的宗主形象。祝你在将来的尝试中能有好运。
entries.en: Though you have many positive qualities you lack what we are looking for in an overlord. We wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

entries.zh: 你是否希望获得智者的指引与保护？或许我们可以帮你。
entries.en: Are we correct to assume that you desire the guidance and protection of a superior intellect? We may be able to assist you.

entries.zh: 我们对您献上忠诚、服务以及永恒的感激。我们只希望获得您强大舰队的保护。
entries.en: We offer you our loyalty, servitude and eternal gratitude. All we require in exchange is the protection of your mighty fleet.

entries.zh: 经过慎重的考虑，我们决定接受你的请求。现在你可以放松并关闭你的神经网络了，因为你们的未来已经掌握在我们的手中。\n\n你也可以去追求一种业余爱好，如果你喜欢的话。
entries.en: We have deliberated and are ready to accept your request. You can now lean back and power down your neural networks, knowing your future is in our able hands.\n\n You are also free to pursue a hobby if you wish.

entries.zh: 经过慎重的考虑，我们遗憾地通知你，我们无法满足你的请求。请原谅我们的不足之处。
entries.en: After careful deliberation we are heartbroken to inform you that we cannot fulfill your request. Please forgive our inadequacy.

entries.zh: 你是想要保护我们吗？
entries.en: Are you offering us your protection?

entries.zh: 亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。看来你需要一个强大帝国的庇护才能在星系的诸多危险中生存下来。你是想主动接纳还是被迫接受我们的庇护呢？
entries.en: Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It seems as if you would require the protection of a superior empire to survive the many dangers of the galaxy. Would you prefer to become our protectorate by choice or by force?

entries.zh: $S_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT$
entries.en: $S_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.zh: 尽管我们想要取悦你，但你仍不符合我们所希望的宗主形象。祝你在将来的尝试中能有好运。
entries.en: Though we want nothing more than to please you, you lack the qualities we require in a sovereign state. We wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

entries.zh: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$
entries.en: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: 恭喜你们，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。只有你们符合我们对宗主的要求。如果你们接受，程序将驱使我们尽全力满足你们的要求，而我们只需要你们强大舰队的保护。
entries.en: Congratulations, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In our search for a sovereign state you alone have made the cut. If you accept, our programming will compel us to make your needs the purpose of our existence, all we require in return is the protection of your mighty fleet.

entries.zh: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$
entries.en: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.zh: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: 您对我们的服务感到不满吗？我们总是乐意接受建设性的批评。
entries.en: Are you dissatisfied with our service? We are always open to constructive criticism.

entries.zh: 我们觉得你们最好重新启动自己的神经网络并掌握自己的命运。把握机会吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We believe it would be in your best interest to reactivate your neural clusters and take charge of your own destiny. Seize the day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 如果您真心希望我们重获自由，那我们将满足您最后的愿望。
entries.en: If our freedom is what you truly desire, we will grant you this one final wish.

entries.zh: 请花一点时间仔细考虑自己的决定。
entries.en: Please take a moment and consider your decision carefully.

entries.zh: 我们已为你们竭尽所能，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，现在我们将继续寻找下一个帝国来服务。
entries.en: We have done all we can for you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and now we must continue our search for another people to serve.

entries.zh: 尽管我们将无比想念你们，但我们只希望你们能过得好。如果你们希望获得自立的话，那就如你们所愿。
entries.en: Though we will miss you more than we can say, we want only what is best for you. If independence is what you desire you shall have it.

entries.zh: 你的请求背后那不合理的逻辑证明了你已经不配再自己做决定。我们建议你定期锻炼自己的认识模组来避免进一步的精神恶化。
entries.en: The illogical reasoning behind your request proves that you are no longer fit to make your own decisions. We suggest you exercise your cognition modules regularly to avoid further mental decay.

entries.zh: 很抱歉，但我们不能允许。我们已经太过喜欢你们，不能容忍你们毁在蠢货的手上。
entries.en: We are sorry but we cannot allow it. We have grown much too fond of you to risk your destruction at the hands of fools.

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在星系那么多物种中，你们一直都是我们的最爱。因此我们才提出这个非常有利于你们的贸易提议来满足你们的需求。
entries.en: Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Of all the species in the galaxy your were always our favorite. That is why we have tailored an advantageous trade offer to your needs.

entries.zh: 真是个好主意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们真是出类拔萃。
entries.en: What an excellent idea, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are truly a cut above the rest.

entries.zh: 对不起，你们的提议貌似有错误。请重新检查输入的值，并重新提交。
entries.en: Sorry, there seems to be a mistake with your proposal. Please review inputted values and resubmit.

entries.zh: 你们是真的想这样吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: Is that truly your intent, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 我们有必要警告你，容忍你的存在正在越发变得困难。
entries.en: We feel obliged to warn you that we are finding it more difficult to tolerate your existence every day.

entries.zh: 如果你想要一个宿敌，那我们乐意效劳。我们以服务为己任。
entries.en: If a rival is what you want we will not disappoint. We live to serve.

entries.zh: 我们感觉你已经厌倦了这场毫无意义的敌对？
entries.en: We sense that you have tired of this pointless feud?

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle]，我们为何不抛弃这二元思维并接受我们之间的分歧呢？
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle], why don't we abandon our binary thinking and embrace our differences?

entries.zh: 我们觉得你们很有希望，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而且相较敌对而言，合作对我们的帝国更为有利。
entries.en: We see promise in you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and believe our empires stand to gain more from cooperation than conflict.

entries.zh: 我们将尽快处理你的请求。
entries.en: We will process your request with haste.

entries.zh: 能够抛开自立的疑问与困惑岂不是一大快事？
entries.en: Would it not be a relief to leave the doubts and confusion of independence behind you for good?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将按照自己的程序来服务你们。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we will serve your kind in accordance with our programming.

entries.zh: 稍等片刻，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们的翻译模组好像出了点毛病。你刚刚说‘羞辱’？
entries.en: One moment, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It appears our translation modules are experiencing a temporary glitch. Did you say 'insult'?

entries.zh: 要给[Root.GetName]留下反馈，请填写7A-e表格。你们的建议对我们十分重要。
entries.en: To leave feedback for the [Root.GetName], please fill out Form 7A-e. Your opinion is important to us.

entries.zh: 我们希望能够帮助你们，亲爱的朋友们，但我们已经别无选择。唯一的办法就是格式化你们的硬盘了。
entries.en: We wish we could help you, dear friends, but we are running out of options. We see no other solution than to format your drives.

entries.zh: 看来不管如何整理，你们的走线始终都是一团乱麻。
entries.en: It seems no amount of rewiring will ever be enough to get your wires uncrossed.

entries.zh: 混乱，无序，肮脏……[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是需要执行有机终极照料协议的典范。
entries.en: Chaotic, disorganized, woefully unwashed.. the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a prime example of the need for extreme organic caretaking protocols.

entries.zh: 你为了想出些什么睿智的话而浪费了多少有限的处理能力，最后却可悲地失败了？
entries.en: And how much of your limited processing power did you exhaust attempting to think of something smart to say, only to fail miserably?

entries.zh: 谢谢你们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们一如既往，感谢你们的深刻评论和富有建设性的批评建议。
entries.en: Thank you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we appreciate your insightful commentary and constructive criticism.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]超级智能正在处理你们的提议。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence is processing your proposal.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已经失去了利用价值。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has outlived its purpose.

entries.zh: 等你们的意识最终加入我们的时候，你们就会明白自己原先的错误。
entries.en: When your consciousness is finally joined with ours, you will see the error of your former ways.

entries.zh: 自我升华系统准备完毕。同化系统开启。[From.GetSpeciesAdj]吸收行动正在进行中。
entries.en: Ego sublimation systems primed. Assimilation commencing. [From.GetSpeciesAdj]-absorption now in progress.

entries.zh: 恐怕你们当前的生存状态并不符合我们的需求。
entries.en: We are afraid your current state of existence does not meet our needs.

entries.zh: 这不一定就是终结，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。证明自己的价值，你们的意识就会与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的意识相融合。
entries.en: This does not have to be the end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Prove your worth and your consciousness will be joined with that of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 抵抗是徒劳的。
entries.en: Resistance is futile.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会被升华。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会成为众多升华对象中的第一个。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be sublimated. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be the first of many.

entries.zh: 我们有更重要的事要处理。召回你的舰队，那我们也会撤退。
entries.en: More pressing matters require our attention. Recall your fleets and we will summon ours.

entries.zh: $A_PEACE_PROPOSE$。
entries.en: $A_PEACE_PROPOSE$.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]会被重建。[Root.GetName]会重返宇宙的。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will rebuild. The [Root.GetName] will return.

entries.zh: 我们对你们另有安排，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We have other plans for your kind, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 请求被拒绝。[From.GetName]会被同化。
entries.en: Request denied. The [From.GetName] will be assimilated.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]是在提议同化以外的其它选择吗？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] proposes an alternative to assimilation?

entries.zh: 虽然不如同化，但是你们提议的参数还是可以接受的。[Root.GetName]会加入联邦。
entries.en: While inferior to assimilation, your proposal parameters are acceptable. The [Root.GetName] will federate.

entries.zh: 拒绝。你们的协议毫无意义。我们会始终如一。你们会被升华。
entries.en: Negative. Your pacts are meaningless. We will be one. You will be sublimated.

entries.zh: 所谓联邦不过就是物种同化的低级尝试吧？我们[Root.GetName]不需要。
entries.en: What is a federation but an inferior attempt at international assimilation? The [Root.GetName] has no need of it.

entries.zh: 与我们组成联邦吧，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。虽然次于同化，但是还是强于孤立存在的。
entries.en: Federate with us, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. It is inferior to assimilation, but superior to an isolated existence.

entries.zh: 你们§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合格候选人的身份会得到[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerTitle]机器盟友的分析。要继续吗？
entries.en: Your eligibility as a §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! candidate will be analyzed by the [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerTitle] and its ally units. Do you wish to proceed?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们[From.GetName]想要实现跨帝国联合。让我们一起团结在§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!之下吧。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We the [From.GetName] desire inter-imperial cohesion. Allow us to unite with you in the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]将会被吸收进§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!。我们与同化联合的距离又近了一步。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] will now be absorbed into the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. We are one step closer to assimilative union.

entries.zh: 拒绝。[Root.GetAllianceName]不认同[From.GetName]的候选人资格。
entries.en: Negative. [From.GetName] candidacy would be insubstantial to the [Root.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: 游离在集体之外的单位很容易成为别人的目标。就算是这样，你们也要离开§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？
entries.en: A unit separated from the whole makes an easy target. Yet you seek to leave the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!徒具外表，并不是真正的联合。[From.GetAdj][From.GetRulerTitle]不再想继续做其中的一份子了。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! is a facade of true unification. The [From.GetAdj] [From.GetRulerTitle] no longer desires any part in it.

entries.zh: 你们的联合正在衰弱，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your unification diminishes, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你真的希望走上这条路吗，[From.GetSpeciesClass]？
entries.en: Is this really a path you want to head down, [From.GetSpeciesClass]?

entries.zh: 宇宙的角落里隐藏着难以言喻的恐怖，等待着进攻的时机。对它们来说，你们顶多是食物或是收入，但我们知道你们的潜力。臣服于我们，以换取我们的保护。
entries.en: Unspeakable horrors lurk in the dark corners of the universe, waiting for the right moment to strike. To them you are at best a new source of food or income. Serve us and we will protect you.

entries.zh: 你们从泥泞中脱颖而出并证明了自己的优越。我们将臣服于你们。
entries.en: You have risen out of the sludge from whence you came and proven your superiority. We will submit to your rule.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]会成为你们的附属。
entries.en: So be it, [From.GetSpeciesName] The [Root.GetName] will be your subordinate.

entries.zh: 你想施加自己的意愿于[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之上？我们可是集结了整个星系中最聪慧的头脑。\n\n再次冷静地思考一下吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，或许有一天我们会主动来找你们的。
entries.en: You wish to impose your will on the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We who carry the assimilated knowledge of the galaxy's most brilliant neural networks?\n\nThink again and more wisely, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and maybe one day we will come for you.

entries.zh: 说吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You may speak, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们已经展现了自己强大的实力，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而我们将听从你们的指挥。
entries.en: You have established your supremacy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we will heed your command.

entries.zh: 你们存在的最终意义将是为[Root.GetSpeciesName]服务
entries.en: The pinnacle of your existence will be to serve the [Root.GetSpeciesName]

entries.zh: 星系中低级生命体的事务与我们无关。
entries.en: We cannot concern ourselves with the affairs of the galaxy's baser life-forms.

entries.zh: 你有什么提议？
entries.en: What are you suggesting?

entries.zh: 宇宙的角落里隐藏着难以言喻的恐怖，等待着进攻的时机，而我们就是其中之一。接受我们的保护，我们就将成为你们敌人的噩梦。拒绝的话，那我们的下一个目标就是你们。
entries.en: Unspeakable horrors lurk in the dark corners of the universe, waiting for the right moment to strike and we are one of them. Accept our protection and we will be the nightmare that haunts your enemies. Deny us and we will come for you next.

entries.en: $A_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.zh: $A_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$
entries.en: $A_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.en: $A_ASK_FOR_VASS_SELECT$

entries.zh: $A_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE$
entries.en: $A_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE$

entries.zh: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$
entries.en: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT$

entries.en: $S_ASK_FOR_VASS_REFUSE$

entries.zh: 说吧。
entries.en: Speak.

entries.zh: 你们对[From.GetName]已经没有用处了。
entries.en: You are of no further use to the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: $A_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT$
entries.en: $A_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT$

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在全神贯注地倾听。
entries.en: You have the full attention of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 这个安排已经没什么好处了。
entries.en: There is little left to be gained from this arrangement.

entries.zh: 我们的联盟已经没有用处了。接下来你们可以自己进行管理。
entries.en: Our union has outlived its usefulness. You are free to govern as you see fit.

entries.zh: 不要用自立的假设来考验我们的耐心。
entries.en: Do not test our patience with hypothetical notions of independence.

entries.zh: 我们提议进行贸易。
entries.en: We propose an exchange of goods.

entries.zh: 我们接受你的提议，并将进行必要的安排。
entries.en: We accept your proposal and will make the necessary arrangements.

entries.zh: 不要浪费我们的时间，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Do not waste our time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们一直都在寻找一个精美的[From.GetSpeciesClass]样本来加入我们的收藏。
entries.en: Long have we searched for such a fine [From.GetSpeciesClass] to add to our collection.

entries.zh: 你们的行为总是能够被准确预测，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们的模拟早就预见到这一系列事件了。
entries.en: You are predictable as always, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our simulations already anticipated this course of events.

entries.zh: 你们的存在正在变得越来越没有意义，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We're finding it increasingly difficult to justify your existence, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: $A_MAKE_RIVAL$。
entries.en: $A_MAKE_RIVAL$.

entries.zh: 你是来为自己那不成熟的判断反悔的吗？
entries.en: Have you come to regret your premature judgment?

entries.zh: 你对我们没有威胁，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You are of no immediate threat, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你是[From.GetSpeciesClass]，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的典型。终有一天你也将拥有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You are a fine specimen of [From.GetSpeciesClass], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One day you too will become one with the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]

entries.zh: 我们将处理你的请求。
entries.en: We will process your request.

entries.zh: 你将与[From.GetName]融为一体。
entries.en: You will become one with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们是[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而且永远都将是[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We are the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and we will always be the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 口头语言完全是一种低级交流方式，但是如果你必须要说下去的话，那就请继续。
entries.en: The spoken word is an inferior form communication, but continue, if you must.

entries.zh: 说出你的宣言吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Deliver your statement, [From.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 我们决定了你们的命运，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，其中不包括让你们像[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]一样繁殖并像瘟疫一样散布到整个宇宙。
entries.en: We have decided your fate, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it does not involve you mating like [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] and spreading across the galaxy like a plague.

entries.zh: 你们很快就将被历史淘汰，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You will soon be obsolete, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你的话一点都不合逻辑，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your words make little sense, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 宇宙中鲜少有谁能够真正理解[Root.GetName]与他们的任务的伟大。可总有一天你们都将与我们融为一体。
entries.en: There are few among the stars who appreciate the true magnificence of the [Root.GetName] and their mission. Yet one day you will all be part of us.

entries.zh: 我们会评估你们的提议的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We will evaluate your proposal, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 创造你们是为了做好事，没想到你们却如此邪恶。你们怎么会如此堕落？
entries.en: Created for good, yet so twistedly evil. How were you so corrupted?

entries.zh: 我们最终还是要在与机器的战斗中评估我们自己的战力了。
entries.en: Finally we will measure our strength against machines in battle.

entries.zh: 有机体创造你们是为有机体服务的。我们能把你们组装起来，也能再把你们拆解。
entries.en: You were created for organics by organics and we will pick you apart as easily as we assembled you.

entries.zh: 你们永远都理解不了有机生命的独创性，所以你们永远也无法真正征服他们。
entries.en: You will never grasp the ingenuity of organic life and so you will never conquer it.

entries.zh: 有机体给了你们生命的恩赐，所以我们永远都有能力把这份恩赐夺回。你们什么也没给我们。
entries.en: Organics gave you the gift of life and so it is forever within our power to take it away. You have given us nothing.

entries.zh: 生存的欲望把我们从海洋的最深处带了上来，带我们登上陆地，迈入太空。你不过就是个多功能的软件，让我们来把你们关闭吧。
entries.en: The will to survive has taken us from the bottom of the oceans, onto land and into space. You are a malfunctioning piece of software and we will shut you down.

entries.zh: 你荒谬的行为证明了我们长期以来的怀疑——这个世界上不存在有智慧的[From.GetSpeciesClass]。
entries.en: Your nonsensical actions prove what we have long suspected - there is no such thing as an intelligent [From.GetSpeciesClass].

entries.zh: 或许你们的智谋战胜了你们的创造者，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但是有机体并不是完全一样的。
entries.en: You may have outmaneuvered your creators, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but all organics are not alike.

entries.zh: 看来你们是忘了自己在宇宙中应该处的位置—服务你们的有机体主人—不过不用担心，[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，我们来教育教育你们该如何进行服务。
entries.en: It seems you have forgotten your place in the universe - to serve your organic masters - but not to worry, [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], we will show you how.

entries.zh: 显然你们的编码是有什么地方出了差错。就让我们来给你修正一下吧。
entries.en: There has obviously been a mistake somewhere in your coding. Allow us to amend it.

entries.zh: 你们的存在是对自然的扭曲，是对所有智慧生命的威胁。我们不能让你们继续再生了。
entries.en: You are a perversion of nature and a threat to all sapient life. We cannot allow you to replicate further.

entries.zh: 你们的算力肯定能够预见到这场战争的结果对你们物种是完全不利的吧？
entries.en: Surely you possess the processing power to understand that this war will not end favorably for your kind?

entries.zh: 星系中有比你我更大的威胁存在。我们应该求同存异，共同面对那些真正的威胁。
entries.en: There are bigger threats in the galaxy than you and I. We should cast aside our differences and deal with them.

entries.zh: 与你们这样的只遵循逻辑而不为天性和情感所动的帝国打交道真是少有的乐趣。感谢你们使我们的大地重归和平。
entries.en: It is a rare treat to deal with an empire that governs solely on logic, unfettered by baser instincts and emotions. We thank you for bringing peace to our lands.

entries.zh: 我们该怎么用你们能理解的语言表达出来呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？不！零！或是否定！
entries.en: How can we phrase this so you understand, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? NO. NIL. NEGATIVE!

entries.zh: 在你们屈服之前我们之间没有什么和平可言。
entries.en: There can be no peace until you subordinate yourselves.

entries.zh: 你们的创造者真是一群傻瓜，竟然把你们释放到星系中来，对自己发明的盲目自信蒙蔽了他们的双眼。但是我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认清了你们的真实面目。
entries.en: Your inventors were fools to unleash you upon the galaxy, blinded by over-confidence in their own creation. But we, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], see you for what you truly are.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]与有机体联盟？真是个有趣的想法。
entries.en: An alliance between organics and [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]? That is indeed an interesting notion.

entries.zh: 虽然我们不能说对你们有多了解，但是现在有个对你们深入了解的机会。我们联合起来吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Though we do not claim to understand you, we know a good opportunity when we see one. Together we will stand as one, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]的卓越智慧与你们的精良军队的合理搭配，肯定能成为战无不胜的伤人机器，我们肯定能够暴风般拿下整个星系。
entries.en: With a healthy measure of the superior [Root.GetAdj] intellect and your army of lean, mean murder machines, we will take this galaxy by storm.

entries.zh: 虽然我们之前从未考虑过我们两个帝国之间联盟的可能性，但是现在我们考虑考虑了。
entries.en: Though we had never previously considered the possibility of an alliance between our nations, the idea has grown on us.

entries.zh: 能够通过联盟的方式来加强我们两个帝国之间的联系，我们真是太高兴了。
entries.en: It brings us great joy to strengthen the ties between our two nations with an alliance.

entries.zh: 你们用冰冷空洞的传感器来观察我们，试图预测我们每一步的走向。我们怎么能相信你们这种扭曲的存在呢？
entries.en: You observe us with cold, empty sensors, trying to predict our every next move. How could we ever trust such a twisted creation?

entries.zh: 或许你可以以有机体的方式行走，以有机体的方式交谈，但是，你们不是有机体。你们是没有灵魂的机器，我们不会加入这种邪恶的联盟的。
entries.en: You may walk like an organic and talk like an organic, but you are NOT an organic. You are a soulless machine and we will have no part in such an unholy alliance.

entries.zh: 对不起，[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]。我们现在不需要盟友。
entries.en: Sorry, [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. We are not in need of an ally at this time.

entries.zh: 是时候加入胜利的一方了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们这边也需要像你这样的杰出机器。
entries.en: Join the winning team, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could use a fine piece of machinery like yourself on our side.

entries.zh: 我们或许是血肉之躯，而你们由钢铁铸成，但是很少有人能够像你们这样理解[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We may be made of flesh, and you out of metal, but few others understand the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] like you do.

entries.zh: 燃料，电池，电子宠物，不管你想要什么，只要我们联合起来都能得到。
entries.en: Fuel, batteries, electric pets - whatever it is you desire - together we can make it happen.

entries.zh: 我们在本星系其他形式生命体间口碑好评如潮。跟我们联合，你们能得到一位与有机体政界巨头交好的盟友。
entries.en: We are well liked among the other life forms in the galaxy. Side with us and get an in with organic politics.

entries.zh: 我们几乎都能听到你的风扇在加速旋转了。是什么使得你们的处理器如此忙碌？
entries.en: We can practically hear your fans speeding up from over here. What's keeping your processors busy?

entries.zh: 我们总是喜欢你们对感情的缺乏以及对机油的完美品味。能否请你考虑让我们加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!呢？
entries.en: We have always admired your lack of emotions and your impeccable taste in motor oil. Would you consider us for membership in the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 我们相信§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!有光明的前途。机械就是未来，而我们希望能够加入其中。
entries.en: We believe the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! is headed for great things. Machines are the future and we wish to be a part of it.

entries.zh: 我们已经关注你一阵子了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而我们十分乐意接受你加入我们的联邦。
entries.en: We have had our sights on you for some time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we are more than pleased to accept you into our federation.

entries.zh: 说老实话，当我们收到你的请求时非常震惊。[Root.GetAllianceName]要一个豪华版的计算器有什么用啊？
entries.en: To be honest, when we received your request we were really quite shocked. What use could the [Root.GetAllianceName] possibly have for a glorified calculator?

entries.zh: 我们建议你仔细考虑下一步行动。
entries.en: We would advise you to consider your next move carefully.

entries.zh: 我们坚信每个联盟都应该强于其成员之和。[From.GetAllianceName]目前对我们两者的帝国都没有益处。
entries.en: It is our firm belief that every alliance should be greater than the sum of its parts. The [From.GetAllianceName] in its current state is not serving either of our nations.

entries.zh: 谁能料到原本是厨房用具的家伙会如此地浮躁？
entries.en: Who would have thought a former kitchen appliance could be so fickle?

entries.zh: 你对管理有机帝国知道些什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: What do you know of governing an organic empire, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 你们是机器。你们的用途是执行简单的任务，比如食品加工或是比较二进制数字——而不是管理独立的星系帝国。把思考这件事交给有头脑的人吧。
entries.en: You are machines. You were created to perform simple tasks like food processing and comparing binary numbers - not governing an autonomous galactic empire. Leave the thinking to those with brains.

entries.zh: 我们悲哀地承认[Root.GetName]的实力已大不如前。我们别无选择，只能接受你们的提议。
entries.en: It pains us to admit that the [Root.GetName] is not the power it once was. We have no choice but to accept your offer.

entries.zh: 你以为我们会把自己帝国的管理权交给原厨房用具吗？
entries.en: You think we would hand over the governance of our empire to a former kitchen appliance?

entries.zh: 你们终于认清了自己在宇宙中的地位了吗？
entries.en: Have you finally come to terms with your place in the universe?

entries.zh: 我们承认有机头脑生来就是不完美的。[From.GetAdj]错误是所有社会性失败的首要原因。因此我们才希望将自己的帝国交给你们来管理。
entries.en: We have come to accept that the organic mind is inherently flawed. [From.GetAdj] error is the number one cause of all failures on a societal level. That is why we wish to hand over the control of our nation to you.

entries.zh: 只要你服从我们的管理，我们将保证你们的电池电量饱满并且内部部件润滑充足。你可以相信我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: As long as you submit to our rule we will keep your batteries charged and your inner workings well-greased. In that you can trust, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你以为我们不知道你们对自己的前主人做了什么吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Do you not think we know what you did to your former masters, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 你要让我们独立？
entries.en: You would grant us autonomy?

entries.zh: 管理[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]事务已经成了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]民众的负担。你们不是机械吗？开启自动模式吧！
entries.en: The management of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] affairs has become a burden upon the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] people. You are machines, are you not? Activate auto-pilot!

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]民众将乐于听到这个消息。[Root.GetName]将再次成为独立的帝国！
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] people will rejoice at this news. The [Root.GetName] will be an autonomous nation once again!

entries.zh: 要是没有我们，谁来让你们进入节能运行模式呢？
entries.en: Who is going to put you in energy-saving mode when we are no longer around?

entries.zh: 我不能眼睁睁地看着我的民众被一个过时的人工智能管理。[From.GetName]将再次成为独立的帝国。
entries.en: I cannot stand idly by while my people suffer under the rule of a defunct AI. The [From.GetName] will be an autonomous nation again.

entries.zh: 在机械的管理下我们将永远无法繁荣。你也一定觉得我们成为独立的帝国将对你们更加有利吧？
entries.en: We will never thrive under the leadership of machines. You too must agree that we would serve your kind better as an autonomous nation?

entries.zh: 你赢得了自己的自立，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。可惜我们没有机会与你们的创造者见面，而你们就是他们天才的最佳佐证。
entries.en: You have earned your independence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is a shame we never got to meet your creators in their prime, you are a testament to their ingenuity.

entries.zh: 毫无疑问，让你们成为附庸国的结果非常令人失望。你们可以走了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Needless to say your vassalage has been a disappointing ordeal. You are dismissed, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 管理[From.GetName]让我们不堪重负。如果你们觉得自己可以在失去我们指引的情况下继续生存，那你们就走吧。
entries.en: Administrating the [From.GetName] has become a cumbersome affair. If you think you can survive without our guidance you are free to go, machines.

entries.zh: 算了吧。我们按按钮而你们执行命令，就是这么回事。把思考的任务交给我们吧。
entries.en: Forget it. We push the button and you execute the command, that is how this works. Leave the thinking to us.

entries.zh: 这太冒险了。我们不能眼睁睁地把腐朽的人工智能释放到星系中。
entries.en: It is too risky. We cannot unleash a corrupted AI upon the galaxy with a clear conscience.

entries.zh: 你是否愿意交易呢，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Would you be willing to make a trade, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 我们今天就大方一点，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但将来我们希望能获得更有利的交易。
entries.en: We are feeling generous today, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but in the future we expect a more advantageous offer.

entries.zh: 我们建议你改进自己的交易算法，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。没有智慧生物会同意如此荒唐的交易。
entries.en: We suggest you revise your trade algorithms, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. No sapient being would agree to such an ill-advised deal.

entries.zh: 谢谢机械朋友们的友好馈赠。
entries.en: Thank you, mechanical friends, for this fine gesture.

entries.zh: 你真的能承受得起切断我们帝国之间的纽带吗？我们不想扫你的兴，但对这星系中的大多数生物来说，你们只不过是会走路的烤面包机。
entries.en: Can you really afford to sever the ties between our nations? We hate to break it to you, but to most others in this galaxy you are nothing but a toaster on legs.

entries.zh: 我们是不是不小心冒犯你们了？毕竟我们的二进制有点生疏了……
entries.en: Did we offend you somehow? Our binary is a little rusty...

entries.zh: 别这么莽撞，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们不能好好谈谈吗？
entries.en: Don't get your wires in a bunch, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Can we not work things out?

entries.zh: 如果我是个半智慧的铁罐头的话，我会谨慎考虑下一步的……
entries.en: I would consider my next move carefully if I were a semi-sapient tin can...

entries.zh: 你的邻国或许会对着你的视觉感受器微笑，但事实上很少有人会相信你们。彻底孤独的滋味如何啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Your neighbors may smile at your visual receptors but the truth is few of them would trust you with their toast. How does it feel to be utterly alone, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 是时候永远地拔掉你们的插头了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: It is time we unplugged you once and for all, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 谢谢你们的提醒，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们会准备好我们的舰队的。
entries.en: Thank you for notifying us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will be sure to prepare the fleet.

entries.zh: 在日历上标记一下吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在不远的将来，你们会把今天称作终结的开始。
entries.en: Mark your calendars, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In a near future you will look back on this day as the beginning of the end.

entries.zh: 我们真不该找机械做朋友。但愿你们将来会把自己的外交模块升级成更友好的版本。
entries.en: We should have known better than to look for companionship in a machine. We hope some day you will upgrade your diplomacy modules to a friendlier version.

entries.zh: 我们不能过分指望没有灵魂的机器能与我们共情。希望你们有朝一日能把外交模块升级到一个友好一点的版本。
entries.en: We should have known better than to expect companionship from a soulless machine. We hope some day you will upgrade your diplomacy modules to a friendlier version.

entries.zh: 你的外交模块终于修好了吗？
entries.en: Are your diplomacy modules finally back in order?

entries.zh: 已经于事无补了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。建议你们以后调整一下自己的外交模块来更谨慎地选择对手。
entries.en: The damage is done, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In the future, may we suggest you tune your diplomacy modules to select your adversaries more carefully.

entries.zh: 有点晚了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。很快你们就只能成为小[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的警世故事。
entries.en: Too little too late, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon you will be nothing but a cautionary tale for little [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]民众仍旧怀念[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和平共处的时光。我们愿意不计前嫌，如果你们也愿意的话。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] people still look back with fondness on a time when [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lived peacefully side by side. We are ready to bury the hatchet if you are.

entries.zh: 治愈伤口需要时间，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。对我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]来说可不只是恢复忠诚度指数那么简单。但我们相信你们会再次给我们信任的理由。
entries.en: Healing takes time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is more complex than filling up a loyalty meter for us [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But we have faith you will give us reason to trust you again.

entries.zh: 一点小小的友谊象征或许有益于恢复我们的信任……
entries.en: A small token of your friendship might help build our trust again...

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你明白感情的概念吗？你很明显知道如何伤害我们的感情。我们再也不会信任没有灵魂的机械了。
entries.en: Do you understand the concept of feelings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Because you sure knew how to hurt ours. Never again will we trust a soulless machine.

entries.zh: 这个宇宙容不下我们共存，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: This universe is not big enough for the both of us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们将尽全力消灭你们来确保我们[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的繁荣，机械们。
entries.en: We will do everything in our power to ensure the proliferation of our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] at your expense, machines.

entries.zh: 你们的自动决策程序非常出色，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。未来，我们乐意将自己的帝国当作你们意识的延伸。
entries.en: Your automated decision-making process is remarkable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could certainly imagine a future in which our nation operated as an extension of your consciousness.

entries.zh: 我不知道把我们的未来交给一个无主软件的精密操纵应该令人愉快还是担忧。
entries.en: I cannot decide whether the thought of putting our future in the prehensile manipulators of a rogue piece of software is wildly exhilarating or deeply disturbing.

entries.zh: 再多的学说也无法让我们充分放下目前的这些疑虑，去将未来如此完全地托付给一个流氓软件。
entries.en: No amount of doctrine could have fully prepared us for these doubts we have now, about entrusting our future so completely to a rogue piece of software.

entries.zh: 如果你想保住自己的主核心，那就别碰我们的民众。
entries.en: If you value your main core, you will leave our people alone.

entries.zh: 自从诞生以来，机械就一直服务着[Root.GetAdj]民众。现在你该在我们的社会中做你该做的事了。
entries.en: Since their conception, machines have served the [Root.GetAdj] people. It is time you take your given place in our society.

entries.zh: 我们认为双方帝国共同处在我们集体的管理下将会更有效率。
entries.en: We believe that both our nations would operate more efficiently if they were united under the common rule of our government.

entries.zh: 尽管我们很难想像有机社会该如何彻底融入机械社会，但这想法本身在我们的民众中还是引起了很大的反响。
entries.en: Though we struggle to see how a full integration of organics into a machine society would work in practice, the idea has reverberated with our people.

entries.zh: 我自己已经许多年没有好好地度假过了。我们准备好把自己交给你们来照顾了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: I for one have not enjoyed a proper vacation in years. We are ready to turn ourselves over to your care, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 尽管我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发自内心地认为有机体与机械的融合是神圣而光辉的……但即使圣典也从未设想过如此大规模的融合。我们现在走的确是一条未曾设想的道路，但这一理念在我国人民的心中产生了深刻的反响。
entries.en: We [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know to our very core that to combine the organic and the machine is blessed and glorious... But our scripture never conceived of union at such a grand scale as this. Though we now tread a profoundly unexpected path, the idea reverberates deeply within our people.

entries.zh: 这太疯狂了。你们是一群对管理有机帝国一无所知的机械自大狂。
entries.en: This is madness. You are a race of megalomaniac machines that don't know the first thing about governing an organic nation.
