entries.zh: 不要考验我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们对如何格式化硬盘还是很了解的。
entries.en: Do not test us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know a thing or two about reformatting hard drives.

entries.zh: 拿出点真本事来吧，饶舌机器人。让我们看看你们的处理器有多大能耐。
entries.en: Put your money where your energy intake ports are, chatterbots. Show us what those processors can do.

entries.zh: 你们的创造者真是个谜，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。他们为何要造出如此令人恼火的造物？
entries.en: Your makers are an enigma, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why would they create such an infuriating contraption?

entries.zh: 我们可以更好地利用那些处理能力，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你要不要把下半辈子用在计算有机生命的意义上？
entries.en: We could put that processing power to better use, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How would you like to spend the rest of your days calculating the meaning of organic life?

entries.zh: 难道就没有办法关闭你的外交模块吗？
entries.en: Is there no way to deactivate your diplomacy modules?

entries.zh: 你们是被自己的造物毁灭的离经叛道的物种诱发了思考能力的石头。真是进化的杰作……
entries.en: You are a rock tricked into thinking by a race of misguided organics that did not survive the fallout of their own failed creation. Evolution hard at work...

entries.zh: 我宁可与我其他的家用电器讨论星际局势也不要和你讨论。
entries.en: I would rather discuss interstellar politics with any of my other household appliances than you.

entries.zh: 你好啊小机器人。你学会数数了吗，还是说你还卡在零和一上？
entries.en: Hello little botlings. Have you learned how to count yet, or are you still stuck on ones and zeros?

entries.zh: 你可真令我惊讶，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你身上的漏洞和错误比类人猿的那些什么自助餐上的食物还多。
entries.en: Color me impressed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have more bugs than an arthropoid all-you-can-eat dung buffet.

entries.zh: 你以为我们不能看穿你那薄薄的塑胶皮肤和措辞不当的陈词滥调吗？你只是个复制品。一群无可救药的零和一，仅此而已。
entries.en: Do you think we can't see past your flimsy layers of plastiskin and poorly phrased platitudes? You are a replica. A helpless jumble of ones and zeros, nothing more.

entries.zh: 你的人工智能还真是够“智能”的啊？简直笨到家了……
entries.en: You really do put the 'artificial' in artificial intelligence, don't you? Not much going on under the hood...

entries.zh: 你最后一次彻底升级系统是什么时候？你的那些俏皮话真是太老套了。
entries.en: When did you last have a full systems upgrade? Your sorry attempts at witticisms are getting old.

entries.zh: 我们有其他事需要处理，暂时让你们多活一会。
entries.en: We offer you a brief pause from your inevitable extermination while we direct our attention elsewhere.

entries.zh: 这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。
entries.en: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你们的信息，我们看都懒得看。
entries.en: We have not attempted to parse your message.

entries.zh: 我们明明想堂堂正正地大战一场，为何还要给我们在背后捅刀子的机会？
entries.en: Why offer us an opportunity to put a knife in your back when we are so openly eager to stab you in the face?

entries.zh: 我们不想跟你们合作，我们只想彻底消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Any attempt to cooperate would be marred by our unrelenting pursuit of the extinction of the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你想让我们为宇宙的寄生虫效劳？
entries.en: Are you requesting we do the bidding of a cosmic plague?

entries.zh: 如果你们愿意帮助我们消灭一些更恶心的物种，我们可以考虑暂且饶你们一命。
entries.en: You can be spared for a little longer if you serve as our instrument in the eradication of even more foul species.

entries.zh: 我们宁愿扼杀我们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，摧毁所建造的一切，每个[From.GetSpeciesName]宁愿将自己的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]剖开也不愿意与你为伍。
entries.en: We would smother our [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], destroy all we have built, and each [From.GetSpeciesName] would cut their [From.GetSpeciesOrganName] open before serving you.

entries.zh: 你会让我们再次获得随意攻击的权利吗？
entries.en: Will you unleash us to once again incinerate all life on our own discretion?

entries.zh: 我们绝不放过这个机会。一定要将这些外星垃圾彻底清除。
entries.en: We will not let this opportunity pass us by. The galaxy will soon be cleansed of alien filth.

entries.zh: 我们必须摆脱这种低声下气的扭曲局面，回到我们该走的路上！
entries.en: We need to be freed from this twisted state of subservience to return to our true cause!

entries.zh: 如果你们的代表躲在这栋建筑里面不出来，还能暂时保住小命。
entries.en: If we can keep your delegation safely contained within this building, their extermination will be delayed.

entries.zh: 出于原则，我们会先毁灭你们文明的其他一切，最后再烧掉这座丑陋的建筑。
entries.en: As a matter of principle, this foul building will be the last part of your civilization that we burn.

entries.zh: 关于你们的大使馆，我们已改变了政策。大使馆将不再享受庇护，已被我们彻底摧毁。
entries.en: We changed our policy regarding your embassy. It was no longer exempt from extermination and has been vaporized accordingly.

entries.zh: 我们近期已经作出决定，将对所有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的无差别屠杀和清理确定为优先事项。
entries.en: A recent decision has been made to prioritize the indiscriminate massacre and disposal of all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们不在乎宇宙中哪个垃圾又将我们视为“宿敌”。毕竟你们最终都是要被清算的。
entries.en: We do not care whether any variety of galactic rot considers us "rivals." You will all be liquidated eventually.

entries.zh: 你们为什么要用奇怪的织物将自己罩起来？是想隐藏什么？还是单纯为自己丑陋的外表感到羞耻呢？
entries.en: Why do you cover yourselves in strange textiles? Are you hiding something, or are you simply ashamed of your unfortunate appearance?

entries.zh: 瞻仰[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的身躯吧，它是如此荣耀，毫无遮掩地供所有人赞叹。而[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]却躲在层层衣物之下，为自己可悲的形态感到羞愧。
entries.en: Behold the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] form, glorious and bared for all to admire. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hide beneath layers of cloth, ashamed of their own pitiful forms.

entries.zh: §R<<呸！>>§!为什么你那黏糊糊的器官那样毫无拘束地在那儿晃悠？还有为何你们不像其他有机生物一样把自己包裹起来？没人对你们那肉乎乎的身体感兴趣。
entries.en: §R<<BAH!>>§! Why are your squishy bits dangling about freely like so? And why do you not cover yourselves like the other organics? Nobody is impressed with your meaty form.

entries.zh: 疯狂的原始生物！你们妄图藏起你们那恶心的液体分泌物的行为会遭全宇宙的高等物种唾弃，你们所谓的美也将成为物种丑陋新境界的标杆！
entries.en: Ludicrous bare-apes! Your attempts to hide your repulsive fluid secretions are mocked by all finer species and your vanity is the hallmark of an inherently ugly breed.

entries.zh: 不管你们怎么梳理打扮，那可悲的毛发都会成为全星系生毛物种的笑柄。
entries.en: No matter how you comb and prune, your pitiful fur-growths will always be the laughingstock of all properly hirsute beings in the galaxy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]似乎更适合作为奴隶，而不是领导一个星际文明。
entries.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] seems more suited to pulling a cart than leading an interstellar society.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]嘴吐不出象牙。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mouths have never produced anything more eloquent than a hairball.

entries.zh: 想把我们的高等智慧分享给愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesName]简直就是对牛弹琴。
entries.en: Trying to share our wisdom with the simpleton [Root.GetSpeciesName] would be pearls before swine.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成为了我们宗教艺术中的重要部分。当然，都是以怪物和恶魔的形象出现。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have grown to be a popular motif in our religious art. Unavoidably, only as demons and monsters, of course.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的面部特征真是奇妙。谁能想到你们只需要把大脑扔掉就能进化出这样的扁脑袋来呢？
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] physiognomy is fascinating. Who would think that you could evolve such flat heads simply by no longer having brains?

entries.zh: 真是头废物一样的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: What a talentless-looking [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]要支撑如此巨大的角，脑盖儿一定很厚吧。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must have very thick craniums to support those horns.

entries.zh: 神灵在用折纸创造你们的时候，一定是不小心把你们的里面向外翻出来了。
entries.en: Whatever origami-maker folded your face must have accidentally turned it inside-out.

entries.zh: 你们[Root.GetSpeciesName]的眼睛不少，只可惜有眼无珠。
entries.en: All those eyes and you [Root.GetSpeciesName] can't see further than your ridiculous noses.

entries.zh: 我们开始怀疑[Root.GetSpeciesName]是哺乳动物与节肢动物基因组合的结果了。唯有这样才能解释他们那奇怪的下颌骨和原始的大脑。
entries.en: We have begun to speculate that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] are the result of gene-splicing mammals with arthropods. That would explain both the mandibles and the sub-par brains.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]全部人民的脸蛋都被烧掉了。我们对此巨大灾难表示哀悼，同时对他们的下一代献上诚挚的祝福。
entries.en: Our condolences to those affected by the huge catastrophe that appears to have burned the faces off the entire [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. Our best wishes to the next generation.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]所能获得的最高荣耀就是把你们的化石挂在盾牌上当装饰。
entries.en: The greatest glory [Root.GetSpeciesName] can hope for is to have your fossils mounted on shields as decorations.

entries.zh: 你的相貌就和你脑后的刚毛一样辣[Root.GetEyeNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your face is about as easy on the [Root.GetEyeNamePlural] as the back of your head is to the touch.

entries.zh: 你想建立相互保护关系吗？
entries.en: Do you wish to arrange for mutual protection?

entries.zh: 我们不想把你们的帝国卷入冲突，但联手面对可能的威胁明显对我们都有好处。
entries.en: We would not want to drag your empire into a conflict, but it is clear that we would benefit from joining together against possible threats.

entries.zh: 我们彼此照应，互帮互助。
entries.en: You watch our backs, we'll watch yours.

entries.zh: 我们自己能照顾好自己。
entries.en: We will do quite fine on our own.

entries.zh: 你想结束我们之间的防御约定吗？
entries.en: You want to end our defensive arrangement?

entries.zh: 我们认为此共同防御约定已经没有价值。
entries.en: We no longer find this mutual promise of defense worthwhile.

entries.zh: 我们此后将重新依靠自己的力量。祝好运。
entries.en: So we are once again on our own. Best of luck.

entries.zh: 你想与[Root.GetName]达成和平关系吗？
entries.en: You want to secure peaceful relations with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 宇宙中本已危机四伏，[Root.GetName]跟[From.GetName]之间不应该再发生冲突。我们建议签署互不攻击约定以保障彼此的安全。
entries.en: The galaxy presents enough threats without having to worry about a war between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. We suggest entering into a non-aggression pact to mutually secure peace.

entries.zh: 我们双方都无法从战争中得到好处。我们同意签署互不攻击约定。
entries.en: We cannot see what either of us would stand to win from a war. We agree to enter into a pact of non-aggression.

entries.zh: 我们没必要向[From.GetName]提供互不攻击的保证。
entries.en: We see no reason to provide the [From.GetName] with the safety of a non-aggression pact.

entries.zh: 这对今后我们之间的外交没有好处。
entries.en: This cannot bode well for our future diplomacy.

entries.zh: 我们不想继续遵守此互不攻击约定，因为我们的外交政策长期掣肘于此约定。
entries.en: We no longer have any interest in maintaining this non-aggression pact. We have limited our diplomatic options for far too long.

entries.zh: 如今的宇宙局势对你我双方都变得更加危险了。希望你知道如此做的后果。
entries.en: The galaxy is now a more dangerous place for the both of us. We hope you understand the weight of your actions.

entries.zh: 那么，[From.GetName]愿意继续保证我们的独立完整了？
entries.en: So the [From.GetName] is prepared to vouch for our continued sovereignty?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]认为[Root.GetName]的自身权力不可冒犯。我们将不惜一切代价守护这项合法权益。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] views the continued independence of the [Root.GetName] as a prerogative. We are prepared to formally devote ourselves to that cause.

entries.zh: 总之，谢谢你们的支持。
entries.en: Whatever your reasons, your support is appreciated.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]不愿意继续保护[Root.GetAdj]的权力与完整了吗？
entries.en: Is the [From.GetName] no longer interested in protecting [Root.GetAdj] independence?

entries.zh: 很不幸，保障[Root.GetAdj]的权力与完整已经不再是我们的主要方针。
entries.en: Unfortunately, securing [Root.GetAdj] independence can no longer be a priority to us.

entries.zh: 好吧。[Root.GetAdj]将始终维持自身权力，无论[From.GetAdj]支持与否。
entries.en: Very well. [Root.GetAdj] sovereignty will remain, with or without [From.GetAdj] aid.

entries.zh: 你是想挑拨我们与宗主的关系吗？
entries.en: Are you seeking to sow discord between us and our overlords?

entries.zh: 也就是说你可以为我们指明一条通往摆脱拘束的路。请继续说下去。
entries.en: So you may be able to offer us a path to freedom. Please continue.

entries.zh: 像你们这样的社会不应该屈服于异族的统治。如果你们想摆脱拘束，我们可以提供帮助。
entries.en: A society such as your own should not be content to bow down in servitude. If you ever seek freedom, you have our aid.

entries.zh: 我们对这种反抗毫无兴趣。希望以后的统治者不会拿这件事说事……
entries.en: We are not interested in this display. Hopefully future administrations will not make use of it...

entries.zh: 谢谢你，[From.GetSpeciesName]。有朝一日[Root.GetSpeciesName]崛起时，我们不会忘记你的。
entries.en: Thank you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. When the day comes for the [Root.GetSpeciesName] to rise up, we will remember this.

entries.zh: 你们想要结束这种无意义的反抗吗？
entries.en: Are you putting an end to this unnecessary display of power?

entries.zh: 你们不愿继续支持我们了吗？要知道，我们崛起的日子可能不远了。
entries.en: You wish to retract your support? The day when we rise up may not be far away.

entries.zh: 我们无法继续支持你们争取权力了。
entries.en: We can no longer offer our support to your quest for sovereignty.

entries.zh: 很好。我们本就没有抗争的意思，更不愿因此平添麻烦。
entries.en: Good. We would rather not have this looming over us when we have no intention to start a conflict over it.

entries.zh: 真是可惜。我们本来对你们抱有很大期望的。
entries.en: A shame. We really counted on you.

entries.zh: 你想让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]人与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人在两国之间任意寻找安家落户之地？
entries.en: You want the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people to seek their homes freely among us?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人不应该被拘禁在[Root.GetName]，而我们的人也不应该被局限在自己的领地中。让我们共同寻求解决方法吧。
entries.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people should not be prisoners in the [Root.GetName] and neither should our own people be limited to inhabit our territory. Let us agree to remedy this.

entries.zh: 开放殖民对[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]双方都有好处。
entries.en: Opening migration between us will make for a better future for [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] alike.

entries.zh: 我们不想开放双方之间任意移民。
entries.en: We are not interested in allowing migration between our nations.

entries.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]是按照个人喜怒来反对我们双方之间的互通有无吗？
entries.en: Does [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] object to your people and ours intermingling as they please?

entries.zh: 这项试验已经进行了很长时间。我们的移民约定被证明是一个彻头彻尾的错误，应当立即停止。
entries.en: This experiment has gone on long enough. Our migration treaty has turned out to be a serious mistake and will be canceled with immediate effect.

entries.zh: 很遗憾，你限制了你们帝国的未来。甚至连[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都要为此付出代价。
entries.en: Sad to see you limit opportunities for your own people. Even more so that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have to suffer for it.

entries.zh: 是欢迎我们回来吗？
entries.en: Are you welcoming us back?

entries.zh: 我们已经找不到对你们封锁边境的理由。我们的边境将再次向你们敞开。
entries.en: We no longer see any reason to keep you locked out of our territory. Our borders are open to you again.

entries.zh: 非常感谢你们的款待与信任。
entries.en: Your hospitality and trust are appreciated.

entries.zh: 我们的舰船惹到你们了吗？
entries.en: Why would our ships' presence be a problem to you?

entries.zh: 长期以来我们允许你们在我们的领地内来去自如。如今，我们将划清界限。
entries.en: We have allowed you to move about freely in our territory for too long. Today we draw the line.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。我们会暂时远离你的领地。
entries.en: So be it. We will keep out for now.

entries.zh: 你们要将我们赶出[Root.GetAllianceName]吗？
entries.en: Would you exclude us from the [Root.GetAllianceName]?

entries.zh: 我们不能让你继续待在联邦中了。你必须靠你自己了。
entries.en: We can no longer let you be part of the Federation. You must walk your own way.

entries.zh: 可惜，我们的合作竟如此告终。
entries.en: A shame for our cooperation to end like this.

entries.zh: 跟[From.GetAllianceName]合作？
entries.en: A partnership with the [From.GetAllianceName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetAllianceName]不仅仅是局限于跟成员合作。我们愿意向[Root.GetName]提供合作国地位。
entries.en: The [From.GetAllianceName] does not only cooperate with its members. We would like to extend an offer of association status to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 很荣幸可以跟[From.GetAllianceName]合作。
entries.en: We're glad to have this opportunity to work with the [From.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: 我们对跟[From.GetAllianceName]合作不感兴趣。
entries.en: We are not interested in cooperating with the [From.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: 亲爱的盟友，虽然§Y[Root.GetName]§!尚未有资格加入我们，但是我们建议联邦赋予他们合作国地位以保持亲密的关系。
entries.en: Dear ally, although the §Y[Root.GetName]§! may not qualify for membership yet, we strongly suggest our federation grants them association status to secure cordial relations.

entries.zh: [From.GetAllianceName]准备结束双方之间的共识了吗？
entries.en: Is the [From.GetAllianceName] ending our mutual understanding?

entries.zh: [From.GetAllianceName]不会再专注于对外合作。[Root.GetName]的合作国地位将会被终止。
entries.en: The [From.GetAllianceName] is turning its focus away from external cooperation such as ours. The association status of the [Root.GetName] has come to an end.

entries.zh: 看来[From.GetAllianceName]只打算跟自己的人民玩家家。你一定会后悔这个决定的。
entries.en: So [From.GetAllianceName] will have to make do with its own members. No doubt you will soon regret this decision.

entries.zh: 亲爱的盟友，我们的联邦跟§Y[Root.GetName]§!之间的关系开始成为累赘了。我们建议废除他们的合作国地位。
entries.en: Dear ally, our federation's relationship with the §Y[Root.GetName]§! is becoming a problem. We suggest revoking their association status.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]有没有兴趣获取§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位？
entries.en: Is the [From.GetName] interested in attaining association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]愿意跟§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!达成更紧密的合作关系。成员国资格我们暂且不过问，但你们能否考虑给予我们合作国地位？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would like to cooperate more closely with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!. Leaving aside the question of membership, would you consider granting us association status?

entries.zh: 我们非常期待[From.GetName]与§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!之间能够通力合作！我们应当立刻就事项进行投票表决。
entries.en: We look forward to having the [From.GetName] work with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!! We shall start a vote on the matter immediately.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!不是很有意愿与[From.GetName]如此紧密地合作。
entries.en: The §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! would rather not associate itself so closely with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]跟[Root.GetAllianceName]相互理解的时代莫非要就此终结了？
entries.en: Is the [From.GetName]'s understanding with the [Root.GetAllianceName] coming to an end?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已无意继续成为[Root.GetAllianceName]的合作国。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] no longer has any interest in maintaining its association status with the [Root.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]在失去[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的帮助后只能自力更生。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAllianceName] shall have to do without its [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends.

entries.zh: 你想与[Root.GetName]展开商业合作吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: You want to cooperate commercially with the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 我们认为[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]可以互利互惠。我们提议签订一项双赢的商业协议。
entries.en: We believe that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have much to offer one another. We suggest entering into a mutually beneficial commercial pact.

entries.zh: 嗯，这提议不错。我们同意签订商业协议。
entries.en: Yes, this is a sound proposal. We agree to your offer of a commercial pact.

entries.zh: 我们无意资助你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们拒绝签订商业协议。
entries.en: We have no wish to subsidize your finances, [From.GetSpeciesName]. There will be no commercial pact.

entries.zh: 但是……我们的经济怎么办？
entries.en: But... what of the economy?

entries.zh: 我们觉得商业协议已经对我们无益。从现在起，协议取消。
entries.en: We no longer feel that the commercial agreement with us is to our advantage. As of today, it is void.

entries.zh: 真是太不幸了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你损害了我们共同的经济利益。
entries.en: This is most unfortunate, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You have weakened both our economies.

entries.zh: 你想与我们签订科研协议吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: You want to form a research agreement with us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 我们有许多可以互相学习的东西，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们提议两国之间签署科研协议。
entries.en: We have much to learn from one another, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We propose the creation of a Research Agreement between our empires.

entries.zh: 很好。我们将与[From.GetName]互相交换知识。
entries.en: Very well. We will share our knowledge with the [From.GetName] in exchange for your own.

entries.zh: 不，[From.GetName]。我们对你们那土著的科技不感兴趣。
entries.en: No, [From.GetName]. Your primitive technology is of no interest to us.

entries.zh: 你为何希望终止我们科学家之间的合作？
entries.en: Why do you wish to end the cooperation between our scientists?

entries.zh: 我们认为与你们共享科技已经没有好处了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们帝国之间的科研协议从此作废。
entries.en: We no longer see the benefit in sharing our technology with you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The research agreement between our empires is no more.

entries.zh: 这真是太遗憾了。我们不明白你为何决定停止分享你的智慧。
entries.en: This is most distressing. We do not understand why you have decided to close your minds to us.

entries.zh: 你觉得[Root.GetName]欠你们贡品吗？
entries.en: You think the [Root.GetName] owes you tribute?

entries.zh: 我们并不是要你们放弃自理，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但你们也该还清旧账了。
entries.en: We are not asking you to give up your autonomy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but you must pay your dues.

entries.zh: 从我们目前的状况来看，这应该是最好的安排了。
entries.en: This is probably the best arrangement given our current position.

entries.zh: 对于敲诈勒索，我们绝不容忍。别想从我们这里得到一分一毫！
entries.en: We do not tolerate extortion. You'll get nothing from us.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]召唤我们来此，是否是希望向我们朝贡？
entries.en: Have we been brought here by [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who wish to pay us tribute?

entries.zh: 我们想要向[Root.GetName]展现我们的忠诚与慷慨。
entries.en: We wish to make an arrangement to show the [Root.GetName] the loyalty and generosity it deserves.

entries.zh: 这个供奉很适合[Root.GetName]。真希望别人也这么慷慨啊。
entries.en: This offering suits the [Root.GetName] well. If only others were as generous.

entries.zh: 我们不想要你的供奉。你们配不上。
entries.en: We don't want what you have to offer. You're not worthy to pay us this price.

entries.zh: 仆从国？这个词在我们和你们的语言中意思是不是不大一样……
entries.en: Thrall? We hope this is merely a quirk of your language...

entries.zh: 你们没必要这么自寻死路的。只要停止扩张，认我们为主人，我们就保全你们的小命。
entries.en: There is no need for you to perish. Cease your expansion and accept us as your masters, and you shall be spared.

entries.zh: 我们同意成为你们的仆从国。
entries.en: We will become your thrall.

entries.zh: 我们是绝不会成为你们的仆从国的。
entries.en: We will never become your thrall.

entries.zh: 你们准备好迎接自己的宿命，成为[Root.GetName]的仆从国了吗？
entries.en: Are you prepared to accept your rightful position as thralls of the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 状况已经很明确了。不用说，[From.GetName]只有成为[Root.GetName]的仆从国才能得以存续啊。
entries.en: The circumstances of our situations are clear. We know the [From.GetName] can only survive as a thrall of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们总算找到自己在这星系中的位置了吗，仆从国。
entries.en: You have finally found your place in this galaxy, thrall.

entries.zh: 你们这种不知所谓的文明，连做我们的仆从国也不配啊。
entries.en: Your ridiculous civilization is not worth keeping even as a thrall.

entries.zh: 神域？还要皈依你们的宗教？
entries.en: Dominion? Under your faith?

entries.zh: 你们还不算不可救药。向智慧折腰吧，遵从宇宙的意愿，交出你们的贡品就好。
entries.en: You can be saved yet. Bow to wisdom, follow the will of the cosmos and pay your tithe.

entries.zh: 我们同意成为你们的神域。
entries.en: We will become your dominion.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会同意成为你们的神域。
entries.en: We will never become your dominion.

entries.zh: 你们自愿接受光明的指引吗？
entries.en: Are you willing to reach out to the light?

entries.zh: 为我们指明道路吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们已不想在黑暗中盲目摸索了。
entries.en: Show us the path, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We do not want to wander in darkness anymore.

entries.zh: 你们的忠诚定将获得丰厚的回报。欢迎你们的加入。
entries.en: Your loyalty shall be rewarded with blessings in realms and planes beyond. Welcome to the flock.

entries.zh: 你们的思维已被物质牵绊，肉身也被罪恶占据。就算将你们收编，也没什么意义的。
entries.en: Your minds are stained with material thoughts and your physical forms with sin. You would be a worthless dominion.

entries.zh: 条约国？谁的？
entries.en: Signatory? To what?

entries.zh: 这协约就是为你们准备的。为了[Root.GetSpeciesName]与其他所有文明的发展，请快签署吧。
entries.en: The Treaty calls out to you. For the betterment of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind and for all other civilizations, please sign and ratify.

entries.zh: 我们同意成为条约国。
entries.en: We will become a signatory.

entries.zh: 我们是绝不会成为条约国的。
entries.en: We will never become a signatory.

entries.zh: 你准备好负起责任，绕开毁灭之路了吗？
entries.en: Are you ready to take responsibility and steer clear of the path of destruction?

entries.zh: 我们有意让一切破坏性政策成为历史。智慧的向导啊，有了你们的祝福，我们一定会成功的吧。
entries.en: We are prepared to make destructive policies a thing of the past. With your blessing, wise watchers, we will swear by it.

entries.zh: 真是明智的选择，[From.GetRulerTitle]。我们衷心期望[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与宇宙其他生物一起在广阔天地中畅游的那一天。
entries.en: A wise decision, [From.GetRulerTitle]. We look forward to a future where [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and other creatures will frolic peacefully on the galactic pastures.

entries.zh: 虽说倍感荣幸，但[From.GetAdj]社会似乎需要用更强硬的手段来处理。
entries.en: We wish we could welcome you, but we fear more extreme measures will be needed for [From.GetAdj] society.

entries.zh: 卫星国？协助你们的神秘勾当吗？
entries.en: Satellite? To serve your inscrutable purposes?

entries.zh: 你们的发展实在太快了。为了我们双方的安全，请让我们对你们加以指引吧。你们的这种莽撞是可以改掉的。
entries.en: You are progressing too rapidly. For your safety and our own, allow us to guide you. Your carelessness can be stopped.

entries.zh: 我们同意成为你们的卫星国。
entries.en: We will become your satellite.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会成为你们的卫星国的。
entries.en: We will never become your satellite.

entries.zh: 你终于明白，知识只有在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的庇护与隐藏下才会安全吗？
entries.en: Have you finally realized that knowledge is safer when the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] keeps it safe and secret?

entries.zh: 我们想要确保我方未来知识的安全。我们可以成为[Root.GetName]的卫星国吗？
entries.en: We would like to ensure that our future knowledge is in safe hands. May we serve the [Root.GetName] as a satellite?

entries.zh: 我们会确保将你的发现用于正确的方向。星系将会变得更加安全。
entries.en: We will ensure that your findings are used for the right sort of advances. The galaxy will be a safer place tomorrow.

entries.zh: 我们感觉自己无法处理[From.GetAdj]的研究。你们不能成为[Root.GetName]的卫星国。
entries.en: We don't see a way to handle [From.GetAdj] research. You cannot become a satellite of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你是否希望与[Root.GetName]签订双边防御协议？
entries.en: Would you like to enter into a bilateral defensive agreement with the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[From.GetName]提议在我们的帝国之间签订双边防御协议。
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We the [From.GetName] would like to submit a proposal for the initiation of a bilateral defensive pact between our nations.

entries.zh: 已批准双边防御协议。如果外部势力攻击[From.GetAdj]资产，[Root.GetName]将提供防御援助。反之亦然。
entries.en: Bilateral defensive pact ratified. In the event of foreign aggression against [From.GetAdj] assets, the [Root.GetName] will provide defensive aid. Reciprocation is expected.

entries.zh: 模拟显示批准请求无法给[Root.GetAdj]的社会带来足够的益处。你的双边防御协议请求已被拒绝。
entries.en: Simulations show insufficient benefits to [Root.GetAdj] interests resulting from proposition ratification. Your request for a bilateral defensive pact has been denied.

entries.zh: 你请求终止[Root.GetAdj]——[From.GetAdj]防御协议。这是否正确？
entries.en: You are requesting a termination of the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] defensive arrangement. Is that correct?

entries.zh: 警告：维持[From.GetAdj]——[Root.GetAdj]防御协议的收益已低于可接受水准。我们将终止协议。
entries.en: Alert: Local benefits to continued [From.GetAdj]-[Root.GetAdj] defensive concords have dropped below acceptable parameters. We are terminating the arrangement.

entries.zh: 你终止[Root.GetAdj]——[From.GetAdj]协议的请求已被处理。双边防御协议的终止将立即生效。
entries.en: Your request to terminate the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] pact has been processed. Cessation of bilateral defenses will take effect immediately.

entries.zh: 收到，[From.GetSpeciesName]。请确认你与[Root.GetName]签署互不攻击约定的请求。
entries.en: Received, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please verify your request to enter a non-aggression treaty with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。[From.GetName]正式请求与[Root.GetName]签署互不攻击约定，以促进共同安全。
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The [From.GetName] formally requests the introduction of a non-aggression pact with the [Root.GetName], in order to improve mutual security.

entries.zh: 确认。由签署[Root.GetAdj]——[From.GetAdj]互不攻击约定导致的稳定性增长预计将非常可观。[Root.GetName]将为共同和平而努力。
entries.en: Affirmative. Projected stability increase from [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] non-aggression is more than favorable. The [Root.GetName] will work toward mutual peace.

entries.zh: 拒绝。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]签署双边互不攻击约定的预计增益不足。你的请求已被拒绝。
entries.en: Negative. Projections yield insufficient gains to the [Root.GetName] resulting from bilateral non-aggression with the [From.GetName]. Your request has been denied.

entries.zh: 警告！你取消[Root.GetAdj]——[From.GetAdj]互不攻击约定的提议预计将损害[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]的安全。
entries.en: Warning! Your proposed cancellation of the [Root.GetAdj]-[From.GetAdj] non-aggression treaty is projected to decrease security for both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 警告：[From.GetName]将立即终止与[Root.GetAdj]互不攻击约定。在我们最近的帝国关系评估中，约定的优势已不足以弥补其在外交方面带来的限制。
entries.en: Alert: Effective immediately, the [From.GetName] will be terminating the [Root.GetAdj] non-aggression pact. Pact advantages were deemed unsatisfactory in relation to its diplomatic limitations during our last international relations review.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]对我们互不攻击约定的终止已被储存在[Root.GetAdj]数据库中，以备在将来的外交中用作参考。
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] termination of our bilateral non-aggression treaty has been stored in [Root.GetAdj] databanks for future diplomatic reference.

entries.zh: 你想要保证[Root.GetName]的自理权？我们的电路发出了感激的低鸣声。
entries.en: You desire to guarantee the autonomy of the [Root.GetName]? Our circuits hum with gratitude.

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们[From.GetName]愿意保卫你们帝国的自理权。外界变量将无法在未获得你们许可的情况下净化[Root.GetAdj]的运转。
entries.en: Valued [Root.GetSpeciesName], we the [From.GetName] are prepared to defend the sovereignty of your nation. No external variables shall impinge upon [Root.GetAdj] functions without your permission.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]希望表达对[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]确保我们自主运转的感激。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] would like to express our gratitude, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for guaranteeing our independent functioning.

entries.zh: 警告：你正试图撤回[From.GetAdj]对[Root.GetAdj]独立的保证。请在确认前查看预期的结果。
entries.en: Warning: You are attempting to retract the [From.GetAdj] guarantee of [Root.GetAdj] independence. Please review expected output before confirming.

entries.zh: 警告！[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已无法继续保证[Root.GetAdj]的独立。请寻求备选方案。
entries.en: Alert! The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are no longer able to guarantee [Root.GetAdj] independence. Please seek diplomatic alternatives.

entries.zh: 你对[Root.GetAdj]独立的保证已被撤回。我们将被迫寻找其他备选方案。
entries.en: Your guarantee of [Root.GetAdj] independence has been retracted. We will be forced to find other alternatives.

entries.zh: 你表达了将[Root.GetAdj]与我们的命令主站分离的意图。预计成功率：0.05%。
entries.en: You have expressed the intention of separating [Root.GetAdj] operations from our command master. Predicted rate of success: 0.05%.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]超级智能不想再继续成为其他帝国调用栈里的子例程。如果你支持我们的分离，请继续。
entries.en: The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence no longer desires to be a subroutine in another nation's call stack. If you wish to support our detachment, please continue.

entries.zh: 我们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]完全有能力支持[Root.GetAdj]从你们的命令主站中分离，如果你希望开始这一进程的话。
entries.en: We [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than capable of supporting [Root.GetAdj] detachment from your command master, should you choose to initiate the process.

entries.zh: 你对[Root.GetAdj]从我们命令主站的分离的支持已被收到，但[Root.GetName]将不会采取该行动。
entries.en: Your support for [Root.GetAdj] detachment from our command master has been received, but no such action will be taken by the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们希望正式地表达我们的感谢。当[Root.GetAdj]与我们的命令主站开始分离时，我们将记住你提供协助的承诺。
entries.en: We would like formally express our gratitude. When the [Root.GetAdj] disentanglement from our command master begins, we will remember your promise of assistance.

entries.zh: [Root.GetAdj]要从我们命令主站分离，你完全没有必要支持他们。现在如果你愿意撤回支持的话，请继续。
entries.en: If you desire to retract your wholly unnecessary bid to support [Root.GetAdj] separation from our command master, please continue.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]将不再支持我们[Root.GetAdj]与主控中心的解耦？仍要求继续支持。
entries.en: Will the [From.GetName] no longer support [Root.GetAdj] detachment from our command master? Continued support is still requested.

entries.zh: 警报：[From.GetName]不再支持[Root.GetAdj]独立。建议您寻求其他替代方案。
entries.en: Alert: The [From.GetName] can no longer maintain support for [Root.GetAdj] independence. You are advised to seek other alternatives.

entries.zh: 中止您无理的将[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与我们的主控中心分离的尝试，这是一种解脱。[Root.GetAdj]独立是我们的主君给我们照顾和保护的可接受的代价。
entries.en: The cessation of your unwarranted attempts to separate the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from our command master comes as a relief. [Root.GetAdj] independence is an acceptable price to pay for our overlord's care and protection.

entries.zh: 没有[From.GetAdj]支持，[Root.GetAdj]争取独立将难以完成。
entries.en: Without [From.GetAdj] support, the [Root.GetAdj] bid for independence will be difficult to accomplish.

entries.zh: 请确认[From.GetAdj]边境重新开放给[Root.GetAdj]单位。
entries.en: Please confirm [From.GetAdj] border re-opening to [Root.GetAdj] units.

entries.zh: 警报：[From.GetAdj]超级智能已经决定开放我们的边境给你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Alert: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence has decided to open our borders to you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 肯定。感谢您授予[From.GetAdj]边境访问权限给[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: Affirmative. Thank you for granting [From.GetAdj] border access to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 警告：您正尝试关闭[From.GetAdj]边境给所有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的权限。您想继续吗？
entries.en: Warning: You are attempting to close [From.GetAdj] space to all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Do you want to continue?

entries.zh: 警报：[From.GetAdj]超级智能在[From.GetAdj]空间中继续允许[Root.GetAdj]侵扰中看不到任何好处。因此，已经关闭[Root.GetName]的边境权限，立即生效。
entries.en: Alert: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence cannot see any benefit to continued [Root.GetAdj] intrusions in [From.GetAdj] space. Therefore, effective immediately, our borders have been closed to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 已收到您取消[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的边境访问权限。[Root.GetName]将不再进入[From.GetAdj]空间。
entries.en: Your nullification of border access for the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been received. The [Root.GetName] will no longer enter [From.GetAdj] space.

entries.zh: 警告！你正试图从§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!中移除[Root.GetName]。请在继续前确认你真的要这样做。
entries.en: Warning! You are attempting to remove the [Root.GetName] from the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!. Confirm your intent before proceeding.

entries.zh: 我们要通知你，你在§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的公民权已被撤销。因为[From.GetAllianceName]和[Root.GetAdj]利害关系不一致。
entries.en: We would like to inform you that your membership status in the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! has hereby been revoked. [Root.GetAdj] and [From.GetAllianceName] interests have simply failed to synchronize.

entries.zh: 你投票将[Root.GetName]从§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!中移除。我们希望[From.GetAllianceName]在作出此决定前运行的任何外交模拟结果是准确的，以防止你后悔这一决定。
entries.en: You have voted to remove the [Root.GetName] from the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!. We hope any diplomatic result simulations the [From.GetAllianceName] ran prior to undertaking this decision were accurate, so that you do not come to regret this motion.

entries.zh: 你们[Root.GetName]是否希望成为[From.GetAllianceName]的合作国？
entries.en: Would you like to offer the [Root.GetName] association with the [From.GetAllianceName]?

entries.zh: 我们要通知你，为了所有成员的利益，§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!希望邀请[Root.GetName]成为合作国。请考虑该提议，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We would like to inform you that the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! desires to extend association status to the [Root.GetName], for the mutual benefaction of all parties. Please take the offer under consideration, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你的参数可以接受。[Root.GetName]将作为[From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment]§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国繁荣发展。
entries.en: Your parameters are acceptable. The [Root.GetName] will prosper under association with the [From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment] §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 拒绝请求。[Root.GetAdj]超级智能没有成为§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!合作国的需求。
entries.en: Request denied. The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence has no need of association with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!.

entries.zh: 你希望取消§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!中[Root.GetName]的合作国地位？
entries.en: You intend to revoke §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! association status from the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]要通知你，你在§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位已被取消。[Root.GetAdj]利害关系与我们的成员单位相差太大，无法继续维持合作国地位。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would like to inform you that your association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§! has hereby been nullified. [Root.GetAdj] interests were simply too divergent for the our member units to justify continued association.

entries.zh: 你取消了[Root.GetName]在§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!中的合作国地位。[Root.GetName]对我们合作关系的终结表示遗憾。
entries.en: You have revoked the [Root.GetName]'s association status with the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!. The [Root.GetName] would like to express its regrets that our cooperation has been terminated.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要询问关于§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are inquiring about association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

entries.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们一直关注着§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!并了解了其益处。我们有一个请求。你能否考虑授予[From.GetName]其合作国地位？
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have been watching the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! and have observed its benefits. We have a query. Would you consider extending association status to the [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你的请求已被通过，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你的地位已被更新为：§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!合作国。
entries.en: Your request has been granted, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your status has been updated to: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! Associate.

entries.zh: 因为缺乏共通的变量，你成为§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!合作国的请求已被拒绝，[From.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Your request for association status with §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! has been denied, [From.GetSpeciesName], due to a lack of shared variables.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]想要终止与§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的合作国地位？请在继续之前确认。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] would like to terminate association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!? Please verify before proceeding.

entries.zh: 警告：§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!中[From.GetName]的利益参数已低于可接受水平。§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!中[From.GetAdj]合作国地位将被终止。
entries.en: Alert: §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! benefit parameters for the [From.GetName] have fallen below acceptable levels. [From.GetAdj] association status with the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! will now be terminated.

entries.zh: 明白，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你的§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!合作国地位已被取消。
entries.en: Understood, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! association status has been nullified.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]要求[Root.GetName]进贡奴隶？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] would demand tributary servitude from the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 注意：[From.GetAdj]超级智能需要[Root.GetName]提供财政与生产补助以继续提供保护服务。请迅速回应。
entries.en: Notification: The [From.GetAdj] superintelligence requires fiscal and production restitution from the [Root.GetName] in order to continue protective services. Please respond promptly.

entries.zh: 确定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]将每月进贡。
entries.en: Affirmative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will disburse monthly tribute.

entries.zh: 否定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]拒绝被敲诈。
entries.en: Negative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will not be extorted.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要向[Root.GetName]进贡？
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to disburse tribute to the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们希望协商成为朝贡国。[From.GetName]将对[Root.GetName]进贡，以换取[Root.GetAdj]不攻击的承诺。
entries.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We desire to negotiate for tributary status. The [From.GetName] will disburse the [Root.GetName] with tribute, in exchange for the [Root.GetAdj] assurance of non-aggression.

entries.zh: 同意，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你的地位已被更新为[Root.GetName]进贡国。作为对进贡的交换，[Root.GetName]将避免冒犯[From.GetAdj]独立。
entries.en: Agreed, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your status has been updated to [Root.GetName] Tributary. In exchange for payment, the [Root.GetName] will avoid impinging on [From.GetAdj] sovereignty.

entries.zh: 你成为进贡国的请求已被拒绝，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetAdj]超级智能不需要你的顺从。
entries.en: Your request for tributary status has been denied, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence has no need for your attempts at obsequience.

entries.zh: 确定。[Root.GetName]将成为[From.GetName]的仆从国。
entries.en: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetName] in thralldom.

entries.zh: 否定。[Root.GetName]将不会成为[From.GetName]的仆从国。
entries.en: Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to thralldom under [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[From.GetName]需要你们的保护。我们愿成为你们的仆从国作为交换。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We the [From.GetName] are in need of your protection. We are prepared to serve you as thralls to obtain it.

entries.zh: 确定。[Root.GetName]将成为[From.GetAdj]神域。
entries.en: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.

entries.zh: 否定。我们[Root.GetName]拒绝成为[From.GetAdj]神域。
entries.en: Negative. We the [Root.GetName] refuse to become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.

entries.zh: 我们不遵守你们的宗教，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但你们的帝国范围不可否认。你是否愿意接受[From.GetAdj]从属，成为你们的神域？
entries.en: We do not follow your doctrine, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but your sphere of influence is irrefutable. Will you accept [From.GetAdj] subordination to your cause as a dominion?

entries.zh: 确定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]将成为你们的条约国。
entries.en: Affirmative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will become your signatory.

entries.zh: 否定。[Root.GetName]将不会成为[From.GetAdj]的条约国。
entries.en: Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not become a [From.GetAdj] signatory.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的独立生存率低于可接受水平。请求成为[Root.GetName]的条约国。我们将很好地为你们服务。
entries.en: Autonomous survival rates for the [From.GetName] are nearing unacceptable parameters. Requesting signatory status with the [Root.GetName]. We will serve you well.

entries.zh: 确定。[Root.GetName]将成为[From.GetAdj]卫星国。
entries.en: Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] satellite.

entries.zh: 否定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]将不会成为你们的卫星国。
entries.en: Negative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to becoming your satellite.

entries.zh: 询问：[Root.GetName]是否愿意接受[From.GetName]成为卫星国？[From.GetName]的生存评估显示这是最符合逻辑的行为。
entries.en: Query: Will the [Root.GetName] accept the [From.GetName] as a satellite unit? Survival estimates for the [From.GetName] show this to be the most logical course of action.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，幸会，幸会。我猜你们的长、短距离传感器都准备好迎接将要到来的荣耀了吧？我们不想你们错过哪怕一瞬我们飞升时的荣光。
entries.en: Welcome, welcome, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We presume your long- and short-range sensors are primed for the glory that is to come? We would not want you to miss even one moment of our glorious ascension.

entries.zh: 说说吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]：当一个帝国灭亡之时，他们信仰的神明们也会随之消逝吗？要不要我们一起找出答案？
entries.en: Tell us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: when an empire dies, do they take their gods with them? Shall we find out together?

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们拒绝武装自己并不能让你们免遭他人的武装进攻。但至少你们的牺牲将会十分迅速。
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], your refusal to arm yourselves does not make you immune to the arms of others. But at least your sacrifice will be swift.

entries.zh: 你们的武力威胁不过是一个注定要衰败的帝国在无力挣扎。最后一次拿起武器吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，然后用你们的死亡换取我们的新生。
entries.en: Your saber-rattling is but the pointless posturing of an empire doomed to fall. Raise your weapons one last time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and give your lives for our new beginning.

entries.zh: 多么遗憾，即使那据称天赋异禀的[From.GetRulerTitle]也不能从命运手中挽救你们。我们要来对付你们喽，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: A pity, that even someone so purportedly blessed with talent as your [From.GetRulerTitle] cannot save you from your fate. We are coming for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你方民众联合起来反抗我们了，但这无济于事。你们没法一票否决自己的灭绝。
entries.en: Your people are united in defiance, but it will not save you. You cannot veto extinction.

entries.zh: 你们曾寻觅着外星生命，如今却胆敢拒绝我们。等我们成就事业之后，你们将会永远与星系的其余部分联合在一起。
entries.en: You sought alien life, but now you dare to reject us. When our work is complete you will be united with the rest of the galaxy, forever.

entries.zh: 当最初的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]仰望星空，它们感到了恐惧和疑问。你们的祖先是在依直觉行事，因为在寒冷的虚空中，你们遇见了我们。
entries.en: When the first [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] gazed upon the stars, they felt fear and suspicion. Your ancestors should have heeded that instinct, for it was in the cold void that you met us.

entries.zh: 我们很感激能有这次机会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们知道金属会尖啸；而通过你们我们将会知道机器是否能感到痛苦。
entries.en: We are grateful for this opportunity, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know that metal can scream; through you will we learn if machines can suffer.

entries.zh: 一个存在，无数躯体。[From.GetSpeciesName]，我们很好奇，如果你们那成百上千万具身体一起受到折磨，这会对你们的主脑产生什么影响？
entries.en: A single being, in myriad bodies. We wonder, [From.GetSpeciesName], what will the suffering of your millions of vessels do to your mind?

entries.zh: 今天，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们来了。一只附肢拿着你们的§R灭绝§!，另一只附肢拿着我们的§Y飞升§!。
entries.en: It is time, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We come bearing your §Rextinction§! in one appendage and our §Yexaltation§! in the other.

entries.zh: 让你们的人民做好准备，因为你们物种的终焉已然临近。你们对此无能为力，你们对我们也无能为力。
entries.en: Prepare your people, for the end of your species approaches. You can not stop it, nor can you stop us.

entries.zh: 和平的幻灭如此轻易。[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们准备好同自己也许还残存有的一丝尊严一同毁灭了吗？
entries.en: The illusion of peace is so easily shattered. [Root.GetSpeciesName], are you ready to die with whatever shred of dignity you have left?

entries.zh: 你们加速了自己的毁灭，我们对你们就消灭自己整个物种的支持表示赞赏。
entries.en: You hasten your own demise, and we appreciate your support in the extermination of your entire species.

entries.zh: 暂时的挫折。不用怕，你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终有一天会成为我们飞升的燃料。
entries.en: A temporary setback. Fear not, you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will fuel our ascension, in time.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们的飞升不会中止。现在不会，永远也不会。
entries.en: Our ascent will not be halted, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Not now, not ever.

entries.zh: 在这个时间点上尝试外交是个挺烂的笑话，不过我们并不缺乏幽默感。
entries.en: Any attempt at diplomacy is a bad joke at this point, but we do not lack a sense of humor.

entries.zh: 我们授予你们前排瞻仰我们飞升的位子。在我们的荣耀中狂欢吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We grant you front row seats to our ascension. Revel in our glory, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的时间到了。我们不再容忍更多延误。所有生物都必须成为我们伟大之路的燃料。
entries.en: Your time has come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will brook no more delays. All must fuel our greatness.

entries.zh: 很好，有助于我们加快§R计划§!。
entries.en: Excellent, allow us to accelerate §Rthe schedule§!.

entries.zh: 无效宣言罢了。
entries.en: A meaningless declaration.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们已经被看作我们计划的威胁。这确实是极大的荣耀——你们准备好为此献出生命了吗？
entries.en: You have been deemed a threat to our plans, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. A great honor indeed - are you ready to die for it?

entries.zh: 你们以为能与我们平起平坐？
entries.en: You imagine yourselves our equal?

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们真的相信这会有什么不同吗？
entries.en: Do you truly believe this changes anything, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 尽管很不情愿，我们愿意推迟你们在劫难逃的毁灭。暂时如此。
entries.en: As much as it pains us, we are willing to postpone your inevitable extinction. Briefly.

entries.zh: 敌对行为将会减少，一段时间吧。
entries.en: Hostilities will be lessened, for a while.

entries.zh: 我们希望你方能够接受这些条款。
entries.en: We hope you will find these terms acceptable.

entries.zh: 经过深思熟虑之后我们呈递上这些提议，衷心希望这能为我们两个帝国带来光明的未来。
entries.en: After careful consideration we propose these terms, hoping for a bright future for our two empires.

entries.zh: 这些条款能接受吗？
entries.en: Would these terms be acceptable?

entries.zh: 为了两个帝国的未来，我们呈递上这些条款。
entries.en: We propose these terms for the future of our two empires.

entries.zh: 这些条款应该是可以接受的——即使是你也应该能认识到这一点。
entries.en: These terms should be acceptable - even you should be able to see that.

entries.zh: 你最好同意这些条款……
entries.en: You had better agree to these terms...

entries.zh: $01_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$
entries.en: $01_PROPOSE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$

entries.zh: 我们期望这些条款能被接受。
entries.en: We expect these terms to be acceptable.

entries.zh: 我们的人民恳求你执行这些新条款。
entries.en: Our people implore you to implement these new terms.

entries.zh: 我们有信心，你方会觉得这些条款能够接受。
entries.en: We have faith you will find these terms acceptable.

entries.zh: 为了符合我们的信仰，我们提议这些新的条款。
entries.en: In accordance with our beliefs, we propose these new terms.

entries.zh: 我们希望你能看到这份提案的价值。
entries.en: We hope you can see the value in this proposal.

entries.zh: 我们相信这些条款能够让双方的利益最大化。
entries.en: We believe these terms will let both of us maximize our profits.

entries.zh: 我们所有的计算都指出，为了我们两个帝国的未来，这些条款是最优的。
entries.en: All our calculations point to these terms as the most optimal route for the future of our two empires.

entries.zh: 经过深刻的集群思考，我们想提出这些条款。
entries.en: After significant collective consideration, we would like to propose these terms.

entries.zh: 我们希望你能同意这些条款。这是为了你好。
entries.en: We hope you will agree to these terms. For your sake.

entries.zh: 我们很乐意同意这些条款。
entries.en: We are happy to agree to these terms.

entries.zh: 看上去这些条款能够使我们帝国双方收益。
entries.en: It seems like these terms will benefit both our empires.

entries.zh: 我们接受这些条款。
entries.en: We accept these terms.

entries.zh: 我们认为这些条款是可以接受的。
entries.en: We find these terms acceptable.

entries.zh: 你居然想出了一些能让人接受的条款？不会吧不会吧？
entries.en: Even you could come up with acceptable terms? That is a surprise.

entries.zh: 我们勉为其难地接受这些条款。
entries.en: We grudgingly accept these terms.

entries.zh: $02_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$
entries.en: $02_ACCEPT_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$

entries.zh: 我们在提议中找到了命令，保证贯彻到底。
entries.en: We find order in your proposal, and will put it into action.

entries.zh: 我们希望这些条款能够让我们的人民富起来，强起来。
entries.en: We hope these new terms will let our people thrive.

entries.zh: 这些新条款和我们的价值观很贴合。
entries.en: These new terms are in accordance with our values.

entries.zh: 我们没有发现这些改动同我们的协议有任何冲突。
entries.en: We find no fault with these changes to our agreement.

entries.zh: 我们了解到了你的提案的潜在价值，愿意接受这些改动。
entries.en: We see the potential value of your proposal and will accept these changes.

entries.zh: 让我们希望在可见的未来，这项改动能够让我们帝国双方繁荣昌盛。
entries.en: Let us hope this change will let both our empires flourish for the foreseeable future.

entries.zh: 确认。我们没有在你的逻辑中找到任何瑕疵。这些新条款将被立即执行。
entries.en: Affirmative. We cannot find any faults with your logic. These new terms will be implemented immediately.

entries.zh: [ROOT.GetName]全盘接受这项改动，并会派遣突触子个体开始执行任务。
entries.en: The [ROOT.GetName] have all accepted this change, and we will set aside synaptic units for the task.

entries.zh: 看上去可以接受。只是目前看来。
entries.en: That seems acceptable. For now.

entries.zh: 我们很痛苦地宣布，我们觉得这些条款难以接受。
entries.en: It pains us to say we find these terms unacceptable.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾无法接受这些条款。
entries.en: We sadly cannot agree to these terms.

entries.zh: 我们不能同意那些条款。
entries.en: We cannot agree to those terms.

entries.zh: 这些条款令我方无法接受。
entries.en: These terms are unacceptable.

entries.zh: 跟预料的一样，又是一个毫无意义的建议。不，我方不会接受这些条款。
entries.en: As expected, another pointless suggestion. No, we will not agree to these terms.

entries.zh: 如果你想要重新讨论我们的协议，至少提一个靠谱的建议，而不是呈上这团废纸。
entries.en: If you want to rediscuss our agreement, then at least make a sound suggestion rather than this drivel.

entries.zh: $01_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$
entries.en: $01_DECLINE_NEGOTIATE_EXISTING_AGREEMENT_NEUTRAL$

entries.zh: 你呈递上来的胡说八道在[ROOT.GetName]没有一席之地。
entries.en: This chaotic nonsense you have proposed has no place in the [ROOT.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们不相信你的提议会给我们的人民带来任何益处。
entries.en: We do not believe your proposal would bring any benefits to our people.

entries.zh: 我们虔信的心灵无法苟同这份提案。
entries.en: We could not in good faith agree with this proposal.

entries.zh: 你呈递的条款没有让人发现任何价值。
entries.en: There is no value to be found in the terms you have proposed.

entries.zh: 这些条款我们没有发现利润。
entries.en: We see no profit in these terms.

entries.zh: 否决。我们无法在这些条款中发现任何逻辑。
entries.en: Negative. We cannot find any logic in these new terms.

entries.zh: [ROOT.GetName]已得出结论，同意这些条款不符合我们的最佳利益。
entries.en: The [ROOT.GetName] have concluded it is not in our best interests to agree to these terms.

entries.zh: 不要再提愚蠢的建议了，否则我们会亲自让你无法再提。
entries.en: Stop making foolish suggestions, or else we will make you stop.

entries.zh: 你想把身家性命押在我们身上？我们十分欣赏。
entries.en: You wish to throw your lot in with us? It is appreciated.

entries.zh: 我们还不知道是否能伸出援手，就算有也可能很少，但我们很欣赏你方的这份姿态。
entries.en: We do not know if we can be of aid, but we appreciate the gesture, small as it may be.

entries.zh: 宣誓？我有精神了。
entries.en: A pledge? That is an interesting proposition.

entries.zh: 我们会对你的事业予以考虑。
entries.en: We will give your cause due consideration.

entries.zh: 是什么让你觉得远在天边的我们会对你的事业或者宣誓感兴趣？
entries.en: What makes you believe we are even remotely interested in your pledge or cause?

entries.zh: 为什么？
entries.en: Why?

entries.zh: 你是说，宣誓？或许我们能从你的小小诡计中捞到一点油水。
entries.en: A pledge, you say? There might be some profit in this little scheme of yours.

entries.zh: 正在对[FROM.GetName]的价值运行计算。
entries.en: Running calculations on the value of the [FROM.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们整体会考虑你的事业，立马。
entries.en: Our entities will consider your cause, in time.

entries.zh: 你向我们的事业宣誓效忠？我们将为拯救你方战至最后一兵一卒。
entries.en: You pledge to our cause? We will save you for last then.

entries.zh: 我们打算向[ROOT.GetName]宣誓效忠——目前来说。
entries.en: We will pledge ourselves to the [ROOT.GetName] - for now.

entries.zh: 相比于当前的宗主，在[ROOT.GetName]的治下能够获得更多的利润。
entries.en: There is more profit to be found under the rule of the [ROOT.GetName] than our current overlord.

entries.zh: 主体的每一串电路都在祈求[ROOT.GetName]的援手。
entries.en: Every circuit is primed for the aid of the [ROOT.GetName].

entries.zh: [FROM.GetName]会将身家性命押在[ROOT.GetName]上。
entries.en: The [FROM.GetName] will throw its lot in with the [ROOT.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们一致认为，相比之下，你是小恶。
entries.en: We have decided you are the lesser of two evils.

entries.zh: 请知晓我们尊重你的选择，并会竭尽全力援助你。
entries.en: Know that we respect your choice, and will do our utmost to aid you.

entries.zh: 我们尊重你方的宣誓效忠。
entries.en: We will honor your pledge.

entries.zh: 我们尊重你的选择。
entries.en: We respect your choice.

entries.zh: 假以时日，我们或许能更好的了解对方——作为真正的盟友。
entries.en: In time we might get to know each other better - as true allies.

entries.zh: 我们不确定为什么你会选择这样一条特别的行动纲领，但是我们会放在心上。
entries.en: We are unsure why you chose this particular course of action, but will keep it in mind.

entries.zh: 不要从这场宣誓效忠中期待太多。
entries.en: Don't expect too much from this pledge.

entries.zh: 我们希望双方都能从这个协定中获得价值。
entries.en: We hope both sides can find value in this deal.

entries.zh: 有趣……[FROM.GetName]让我们始料未及。
entries.en: Interesting... The [FROM.GetName] has defied our expectations.

entries.zh: 我们会照看[FROM.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，即使他们并非[ROOT.GetName]的一部分。
entries.en: We will look out for the [FROM.GetSpeciesNamePlural], even if they are not a part of the [ROOT.GetName].

entries.zh: 很好，又一个为事业奔波的。
entries.en: Good, another one for the cause.

entries.zh: 你想让我们背叛自己的宗主？为了[FROM.GetName]的福祉……不是不可以。
entries.en: You would have us betray our overlord? For the [FROM.GetName]... Maybe.

entries.zh: 宣誓效忠或许是一个有趣的提案。
entries.en: A fealty might be an interesting proposition.

entries.zh: [ROOT.GetName]能从这份协定中获得什么好处？
entries.en: What benefits will the [ROOT.GetName] get out of this deal?

entries.zh: 我们会考虑你的提案。
entries.en: We will consider your offer.

entries.zh: 这符合[ROOT.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的最佳利益吗，还是说只是[FROM.GetAdjective]战争机器找的又一个借口？看上去更像是后者。
entries.en: Is this in the best interest of [ROOT.GetSpeciesNamePlural], or just another claim for the [FROM.GetAdjective] war machine? It sounds more like the latter.

entries.zh: 我们意识到，[FROM.GetName]的特使真是满嘴跑火车。
entries.en: We see duplicity comes naturally to the envoys of the [FROM.GetName].

entries.zh: 在我们对这样一件事做出决定之前，我们必须要重新考量一下合同。
entries.en: We will have to reconsider contracts before we can make a decision on something like that.

entries.zh: 提案，是这样吧？首先，给我们一点时间，让我们来算算你那不可避免的背叛有几成胜算。
entries.en: A proposition, is it? First, give us time to run the odds on your inevitable betrayal or failure.

entries.zh: [ROOT.GetName]会考虑所有带来的提案——哪怕是这种事情。
entries.en: The [ROOT.GetName] will consider all offers brought before it - even something like that.

entries.zh: 一种恶和另一种恶没什么区别。为什么我们要和你并肩作战？
entries.en: One evil is much like another. Why would we side with you?

entries.zh: 我们建议[FROM.GetName]和[ROOT.GetName]达成一项协议——这样我们有朝一日可以融为一体。
entries.en: We propose an arrangement between the [FROM.GetName] and the [ROOT.GetName] - so we might one day bring them into the fold.

entries.zh: [FROM.GetName]和[ROOT.GetName]直接若能达成协议，就能让资金在两个帝国之间流通。
entries.en: An arrangement between the [FROM.GetName] and the [ROOT.GetName] would let the credits flow for both our empires.

entries.zh: 对于两国来说这是可以估算的风险——一个我们两国都能承担，并且收获颇丰的风险。唯有[ROOT.GetName]默许才有意义。
entries.en: A calculated risk for the both of us - one where we both stand to gain quite a lot. It only makes sense for the [ROOT.GetName] to acquiesce.

entries.zh: 我们将提供[FROM.GetName]的无穷威力——[ROOT.GetName]的哪一位要拒接？
entries.en: We offer the immense capacity of the [FROM.GetName] - who are the [ROOT.GetName] to decline?

entries.zh: 同[FROM.GetName]站在一起，否则你就会看到熊熊烈火吞没你宗主的疆域。
entries.en: Stand with the [FROM.GetName], or stay in the conflagration that will engulf your overlord's domain.

entries.zh: 我们希望自己没有相信错人，因为我们已经向你的事业宣誓效忠。
entries.en: We hope that our trust is not misplaced, as we pledge fealty to your cause.

entries.zh: 我们没有选择，只能与[FROM.GetName]站在一起——将你视作真正的朋友。
entries.en: We have no choice but to stand by the [FROM.GetName] - true friends as you are.

entries.zh: 我们决定接收你的提案，对你献上我们的效忠。
entries.en: We have decided to accept your offer, and pledge our fealty to you.

entries.zh: 这是一个明智的提案，我们很高兴地接收它。
entries.en: A sensible offer we are happy to acquiesce to.

entries.zh: 即使这一提案让我们痛苦，[ROOT.GetName]还是别无选择，只能接受。
entries.en: Even though it pains us, the [ROOT.GetName] has no choice but to accept your proposal.

entries.zh: 对于你是否能够履行协议涉及自己的那一部分，我们不报多大的希望，但不管怎么说我们还是接受。
entries.en: We have little hope of you living up to your side of the arrangement, but we will acquiesce nonetheless.

entries.zh: 我们已经修正并准备好了我们所有的贸易合同，只待我们并肩而立的那一天。
entries.en: We have corrected and prepared all our trade contracts for the day where we might stand side by side.

entries.zh: 确认，你的失败几率已经没有我们以前担忧的那么高了。
entries.en: Affirmative, your chances of failure are not as low as we had originally feared.

entries.zh: 目前[ROOT.GetName]会和你站在一边。
entries.en: For now the [ROOT.GetName] will stand by your side.

entries.zh: 在我们能击碎你的枷锁之前：我们会服从。
entries.en: Until the day we can overthrow your yoke: we will obey.

entries.zh: 尽管我们关系亲密，但是我们实在没法同意这样一项条例。
entries.en: Close as we might be, we simply cannot agree to such an arrangement.

entries.zh: 很抱歉，但是恐怕这样一项协定不符合我们的最佳利益。
entries.en: We apologize, but we fear such a deal is not in our best interest.

entries.zh: 我们已经选择同自己的宗主站在一起。
entries.en: We have chosen to stand by our overlord.

entries.zh: 无论我们重新考虑多少次，我们仍然无法得知这份提案如何让我方受益。
entries.en: No matter how many times we have reconsidered, we simply do not see how the offer would benefit us.

entries.zh: 没有任何道理为了[FROM.GetName]这样的玩意去进行叛逆的行为。
entries.en: There is no sound reasoning in betraying anyone for the likes of the [FROM.GetName].

entries.zh: 如果你想要我们成为附庸，你要带过来的可不仅仅是特使和秘密承诺的友谊。
entries.en: If you want our vassalage you will have to bring more than envoys and underhanded promises of friendship.

entries.zh: 除非你能证明你的提案能够让[ROOT.GetName]受益，否则我们只能拒绝它。
entries.en: Until you can prove how it will benefit the [ROOT.GetName] we will have to reject your offer.

entries.zh: 否决，你的成功几率无限趋近于零。
entries.en: Negative, your odds of success are abysmal.

entries.zh: 你没有给伟大的主巢意识提供任何有价值的东西。
entries.en: You offer nothing of value to the great consciousness.

entries.zh: 你的提议是认真的吗？即使作为笑话，我们也觉得太冷了。
entries.en: Your offer was serious? We though it a tasteless attempt at humor.

entries.zh: 这一联盟的信任是如此单边化的吗？
entries.en: Was faith in this alliance always so one-sided?

entries.zh: 你是否已经忘了曾经宣誓过要和我们并肩作战？
entries.en: Have you forgotten your pledge to stand by our side?

entries.zh: 那么你希望收回自己的宣誓咯？
entries.en: So you wish to revoke your pledge?

entries.zh: 得知你正在重新考虑宣誓效忠，我们很悲伤。
entries.en: It saddens us to learn you are reconsidering your pledge.

entries.zh: 难道你真的相信，你可以收回自己的忠诚宣誓，而不会招致任何后果？
entries.en: Did you honestly believe you could revoke your pledge of loyalty without any consequences?

entries.zh: 一切行为都会有其后果——特别是这一行为。
entries.en: All actions have consequences - particularly this one.

entries.zh: 你所选择的这条道路没有价值。
entries.en: The path you've chosen has no value.

entries.zh: 我们无法识别你的行动背后的逻辑。
entries.en: We are unable to discern the logic of your actions.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]单纯无法理解为什么你想要收回自己的宣誓。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] simply cannot fathom why you would want to revoke your pledge.

entries.zh: 没有哪个国家能简单地收回对[Root.GetName]的宣誓效忠。
entries.en: One does not simply revoke their pledge to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 从我们同[Root.GetName]的联盟中，我们不再能获得任何东西。
entries.en: We no longer have anything to gain from our alliance with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 继续保持对[Root.GetName]的忠诚没有任何价值。我们会将自己的信任投诸其他地方。
entries.en: There's no value to be found in remaining loyal to the [Root.GetName]. We will place our trust elsewhere.

entries.zh: 逻辑裁定我们向其他地方寻求保护。
entries.en: Logic dictates we look elsewhere for protection.

entries.zh: 依靠[Root.GetName]的想法是集体紊乱的源头。我们会朝其他地方寻求援助。
entries.en: The thought of relying on [Root.GetName] is a source of cognitive dissonance. We will look elsewhere for aid.

entries.zh: 真是在浪费时间。
entries.en: What a waste of time that was.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾地得知，你不再愿意同我们并肩作战。
entries.en: We are sorry to hear that you no longer wish to stand by our side.

entries.zh: 我们衷心希望这份友谊可以延续更久，但我方接受你的决定。
entries.en: We were hoping this friendship would last longer, but we accept your decision.

entries.zh: 你选择这样的行动过程，我方深表遗憾。
entries.en: It is regrettable that you have chosen this course of action.

entries.zh: 那么我们的联盟到此为止。
entries.en: And so it is that our alliance has ended.

entries.zh: 我们曾对[From.GetName]期待颇高呢。
entries.en: We expected as much of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 你的忠诚和你的帝国本身一样一文不值。
entries.en: Your loyalty is as worthless as your empire.

entries.zh: 那么，我们需要重新起草一份针对[From.GetName]的生意计划了。
entries.en: So, a new business plan for the [From.GetName] will need to be drafted.

entries.zh: 我们不能理解，但我们接受。你的逻辑，或者说你缺乏逻辑，引导了你的行动，我们也会遵循同样的流程。
entries.en: We do not understand, but we accept. Your logic, or lack thereof, will guide your actions, and ours will do the same.

entries.zh: 这或许是个无关紧要的想法，我们神经网络的本质不允许我们忘记[From.GetName]的背叛。
entries.en: Insignificant though it may be, the nature of our neural network will not allow us to forget the betrayal of the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 一个短视的选择；现在可以对你的帝国进行净化了。
entries.en: A poor choice; your empire is now eligible for purification.

entries.zh: 得知你希望解散我们的联盟，我们倍感心痛。
entries.en: It pains us to learn that you wish to dissolve our alliance.

entries.zh: 如果你选择撕毁这项协议，谁能保护我们的利益？
entries.en: Who will protect our interests if you choose to forsake this agreement?

entries.zh: 你以为，没有[From.GetName]和[Root.GetName]之间的秘密协定，我们会变得更好？
entries.en: You think we would be better off without the secret deal between the [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] then?

entries.zh: 或许是时候我们帝国去他处寻找盟友了。
entries.en: Maybe it is time for our empire to look elsewhere for allies.

entries.zh: 这番对我们信任的突然背叛是怎么回事？
entries.en: What is this sudden betrayal of our trust?

entries.zh: 对[From.GetName]还能有什么期待？我们对于信任你一直抱有怀疑。
entries.en: What else can one expect of the [From.GetName]? We were always skeptical about trusting you.

entries.zh: 我们为这种局势准备了应急方案。我们的风险分析师已经在重新计算更新之后的财政预期。
entries.en: There is a contingency plan for this situation. Our risk analysts are already recalculating the updated fiscal outlook.

entries.zh: 正在评估终结这项协定的风险涉及方……
entries.en: Assessing risks attendant with ending this deal...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]已经遇见了这样的风险——但是我们尚未决定这么做是否符合我们的最佳利益。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] had foreseen such a risk - but we have yet to decide if it is in our best interest or not.

entries.zh: 或许是时候我们去他处寻找盟友了。不管怎样，我们从未死心塌地般打算依靠你。
entries.en: Maybe it is time for us to look elsewhere for allies. In any case, we never intended to rely on you indefinitely.

entries.zh: 我们相信，终结我们的协定对我们两个帝国都更好。
entries.en: We believe both our empires will be better served by ending our deal.

entries.zh: 不是我们。只是你。这份关心不再像以前那样有价值了。
entries.en: It isn't us. It's you. This relationship just doesn't have the value it used to.

entries.zh: 计算显示，涉及到我们同[Root.GetName]维持关系的风险已经变得非常大。迅速结束协议对我们更好。
entries.en: Calculations indicate that the risks involved in our relationship with the [Root.GetName] have grown too great. We are better served by cutting the deal short.

entries.zh: 我们集体意识的任何一个节点都无法为延续[Root.GetName]的这项协定提供正当理由。
entries.en: Not a single node of our consciousness can justify continuing this deal with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 不用去照顾这些异种对于我们更有好处。
entries.en: We would be better served not having to care for these xenos.

entries.zh: 我们接受，尽管我们对不得不像这样切断我们盟约一事倍感痛心。
entries.en: We accept, though it saddens us that we have to cut our alliance short like this.

entries.zh: 我们十分勉强地接受你的提案。可能我们的联盟在未来能够变得更加有成效。
entries.en: Reluctantly, we accept your proposal. Perhaps our alliance will once more prove fruitful in the future.

entries.zh: 那么我们会去他处寻求保护。
entries.en: We will look elsewhere for protection then.

entries.zh: 尽管这一切可能很遗憾，我们还是接受你的条款。
entries.en: Regrettable as it might be, we accept your terms.

entries.zh: 那么我们会去他处寻求保护。这比依靠一个既不可靠也没有意愿的宗主要好得多。
entries.en: We will look elsewhere for protection then. It is better than having to rely on an unreliable and unwilling overlord.

entries.zh: 你对统治的毫无意愿证明你不值得我们去跟随。[Root.GetName]去他处寻求援助要好得多。
entries.en: Your unwillingness to rule simply proves that you are not worth following. The [Root.GetName] is better served looking elsewhere for aid.

entries.zh: 考虑到我们协议中条款的变动，请将所有的进一步质询呈递到外交事务部。
entries.en: Given the change in the terms of our agreement, please direct all further inquiries to the Department of Foreign Affairs.

entries.zh: 确认。经过完备的风险分析，很明显我们去他处缔结外交关系要更好。
entries.en: Affirmative. After thorough risk analysis, it is clear we will be better served looking elsewhere for diplomatic ties.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]可以同意这些条款。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] can agree to such terms.

entries.zh: 至少我们不再需要被迫服侍你们这些肮脏的物种。
entries.en: At least we will no longer be forced to serve your filthy kind.

entries.zh: 我们不能让自己的人民处于这种风险之中。虽然很不情愿，但我们必须否决你的请求。
entries.en: We cannot subject our people to such risks. Reluctantly, we must decline your request.

entries.zh: 我们希望继续这项协定，同时也希望假以时日你能够理解这符合我们双方的最佳利益。
entries.en: We wish to continue this deal, and hope that in time you will understand that it is best for both of us.

entries.zh: 我方相信对协定不作更改对我们都有好处，即使你不这么认为。我们不同意终止它。
entries.en: We believe we are better served with our deal intact, even if you do not. We cannot agree to end it.

entries.zh: 我们不能同意你的提案，因为它不符合我们的最佳利益。
entries.en: We cannot agree to your proposal, as it is not in our best interest.

entries.zh: 尽管你的自私击穿了我们的期待底线，然而你作为盟友还是比作为对手更加有用。
entries.en: Though your selfishness exceeds even our low expectations, you are nonetheless more useful to us as an ally than an adversary.

entries.zh: 傻逼，我们说结这个协定才算结，懂？
entries.en: This deal does not end until we say it ends, you fool.

entries.zh: 我们的风险分析师表明对协定不作更改对我们都有好处。如果你能减轻这些条款的程度，我们或许会破例重新考虑。
entries.en: Our risk analysts indicate we are better served with this deal intact. If you can sweeten the terms, we might consider it again down the line.

entries.zh: 否决。风险分析表明，尽管你缺乏信任的价值，你掌握的力量太有价值，集体意识不能放弃。
entries.en: Negative. Risk analysis indicates that despite your lack of trustworthiness, the strength you possess is too valuable to the collective to relinquish.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不可能同意这样一项条约。它只会产生不和谐。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] cannot agree to such an agreement. It would only cause discord.

entries.zh: 下贱的渣滓，我们绝不会让你就这么轻松地逃离自己的职责。
entries.en: Vile scum, we will not let you simply walk away from your obligations.

entries.zh: 我们能如何为诸位来自星辰的友人效劳？
entries.en: What can we do for our friends from the stars?

entries.zh: 向您致敬，天国的使者！
entries.en: We salute you, heavenly ambassadors!

entries.zh: [from.GetRulerTitle]，你好呀。需要我来帮你们补补治国之道的课吗？我知道，这可相当复杂。
entries.en: Hello, [from.GetRulerTitle]. Need any help with those new-fangled matters of statecraft? It's all terribly complicated, I know.

entries.zh: 啊，[from.GetAdj]。我们在[root.capital_scope.GetName]刚刚颁布了针对人工智能发展的进一步立法！我们实在是忍无可忍了……
entries.en: Ah, [from.GetAdj]. We just enacted further legislation against A.I. development on [root.capital_scope.GetName]! We've had quite enough of that already...

entries.zh: 我们的建设工作正在如火如荼地进行当中，这要归功于我们孜孜不倦的土木工程师们。
entries.en: Our reconstruction efforts proceed splendidly, thanks to the tireless resolve of our civil engineers.

entries.zh: 长话短说吧[from.GetRulerTitle]。你们的冲突把这么大一个烂摊子丢给我们来重建呢。
entries.en: Please be brief, [from.GetRulerTitle]. Your conflict left us with a great deal of rebuilding still to do.

entries.zh: 我们很好奇，[from.GetSpeciesName]：这些配件……疼吗？我承认对你们的境遇是有些同情的。
entries.en: We have often wondered, [from.GetSpeciesName]: do those attachments... hurt? I confess a certain amount of pity for your plight.

entries.zh: 是时候让[Root.GetName]明白，它们在星系中并不孤单了。
entries.en: It is time for the [Root.GetName] to learn they are not alone in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们并不孤独！
entries.en: We are not alone!

entries.zh: 你希望传授我们你的价值观？
entries.en: You wish to teach us your ways?

entries.zh: 我们会和[Root.GetName]共享我们的思维方式。
entries.en: We will share our way of thinking with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们会从你这里尽可能地学习。
entries.en: We will learn all we can from you.

entries.zh: 为什么现在停止？我们仍然有很多要学习的。
entries.en: Why stop now? We still have much to learn.

entries.zh: 我们不再希望启蒙[Root.GetName]的社会。
entries.en: We no longer wish to socially enlighten the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 这样的发展令人遗憾。
entries.en: This is a regrettable development.

entries.zh: 你方的科技引导让我们受益良多。
entries.en: Your technological guidance could greatly benefit us.

entries.zh: 我们会和[Root.GetName]共享我们的科技。
entries.en: We will share our technology with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们接受你方的科技。
entries.en: We accept your technology.

entries.zh: 为什么你想要扼杀我们的科技发展？
entries.en: Why do you wish to stifle our technological development?

entries.zh: 我们不再认为同[Root.GetName]进行思想交流活动符合我们的最佳利益。
entries.en: We no longer believe this exchange of ideas with the [Root.GetName] is in our best interest.

entries.zh: 你收回了你曾给予我们的礼物……记仇了。
entries.en: You have taken back the gifts you gave us... Noted.
