entries.zh: 你们像锚一样将自己固定在星球上，[From.Capital.GetName]的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这就是为什么你们的舰队永远无法真正翱翔。
entries.en: You fix yourselves to worlds like anchors, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of [From.Capital.GetName]. This is why your fleets will never truly soar.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是静态的。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]则不是。这一区别将会很重要。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are static. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not. This distinction will matter.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是扎根的。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]则不是。这一区别将至关重要。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are rooted. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not. This distinction will matter.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]紧抓着贬值资产不放。而我们眼中只有目标，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] clings to depreciating assets. We see only targets, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们将自己束缚在土地上，并称之为稳定，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName] 早已摈弃了这种幻象。
entries.en: You chain yourselves to soil and call it stability, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] has moved beyond such illusions.

entries.zh: 我们比那些比[From.GetName]还要稳定的帝国存在得更久。不要试探[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: We have outlived empires more stable than the [From.GetName]. Do not test the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们是群星间的舰队，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。说明你们的来意。
entries.en: We are the fleet between stars, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Speak your purpose.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的游牧模式已确立。允许与[From.GetName]进行通讯。
entries.en: Nomadic pattern of the [Root.GetName] established. Communication with [From.GetName] permitted.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]作为一个整体在虚空中穿行。[From.GetName]进入了我们的意识。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] moves as one through the void. [From.GetName] has entered our awareness.

entries.zh: 您已接通[Root.GetName]。可能会收取反向漫游费，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You've reached the [Root.GetName]. Reverse roaming charges may apply, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们穿行于群星之间无尽的道路上。[From.GetName]的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们在寻求什么？
entries.en: We traverse the endless road between stars. What do you seek, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of [From.GetName]?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的护航队已准备就绪。说明你们的来意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Convoy of the [Root.GetName] stands ready. State your intent, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 前路漫漫。很高兴能在[From.GetName]中遇到[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。
entries.en: The road is long. It is good to find [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] among the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的存在不构成威胁。与[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]合作是可以接受的。
entries.en: The presence of [From.GetName] is non-threatening. Cooperation with the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is acceptable.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的到来没有带来任何威胁。我们作为一个整体向[From.GetName]敞开心扉。欢迎你们来到这里。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] carry no menace in their wake. The Whole opens to the [From.GetName]. You are welcome here.

entries.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的友善面孔。真是令人耳目一新的低风险。
entries.en: A friendly face from the [From.GetName]. How refreshingly low-risk.

entries.zh: 愿您的旅途有恒定的星辰指引，愿那些[From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]总能在风暴降临前捕捉到虚空之歌。
entries.en: May your journey be guided by steady stars, and may those [From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] ever catch the songs of the void before the storms come.

entries.zh: 你赢得了[Root.GetName]的尊重，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。请畅所欲言。
entries.en: You have earned the respect of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. Speak freely.

entries.zh: 你们无法困住永不停歇之物，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You cannot corner what does not stay still, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]试图与分散的目标交战。效率低下。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] attempts to engage a distributed target. Inefficient.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]伸手抓向虫群。却空无一物，无处着力。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] grasps at the swarm. There is nothing to hold.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已发起恶意收购。我们将以激进重组作为回应。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has initiated hostile acquisition. We will respond with aggressive restructuring.

entries.zh: 虚空会将你们错误的回声传至你们[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的[From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]中，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。他们会明白这是你们的选择。
entries.en: The void will carry the echoes of your mistake to the [From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] of your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. They will know you chose this.

entries.zh: 你会发现，想要抓住[Root.GetName]的舰队，远比激怒它们要难。
entries.en: You will find the fleets of the [Root.GetName] harder to catch than to anger.

entries.zh: 我们不需要行星，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]坦然接受星系的一切。
entries.en: We have no need for planets, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] takes the galaxy as it comes.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]对固定资产的依赖非常原始。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] dependence on fixed assets is primitive.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]将自己束缚在星球上。蜂群无法理解这种软弱。
entries.en: The [From.GetSpeciesName] chains itself to worlds. The swarm does not understand such weakness.

entries.zh: 你们以领土来衡量财富，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。而[Root.GetName]则以机遇来衡量。
entries.en: You measure wealth in territory, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] measures it in opportunity.

entries.zh: 你们误将静止当作了启迪，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You have mistaken stillness for enlightenment, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 请注意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]：[Root.GetName]不会鸣枪示警。
entries.en: Be advised, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: the [Root.GetName] does not fire warning shots.

entries.zh: 当心脚下，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们的[Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]曾警告过比你们更强大的帝国。我们的道路还轮不到你们来阻挡。
entries.en: Careful where you step, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Our [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]s have warned empires greater than yours. Our path is not yours to block.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]正在干扰最佳移动。立即调整。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is interfering with optimal movement. Adjust immediately.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]阻挡了洪流。蜂群永不停息。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] obstructs the flow. The swarm does not stop.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]正在阻碍当前的行动。这对你来说并不划算。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is obstructing active operations. This is not cost-effective for you.

entries.zh: 不要阻挡我们前进的道路，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Do not obstruct the path we walk, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 让开，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，否则[Root.GetName]将强行把你们赶走。
entries.en: Move aside, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], or be moved by the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 前路愈发黑暗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]将与任何愿意让群星继续闪耀的人站在一起。
entries.en: The road grows darker, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] will stand with any who would keep the stars lit.

entries.zh: 已确认系统性威胁。[Root.GetName]将与[From.GetName]协调以维护存续。
entries.en: Systemic threat acknowledged. The [Root.GetName] will coordinate with the [From.GetName] to preserve continuity.

entries.zh: 阴影笼罩了所有生灵。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]并肩前行。我们将共同度过难关。
entries.en: A shadow falls across all living things. The [Root.GetName] moves alongside the [From.GetName]. We will endure it together.

entries.zh: 如此规模的危机同时威胁着[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]。合作……暂时是有利可图的。
entries.en: A crisis of this scale threatens both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. Cooperation is… temporarily profitable.

entries.zh: 当黑暗降临，即使是流浪者也必须成为牧羊人。与我们同行吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: When darkness rises, even wanderers must become shepherds. Walk with us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 无论什么降临星系，都将首先面对[Root.GetName]的舰队。与我们并肩作战，或者退避一旁。
entries.en: Whatever comes for the galaxy will face the fleets of the [Root.GetName] first. Stand with us, or stand aside.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]回应了您的信号。我们的赞助人[From.GetName]对舰队有何吩咐？
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] answers your signal. What does our patron, the [From.GetName], require of the fleet?

entries.zh: 已确认[From.GetName]的权限。[Root.GetName]等待指令输入。
entries.en: Authority of the [From.GetName] acknowledged. The [Root.GetName] awaits directive input.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的意志已被感知。[Root.GetName]聆听着。
entries.en: The will of the [From.GetName] is felt. The [Root.GetName] listens.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]正在聆听。让我们与[From.GetName]一起回顾义务、支持与期望。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is listening. Let us review obligations, support, and expectations with the [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们在您的庇护下行走星途，[From.GetName]。请讲，我们的[Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已然敞开。
entries.en: We walk the star-road beneath your protection, [From.GetName]. Speak, our [Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] are open.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的护航队保持战斗准备，随时听命于[From.GetName]。请下达命令。
entries.en: The convoy of the [Root.GetName] remains battle-ready and answerable to the [From.GetName]. Give your orders.

entries.zh: 原来这些就是[From.GetName]的流浪者。没有母星，无根无萍——然而在听到我们的呼叫时，那些[From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]还是竖了起来。你们一定很孤独吧。
entries.en: So these are the drifters of the [From.GetName]. No homeworld, no roots - and yet those [From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] still prick up at our hail. How lonely you must be.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]表现出低效的游荡。没有世界锚点的文明应该从星系记录中被清除。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] exhibits inefficient wandering. A civilization without a world anchor should be cleaned up from the galactic records.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]四处游荡，没有巢穴可供进食。星系应当进化到一个没有你们存在的状态。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] wanders without a nest to feed from. The galaxy should evolve to exist without you.

entries.zh: 没有办公室，没有控股，没有固定资产。告诉我们，[From.GetName]，你为什么还没有申请破产？
entries.en: No offices, no holdings, no fixed assets. Tell us, [From.GetName], why haven't you filed for bankruptcy?

entries.zh: 没有圣地，也没有神圣的家园，你们四处流浪，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，在冰冷的黑暗中抚养着你们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。这真是一种可悲的生存方式。
entries.en: You wander without holy ground or sacred hearth, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], raising your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] in the cold dark. It is a pitiable way to exist.

entries.zh: 一个没有领土的种族，距离灭绝仅有一败之遥。记住这点，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: A people without territory is a people one defeat away from extinction. Remember that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们正在接收您的通讯，[From.GetName]。您想讨论什么？
entries.en: We are receiving your transmission, [From.GetName]. What do you wish to discuss?

entries.zh: 已确认[From.GetName]的游牧模式。说明你的意图。
entries.en: Nomadic pattern of the [From.GetName] acknowledged. State your intent.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]随我们一同漂流。蜂群已经察觉到了你。说出你的目的。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] drifts as we drift. The swarm is aware of you. Speak your purpose.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，本频道已开放。是贸易提议、谈判，还是责任通知？
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], this frequency is open. Trade proposal, negotiation, or liability notice?

entries.zh: 虚空的旅人，我们听见你们了。是什么让[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]引起了我们的注意？
entries.en: Travelers of the void, we hear you. What brings the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to our attention?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]护航队，报告你们的来意。
entries.en: [From.GetName] convoy, report your business.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，我们随时欢迎您的信号。我们该如何协助您的旅程？
entries.en: [From.GetName], your signal is always welcome. How may we assist your journey?

entries.zh: 已识别并许可[From.GetName]的舰队模式。请说明您的需求。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] fleet-pattern is recognized with approval. State your needs.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的到来已为虫群所知。你们在这里并非不受欢迎。你们所求为何？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is known to the swarm. You are not unwelcome here. What do you seek?

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetName]。我们最喜爱的移动合作伙伴。是什么机遇把你们带到这里来了？
entries.en: Ah, [From.GetName]. Our favorite mobile partners. What opportunity brings you here?

entries.zh: 愿祝福降临于你们的方舟与你们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。请畅所欲言。
entries.en: Blessings upon your Arkships and your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Speak freely.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]赢得了我们的尊重。我们能为您的船队提供些什么？
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has our respect. What can we do for your convoy?

entries.zh: 你们不可能永远逃下去，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。每失去一艘方舟，你们的末日就逼近一分。
entries.en: You cannot run forever, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Every Arkship you lose brings your end closer.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的迁徙到此为止。我们会将你们的舰队打得七零八落。
entries.en: The migration of the [From.GetName] terminates here. We will scatter your fleet.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]止步于此。蜂群将席卷残存的一切。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] goes no further. The swarm will sweep over what remains.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已进入清算状态。资产扣押进行中。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has entered liquidation status. Asset seizure in progress.

entries.zh: 你们的流浪只是延缓了审判，并未让你们免于审判，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]中的托辞无法逃过即将降临的一切。
entries.en: Your wandering has delayed judgment, not spared you from it, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The words of your [From.GetSpeciesMouthName]s cannot outrun what is coming.

entries.zh: 你们躲在机动与护航屏障之后，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们会将它们一并粉碎。
entries.en: You hide behind movement and convoy screens, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will break both.

entries.zh: 对于一个连自己能叫出名字的世界都没有的种族来说，你们的骄傲真是令人费解，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Your pride is strange for a people who own no world they can name, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]在历史长河中随波逐流，却将其称之为适应。我们对此依然不以为然。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] drifts through history and calls it adaptation. We remain unconvinced.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]在历史中随波逐流，并称之为适应。蜂群不为所动。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] drifts through history and calls it adaptation. The swarm is not moved.

entries.zh: 一支妄自尊大的舰队依然只是贬值资产，[From.GetName]。
entries.en: A fleet with delusions of grandeur is still a depreciating asset, [From.GetName].

entries.zh: 不要将流浪与超脱混为一谈，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Do not confuse wandering with transcendence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 机动性是有用的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。它并不能替代力量。
entries.en: Mobility is useful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is not a substitute for power.

entries.zh: 你们的舰队近乎放肆，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。给我一个解释。
entries.en: Your fleet edges too close to insolence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Explain yourselves.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]距离化为碎片仅有一步之遥。修正你的航向。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is one deviation from becoming debris. Correct your course.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]激怒了它无法逃脱的存在。蜂群的耐心不是无限的。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] provokes what it cannot outrun. The swarm's patience is not infinite.

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]正在失去耐心，而且拖延的成本越来越高。
entries.en: We are losing patience with the [From.GetName], and the cost of delay is increasing.

entries.zh: 你们流浪的人民心中充满愤怒，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，却少有智慧。
entries.en: There is anger in your wandering people, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and little wisdom in it.

entries.zh: 如果[From.GetName]是来找茬的，直说就行。
entries.en: If the [From.GetName] came looking for a fight, just say so.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，如果你确实有意协助坚守防线，[Root.GetName]将会听取你的意见。
entries.en: [From.GetName], if you truly intend to help hold the line, the [Root.GetName] will hear you.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]具备高机动性。这提高了它在当前条件下的战略价值。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] possesses high mobility. This increases its strategic value in current conditions.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]如蜂群般行动自如。在黑暗的时代，这让你们对我们极具价值。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] moves freely, as the swarm does. In dark times, this makes you valuable to us.

entries.zh: 像[From.GetName]这样的舰队在危机中具有明确的作战价值。让我们来讨论一下条件吧。
entries.en: A fleet like the [From.GetName] has clear operational value in a crisis. Let us discuss terms.

entries.zh: 即使是流浪者也能成为一方守护，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]欢迎你们的援助。
entries.en: Even wanderers may serve as guardians, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] welcomes your aid.

entries.zh: 如果[From.GetName]已经为真正的战争做好了准备，那就请讲。[Root.GetName]洗耳恭听。
entries.en: If the [From.GetName] is ready for real war, then speak. The [Root.GetName] is listening.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]，你的继续通行取决于秩序。你需要[Root.GetName]的指示吗？
entries.en: [From.GetName], your continued passage depends on order. Do you require instruction from the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]仍受[Root.GetName]的监督。请保持顺从。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] remains under supervision of the [Root.GetName]. Maintain compliance.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]遵循[Root.GetName]的意志行动。切勿偏离。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] moves within the will of the [Root.GetName]. Do not stray from it.

entries.zh: 像[From.GetName]这样的移动子公司需要明确的条款。让我们来审核一下您的条款。
entries.en: Mobile subsidiaries like the [From.GetName] require clear terms. Let us review yours.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的流浪者们，不要将[Root.GetName]的指引误认为是软弱。
entries.en: Wanderers of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do not mistake the guidance of the [Root.GetName] for weakness.

entries.zh: 无论有没有方舟舰，[From.GetName]都要听命于[Root.GetName]。说吧。
entries.en: Arkships or not, the [From.GetName] answers to the [Root.GetName]. Speak.

entries.zh: 又是一支流浪舰队，[From.GetName]？你们今天打算怎么浪费[Root.GetName]的时间？
entries.en: Another wandering fleet, the [From.GetName]? How are you wasting the time of the [Root.GetName] today?

entries.zh: [From.GetName]未与[Root.GetName]在路线上一致。从我们的驿道中改道。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] is not aligned with the [Root.GetName]. Deviate from our Waylines.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]与[Root.GetName]毫不和谐。也许你们的方舟舰应该被静默。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] are disharmonious to the [Root.GetName]. Perhaps your Arkships should be silenced.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]提供不了任何[Root.GetName]无法在别处获得的东西。这场会议纯属浪费时间，我们将向你们发送账单。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] offers nothing the [Root.GetName] cannot acquire elsewhere. We will be sending an invoice for this waste of a meeting.

entries.zh: 虚空承载着许多朝圣者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，以及同样多的愚者。但[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并非愚者。
entries.en: The void bears many pilgrims, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and just as many fools. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not the fools.

entries.zh: 让[From.GetName]的船队远离[Root.GetName]的驿站，你们或许能在这场遭遇中幸存下来。
entries.en: Keep the [From.GetName] convoy clear of the [Root.GetName] Waystations, and you may survive this encounter.

entries.zh: 另一支方舟舰队，[From.GetName]？幸会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。是什么让你们与[Root.GetName]的航道交汇？
entries.en: A fellow Arkship fleet, the [From.GetName]? Well met, [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. What brings you across the path of the [Root.GetName]?

entries.zh: 另一个迁徙智能[From.GetName]进入了[Root.GetName]的范围内。已发出确认信号。
entries.en: Another migrating intelligence, [From.GetName], enters range of the [Root.GetName]. Acknowledgment issued.

entries.zh: 我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通常独自旅行。向你们致敬，各位旅人。
entries.en: We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] usually travel alone. Greetings to you, fellow sojourners.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]遇到了[Root.GetName]。很好。双方都懂得保持居无定所的价值。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] meets the [Root.GetName]. Good. Two parties who understand the value of staying mobile.

entries.zh: 又一个跋涉于漫长旅途的种族，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。群星让你们与[Root.GetName]的轨迹交汇，定有其深意。
entries.en: Another people of the long road, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The stars have crossed your path with the [Root.GetName] for a reason.

entries.zh: 像[Root.GetName]这样的船队遇到了[From.GetName]。很好。你懂得效率。
entries.en: A convoy like the [Root.GetName] meets the [From.GetName]. Good. You understand efficiency.

entries.zh: 又一支友好的舰队，[From.GetName]？很好。今天对我们双方的人民来说，虚空不再那么寒冷。
entries.en: Another friendly fleet, the [From.GetName]? Good. The void is less cold for both our peoples today.

entries.zh: 检测到[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的友好举动。已达成相互理解。
entries.en: Friendly motion detected between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. Mutual understanding achieved.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]在虚空中结伴穿行。集合体察觉到了同类的漂流。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] move together through the void. The collective recognizes a kindred drift.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]总是很欣赏像[From.GetName]这样的合作伙伴。居无定所是我们共同的优势。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] always appreciates partners like the [From.GetName]. Mobility is a shared advantage.

entries.zh: 无尽黑暗的朝圣者，对于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的喜悦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愿洗净自己的[Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]，全神贯注聆听。
entries.en: Pilgrims of the endless dark, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] open their [Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with joy.

entries.zh: 幸会，[From.GetName]的船队。[Root.GetName]敬重那些在漫漫长路上坚持下来的人。
entries.en: Well met, convoy of the [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] respects those who endure the long road.

entries.zh: 就这样吧。[Root.GetName]对阵[From.GetName]。让虚空来裁决哪支舰队有资格继续航行吧。
entries.en: So. The [Root.GetName] against the [From.GetName]. Let the void judge which fleet deserves to keep moving.

entries.zh: 两支迁徙文明，[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]，无法共享同一个空间。其中一个将被终止。
entries.en: Two migrations, [Root.GetName] and [From.GetName], cannot share the same space. One will be terminated.

entries.zh: 两支迁徙文明，[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]，无法共享同一个空间。其中一个将被吞食。
entries.en: Two migrations, [Root.GetName] and [From.GetName], cannot share the same space. One will be consumed.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]已对[Root.GetName]发起恶意收购。此次交易将通过武力完成。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] has initiated hostile acquisition against the [Root.GetName]. This transaction will be concluded by force.

entries.zh: 这是何等残酷的命运，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将朝圣之路变成了战场，只留下他们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]来继承这片残骸。
entries.en: A grim fate, that the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] turn the pilgrim road into a battlefield. and leave their [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] to inherit the wreckage.

entries.zh: 很好。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]堂堂正正地解决此事，舰队对阵舰队。
entries.en: Good. The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] settle this properly, fleet against fleet.

entries.zh: 至少[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还算明智，没有去定居。[Root.GetName]愿意承认这一点。
entries.en: At least the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] had the sense not to settle. The [Root.GetName] will grant you that much.

entries.zh: 大多数文明，例如[From.GetName]，都诞生于泥土之中。而[Root.GetName]则铸就于运动之中。
entries.en: Most civilizations, such as the [From.GetName], are born in dirt. The [Root.GetName] was forged in motion.

entries.zh: 啊，[From.GetName]。您是来为[From.GetCapitalName]买个替代品的吗？它有点破旧了。
entries.en: Ah, the [From.GetName]. Have you come to buy a replacement for the [From.GetCapitalName]? It's a bit run-down.

entries.zh: 虽然我们都在太空中穿梭，但只有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]知晓真正的道路。
entries.en: While we both fly through space, only the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know the true path.

entries.zh: 你应该去驻守一颗星球，[From.GetName]。把复杂的虚空留给[Root.GetName]吧。
entries.en: You should go garrison a planet [From.GetName]. Leave the complexity of the void to the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 别激动，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。虚空已经够拥挤了，没必要让[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]再兵戎相见。
entries.en: Easy now, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The void is crowded enough without the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] reaching for weapons.

entries.zh: 检测到[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间局势升级。冲突概率正在上升。
entries.en: Escalation detected between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. Probability of conflict rising.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的紧张局势日益加剧。蜂群感受到了。这条道路必将以鲜血告终。
entries.en: Tension grows between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. The swarm feels it. This path ends in blood.

entries.zh: 让我们不要将[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的相遇变成一片无利可图的残骸区。
entries.en: Let us not turn an encounter between the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] into an unprofitable wreck field.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都远未抵达避风港。不要把这次会面浪费在愤怒上。
entries.en: Both the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are far from safe harbor. Do not waste this meeting on anger.

entries.zh: 两支武装舰队，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]。请谨慎选择下一步行动。
entries.en: Two armed fleets, the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. Choose your next move carefully.

entries.zh: 无论我们有何分歧，[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]都无法独自在即将到来的黑暗中幸存。
entries.en: Whatever our differences, neither the [Root.GetName] nor the [From.GetName] survives the coming dark alone.

entries.zh: 独立的迁徙，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]。检测到共同威胁。协同行动为最优解。
entries.en: Separate migrations, [Root.GetName] and [From.GetName]. Shared threat detected. Coordination is optimal.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]各自分别漂泊流淌，却面对着相同的阴影。蜂群建议共同行动。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] flow separately, but face the same shadow. The swarm suggests moving together.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]提议与[From.GetName]合作。生存第一，利润其次。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] proposes cooperation with the [From.GetName]. Survival first, margins later.

entries.zh: 漫漫长路，将[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都引向了这一使命。
entries.en: The long road has led both the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to this duty.

entries.zh: 两支舰队，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]，正严阵以待，防备着即将到来的一切。我们的[Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已经捕捉到了信号。
entries.en: Two fleets, the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName], standing watch against what comes. Our [Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] are already picking up the signal.

entries.zh: 一支舰队与另一支紧密相连，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]共同踏上了一条奇特的道路。
entries.en: A fleet bound to another, the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] walk a strange road together.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间已建立等级制度。效率低下，但很稳定。
entries.en: Hierarchy established between [Root.GetName] and [From.GetName]. Inefficient, but stable.

entries.zh: 一方迁徙引领，另一方跟随。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]找到了它们的秩序。
entries.en: One migration leads, the other follows. The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have found their order.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]共享所有权。合约的复杂程度必定极其惊人。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] in shared ownership. The contractual complexity must be immense.

entries.zh: 即便是流浪者亦会屈膝。今日，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都踏上了这条道路。
entries.en: Even wanderers kneel. Today, both the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] walk that path.

entries.zh: 一支船队领航，另一支跟随。[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]都明白各自的职责。
entries.en: One convoy leads, one follows. The [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] understand their roles.
